Vice President of Revenue Operations

Employment Type: Full time, Individual Contributor

Location: Singapore

Please note: Only candidates currently residing in Singapore with valid work authorization are eligible for this role

About the Role

We are seeking a hands‑on Vice President of Revenue Operations to drive strategic revenue growth and operational excellence across our sales, marketing, and customer success organizations. This role requires a seasoned leader who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, leveraging deep expertise in SaaS and data licensing business models to optimize our global revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Strategy & Operations

  • Own end-to-end revenue operations strategy, including forecasting, pipeline management, and revenue recognition across multiple business lines
  • Design and implement scalable processes for SaaS subscription models and data licensing agreements
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to drive revenue growth, retention, and expansion
  • Establish and maintain revenue reporting frameworks, KPIs, and executive dashboards

Sales & Marketing Pipeline Management

  • Architect sophisticated lead routing, allocation, and reassignment processes to maximize conversion rates
  • Implement advanced lead scoring models and territory management strategies
  • Design and optimize marketing-to-sales handoff processes and service level agreements
  • Build comprehensive pipeline forecasting models with scenario planning capabilities

AI & Automation

  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI‑powered tools for lead qualification, scoring, and routing
  • Drive automation initiatives across CRM, marketing automation, and sales enablement platforms
  • Leverage machine learning for predictive analytics and revenue forecasting
  • Champion adoption of AI‑driven insights to improve SDR productivity and sales performance

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing operations
  • Proven track record in SaaS and data licensing business models with deep understanding of recurring revenue metrics
  • Extensive experience with sales and marketing pipeline management, including lead allocation and routing strategies
  • Demonstrated expertise in implementing AI and automation solutions for revenue operations
  • Strong background in SDR operations, lead management, and sales development processes
  • Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), marketing automation tools, and analytics platforms
  • Expert‑level skills in forecasting, pipeline analysis, and revenue reporting
  • Experience building and leading high‑performing teams
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities with comfort in data‑heavy environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Analytics, or related field
  • Experience with enterprise B2B sales cycles and complex deal structures
  • Background in data monetization and licensing models
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, or other analytical programming languages
  • Experience with modern revenue operations tools and emerging AI/ML platforms
  • Track record of driving significant revenue growth and operational efficiency improvements

Benefits

We focus on doing things differently and challenge each other to be the best we can be.

  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Casual, remote work environment
  • Hybrid, flexible hours
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Fun annual team events
  • Being part of a high‑performing team that wants to win and have fun doing it
  • Extremely competitive compensation

About Pixalate

Pixalate offers the market‑leading fraud protection, privacy, and compliance analytics platform for Connected TV (CTV), Mobile Apps, and Websites.

Our platform has been used to unearth multiple high‑profile criminal and illegal surveillance cases, including:

  • Gizmodo: An iCloud Feature Is Enabling a $65 Million Scam, New Research Says
  • Adweek: A 7‑Figure Ad Fraud Scheme Running on Roku Underlines Murkiness of CTV
  • Washington Post: Your kids’ apps are spying on them
  • Pro Publica: Porn, Piracy, Fraud: What Lurks Inside Google’s Black Box Ad Empire
  • ABC7 News: The State of Children’s Privacy Online
  • NBC News: How many apps are tracking your children

Our team of lawyers, data scientists, engineers, economists, and researchers spans globally with presence in California, New York, Washington DC, London and Singapore.

6435a9a72e40b2fd965f1ba0c4704652.title: Wellness Brand Sales & Customer Experience Associate
6435a9a72e40b2fd965f1ba0c4704652.snippet:
About the Role

Estalife is a direct-to-consumer supplement brand backed by Singapore’s Largest NSF GMP Certified Supplements Factory. We’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about health and wellness to be the face of Estalife at our factory office. This isn’t a traditional front-desk role — you’ll be the first person customers meet and a key driver of walk-in and recovered sales.

You’ll split your time between serving walk-in customers, handling online customer enquiries, recovering abandoned carts by phone, and supporting day-to-day admin. The role suits someone who’s personable, self-directed, and comfortable switching between tasks throughout the day.

Additional OT and other support role activities are available, with opportunities to upskill.

What You’ll Do

Walk-In Sales & Customer Experience

• Welcome walk-in customers at our factory office and provide a warm, knowledgeable shopping experience

• Learn and confidently recommend Estalife’s full product range — understand the ingredients, the science behind them, and who they’re best suited for

• Help customers complete purchases on our mobile ordering system

• Upsell and cross-sell where it genuinely benefits the customer (you earn 2% commission on every sale you close)

Abandoned Cart Recovery

• Follow up with customers who abandoned their cart at checkout — reach out by phone to understand their hesitation and help them complete their order

• Track and log recovery efforts and outcomes

• Earn 2% commission on every recovered order you convert

Online Customer Service

• Respond to customer enquiries across our online channels (chat, email, social media DMs) during downtime between walk-ins

• Handle order-related queries, product questions, and basic troubleshooting with care and product knowledge

• Escalate complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate team member

Admin & Operations Support

• Keep the reception and customer-facing area clean, organised, and well-stocked with product displays

• Assist with general administrative tasks as needed (data entry, filing, inventory counts, scheduling)

• Support ad-hoc operational needs at the factory office

Who You Are

• Genuinely interested in health, wellness, or nutrition — you don’t need a science degree, but you should enjoy learning about supplements and be able to explain them simply

• Warm, approachable, and comfortable initiating conversations with customers of all ages

• Self-directed — you can manage your own time between walk-ins, online CS, admin, and outbound calls without constant supervision

• Comfortable with basic technology: mobile ordering systems, CRM tools, chat platforms, and spreadsheets

• Fluent in English; conversational Mandarin is a strong plus given our customer base. We are seeking candidates proficient in Mandarin to effectively communicate with Mandarin-speaking clients.

• Prior experience in retail sales, customer service, or a front-facing role is preferred but not required — the right attitude matters more

Nice to Have

• Experience in health, wellness, beauty, or supplement retail

• Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, etc.)

• Experience with outbound sales calls or cart recovery

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary of $2,500/month plus uncapped 2% sales commission

• Direct exposure to how a supplement brand and GMP-certified factory operate — this is not a siloed role

• A founder-led environment where your input is heard and acted on

• Product training so you can speak about our range with genuine confidence

• Staff discounts on Estalife products

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note on why this role interests you. We’d love to hear from you.

Job Title: Customer Experience and Success Manager

Full Time Published On: 14/12/2025 8:25:05 pm

Job Description

Job Summary
To design, lead, and manage all aspects of customer experience and retention across Mind Stretcher’s centres and brands. This role ensures that every parent and student’s journey, from enrolment to renewal, reflects excellence in service, responsiveness, and relationship management. You will spearhead customer success strategies, retention initiatives, and feedback systems to improve satisfaction, loyalty, and brand trust.

Success will be measured by retention and renewal rates, customer satisfaction, time-to-resolution, withdrawal rates and referral rates. These metrics are designed to be interlocking, yet holistic in the outcome that you will be expected to drive.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Map and refine the end-to-end parent and student journey across onboarding, learning, feedback, and renewal stages.
  • Establish clear service standards and escalation processes across all centres.
  • Collaborate with marketing, centre ops, and academic teams to ensure consistent communication and tone across touchpoints.
  • Retention and Loyalty Management
  • Analyse churn drivers and develop targeted “save” strategies (e.g. intervention SOPs, follow-up protocols).
  • Partner with centre heads to manage at‑risk students or families and develop personalised retention actions.
  • Design and track loyalty programmes, referral incentives, and satisfaction initiatives.

Customer Success and Relationship Management

  • Design a system that can centralise contact for parent engagement and issue resolution.
  • Build proactive success frameworks that anticipate needs before complaints arise.
  • Train front‑line staff in customer empathy, solution‑based communication, and recovery handling.

Insights and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead data‑driven feedback systems (NPS, withdrawal analytics, and renewal metrics).
  • Synthesise insights into actionable reports for management and regular reviews.
  • Work with product and curriculum teams to translate feedback into programme improvements.

Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Align operations, academic, and marketing teams around shared service KPIs.
  • Lead or support projects such as CRM upgrades, automation of feedback loops, or service recovery dashboards.
  • Mentor junior service staff or other customer experience executives.

Job Requirements

  • At least 7 years’ experience in customer success, service excellence, or parent relations (preferably in education, hospitality, or service‑driven sectors).
  • Proven ability to lead retention and engagement initiatives with measurable results.
  • Strong analytical ability; comfortable working with data to identify pain points and track improvements.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to work cross‑functionally, manage stakeholders and deliver initiatives on‑time.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer‑first mindset.
  • Familiarity with CRM, feedback tracking, or service desk tools (Salesforce, Freshdesk, Zendesk, etc.) preferred.

Working Experience & Education Qualifications

Education Qualification

  • Degree

Company Profile

Founded in 2002, Mind Stretcher is the market‑leading Tuition & Enrichment chain in Singapore, with 26 centres islandwide and an annual enrolment of 24,000 courses. As Educators with a Difference, we seek to inspire & stretch the potential of all students, regardless of their individual ability. We welcome like‑minded talents who care deeply about nurturing & educating our future generation.

We are looking for a Manager, Sales Enablement and Product Marketing to build and operationalise Finmo’s sales enablement engine. This individual contributor will ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the right narratives, assets and CRM-driven workflows to consistently position Finmo’s treasury (cash tools + payments offering) to CFOs and finance leaders.

You will work at the intersection of marketing, product and sales, translating complex fintech products into clear commercial value while embedding enablement directly into HubSpot to drive pipeline conversion, activation and expansion.

This is a hands-on, execution-driven role with strong exposure to strategic GTM initiatives and category positioning.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Enablement Engine

  • Build and maintain Finmo’s end-to-end sales enablement framework aligned to core ICPs.
  • Develop repeatable sales playbooks for key use cases including cash visibility, cash forecasting, cross-border payments, global collections, FX risk management.
  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership to identify funnel friction points and deploy targeted enablement initiatives to improve conversion and deal velocity.


2. Sales Collateral and Content Development

  • Own creation and continuous optimisation of all sales-facing assets including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, ROI calculators and objection-handling frameworks.
  • Maintain a centralised and well-tagged content repository mapped to ICP, persona, use case and funnel stage.

3. Product Marketing and Messaging

  • Translate product capabilities into clear and differentiated value propositions tailored for CFOs, finance teams and founders.
  • Support product launches and feature rollouts with structured messaging, pitch narratives and enablement kits.
  • Ensure consistent articulation of Finmo’s category positioning, treasury-lite narrative and core value pillars across all sales interactions.

4. Competitive Intelligence and Market Insights

  • Develop and maintain competitive battlecards covering key fintech and treasury platform competitors.
  • Equip sales teams with clear differentiation, pricing, positioning and responses to common objections.
  • Analyse win-loss insights and market feedback to continuously refine messaging and positioning.

5. Sales Readiness and Training

  • Design onboarding and ongoing enablement programs for account executives, business development and partnership teams.
  • Conduct regular training sessions on new product capabilities, messaging updates and vertical-specific use cases.
  • Establish readiness frameworks to ensure consistent pitch quality and narrative alignment globally.

6. Funnel and Performance Optimisation

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales and RevOps to analyse funnel metrics and identify opportunities to improve conversion and activation rates.
  • Track adoption and effectiveness of enablement assets and playbooks and iterate based on data-driven insights.
  • Support the development of a unified attribution and enablement performance view within HubSpot.

Success Metrics (First 12 Months)

  • Improved lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-activation conversion rates
  • Reduced sales cycle length across priority ICP segments
  • High adoption of enablement assets and CRM playbooks by revenue teams
  • Consistent messaging alignment across marketing, product and sales
  • Measurable pipeline influence from enablement-driven initiatives


Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 7-8 years of experience in sales enablement, product marketing or B2B fintech or SaaS GTM roles
  • Exposure to payments, treasury or financial infrastructure platforms is strongly preferred

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong storytelling and positioning skills for complex fintech products
  • Ability to translate product features into clear commercial value and ROI narratives
  • Hands-on experience building sales decks, playbooks and objection-handling frameworks
  • Familiarity with HubSpot and Mixpanel for embedding enablement workflows
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to use funnel and pipeline insights to refine messaging and enablement priorities
  • Excellent stakeholder management across sales, product and leadership teams

We're on a mission to make it possible for every person, team, and company to be able to tailor their software to solve any problem and take on any challenge.   5. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better - and work with product to inform what we do next.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own post‑sale customer lifecycle including onboarding, AI adoption, value delivery and renewal for a book of named accounts

  • Develop success plans to help every customer achieve desired objectives

  • Lead AI workshops to build and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems

  • Develop Notion champions and advocates within book of named accounts

  • Conduct business reviews with senior stakeholders to communicate value received

  • Partner with AEs on growth strategy within existing accounts - identify and qualify expansion opportunities

  • Innovate on Customer Success programs to retain and grow customers; document and share learnings with the broader organisation

  • Learn our product inside and out - share key findings/learnings with Product team to influence roadmap

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of success in your current Customer Success or Account Management role

  • You have experience driving the end‑to‑end customer journey - from adoption to renewal

  • Strong discovery skills to uncover customer challenges and connect them to tailored solutions

  • You are comfortable with technical concepts and can develop skills required to effectively build and implement AI workflows

  • Ability to articulate value customers are receiving and present it effectively to senior audiences

  • Ability to build Customer Success playbooks and new processes based on learnings

  • Ability to work cross‑functionally to solve customer problems creatively

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast‑paced and foundational team

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice to Haves:

  • You have experience using Notion at a past or current company

  • You have experience working with a technical product and multiple commercial models (seats, usage)

  • You've been a first or early hire at a fast growing start up

  • Sales Process Optimization: Analyze and implement enhancements to optimize end-to-end sales process (from lead generation to account management), that maximize efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Develop and implement standardized sales methodologies and playbooks to elevate sales effectiveness.

0cfd3ee525249f9eddf5a586e2ef26fa.snippet:
Field Operations and Enablement Manager - APJ

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Field Operations & Enablement Manager to support our rapidly growing APJ region. This hybrid role combines operational leadership with hands‑on enablement and is ideal for someone energized by building in an emerging market, working cross‑functionally, and partnering with globally distributed teams headquartered in AMS.

You’ll be the operational backbone for our APJ sellers—bringing clarity to processes, improving execution quality, and ensuring continuity across the customer journey—while also delivering targeted enablement that supports onboarding, skill development, and ongoing readiness. As the region continues to scale and recalibrate, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how the business operates day to day.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, love creating structure from ambiguity, and enjoy partnering across time zones to support global programs, this role offers meaningful visibility and impact across the GTM organization.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the Voice of the APJ Field & Trusted Business Partner

  • Build deep relationships with AEs, SDRs, and managers to understand their challenges, requests, and emerging opportunities.
  • Identify recurring patterns and translate field feedback into structured operational insights for RevOps and Global GTM leadership.
  • Represent APJ needs during global planning cycles, advocating for improvements aligned to both local realities and global priorities.
  • Help the field understand the "why" behind operational decisions and ensure alignment between APJ and global strategy.

Drive Operational Excellence Across the APJ Segment

  • Streamline and improve processes that support predictable pipeline creation, opportunity management, and deal progression.
  • Partner with APJ Sales Leadership to reinforce execution expectations and maintain consistent operating rhythms across the region.
  • Translate global process standards into APJ‑ready workflows that address local needs without sacrificing consistency.

Enable Sellers and Managers Through Training, Readiness, and Skill Development

  • Deliver and support onboarding for new sales APJ hires, ensuring they ramp quickly with clear processes, tools, and expectations.
  • Facilitate everboarding programs focused on pipeline generation, discovery, qualification, value articulation, and deal progression.
  • Collaborate with global enablement partners to adapt content, training, and frameworks to fit the APJ context.
  • Provide managers with resources and guidance that strengthen coaching and reinforce expected behaviors.

Partner Globally to Operationalize GTM Initiatives

  • Work closely with Field Operations, Marketing (Campaigns), Sales Enablement, Product Marketing, Partners, RevOps, and Customer Experience to ensure global programs land effectively in APJ.
  • Communicate upcoming changes and readiness needs in a way that keeps the region aligned and informed despite timezone differences.
  • Help adapt global launches—process updates, messaging changes, new plays—into clear, actionable steps for APJ sellers.

Measure, Improve, and Scale What Works

  • Track operational and enablement performance indicators to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for optimization.
  • Document and scale examples of "what good looks like" across APJ to elevate regional execution.
  • Continuously refine workflows, guidance, and enablement programs based on data, local feedback, and evolving business needs.

About You:

  • You thrive in fast-paced, emerging markets and enjoy building structure while the business is evolving.
  • You’re equally comfortable driving operational rigor and delivering hands‑on enablement.
  • You excel at working with globally distributed teams and collaborating across time zones.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively, ensuring sellers have the clarity and resources they need.
  • You’re data-driven and use insights to diagnose issues, prioritize improvements, and measure impact.
  • You build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners—becoming a go‑to problem solver.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in field operations, sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar GTM roles.
  • Experience supporting high‑velocity or emerging‑market sales teams, particularly in APJ.
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, opportunity management, and qualification frameworks.
  • Experience delivering training or enablement programs across virtual, live, and asynchronous formats.
  • Comfortable partnering with cross‑functional teams such as Sales, RevOps, Enablement, Product Marketing, and CS Ops.
  • Familiarity with enablement and sales tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, and LMS platforms (SalesHood, Skilljar, etc.).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to navigate multiple priorities in an evolving environment.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • You’ll help build and shape how the APJ region operates and grows.
  • You’ll collaborate with global teams and influence how worldwide programs translate to local execution.
  • You’ll work in an environment that values clarity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • You’ll join a region on the rise—where your work will have immediate visibility and impact.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

b2d0b452a8ecb5e1300fdabeba970e6d.title: Sales Enablement Operations Associate
b2d0b452a8ecb5e1300fdabeba970e6d.snippet:
The APJ Enablement Team empowers our Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Solutions teams with the right information, skills, and tools throughout their tenure at Datadog in order to maximise their ability to land, expand, and drive Datadog's next phase of growth across the region. We act as strategic partners to the APJ Leadership Team, ensuring they have the support they need to achieve their goals. We regionalise and contextualise global programs, custom-build regional programs, and provide just-in-time support in order to deliver quantifiable impact on go-to-market performance in APJ. As Datadog scales rapidly across APJ, our Enablement programs must scale with precision and consistency. The Sales Enablement Operations Associate will be the operational backbone of the regional Enablement function—designing, running, and continuously improving the systems that power onboarding and ongoing development for our GTM teams. This role is about building leverage. You will create structure where there is complexity, drive process where there is friction, and ensure Enablement programs run efficiently at scale. If you are motivated by operational rigor, process design, and making teams more effective through better systems, this role offers direct impact on how fast and how well APJ grows. At Datadog, we place value in our office culture—the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. What You'll Do: Own end-to-end operations for APJ Enablement programs, including onboarding, everboarding, manager development, and on-demand learning. This includes enrollments, scheduling, and communications. Serve as the APJ Operations point of contact to the global GTM Enablement team. Ensure global programs are planned, launched, and run smoothly in APJ. Partner with sellers and sales leaders to drive alignment and execution of Enablement programs across multiple teams and regions. Manage and maintain Enablement infrastructure, including the Enablement wiki, Google Drive, Learning Management System (LMS), resource repositories, and supporting tools. Ensure content is current, easy to find, and consistently used. Track program participation, completion, and outcomes using dashboards, surveys, and system data. Build reports on program effectiveness for leadership. Improve and scale Enablement operations by designing repeatable, measurable processes that support growth without increasing complexity. Continuously evaluate and enhance tooling, systems, and workflows used to deliver Enablement programs. Support special projects and one-off initiatives as needed, contributing to the ongoing evolution of the APJ Enablement operating model.
Who You Are: 1–2 years of experience in Revenue Enablement, Learning and Development, Project Management, Business Operations, Office Operations, Recruiting Operations, Executive Assisting, or a similar operational role. Project management experience delivering programs or initiatives on short timelines, with clear ownership. Strong operational discipline. You are highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to run multiple workstreams. Outstanding verbal and written communicator: You make the complex simple. Proven ability to prioritise and pivot quickly. You can juggle competing requests, adjust plans, and move with urgency when the business changes. Team oriented and empathetic: You can work with sales leaders, reps, marketing, your own team, whomever! Scrappy and entrepreneurial: You enjoy building and iterating, and don't mind getting messy.
Bonus Points: Experience at a high growth Software-as-a-Service or technology company. Experience supporting enablement or GTM teams across multiple regions, especially in APJ. Experience with Learning Management Systems, such as Docebo. Exposure to change management, especially rolling out new programs, tools, or processes to the field. Experience using data to track progress and outcomes. Comfortable building reports and doing basic analysis in tools like Tableau and Google Sheets. Comfort working in fast-growing or scaling environments with evolving processes.
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. Benefits and Growth: Best-in-breed onboarding Generous global benefits Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks
Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers' entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. We hire successful builders with founder‑like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role‑related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You’re humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end‑to‑end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

The Team

The Revenue Strategy & Enablement team at Airwallex is at the heart of our commercial engine, empowering sales and commercial teams to win in a fast‑paced environment. We collaborate closely with commercial leaders, product marketing, and cross‑functional partners to deliver world‑class enablement programs, content, and training. Our mission is to accelerate revenue growth by equipping our teams with the knowledge, tools, and processes they need to succeed – across both core and new products, and in every region we serve.

What You’ll Do

Airwallex is looking for a commercially savvy operator with experience in enablement, new product launches, and market entry to help accelerate our growth across Singapore and Southeast Asia. You’ll work at the intersection of GTM, Product, and Commercial – driving high‑impact initiatives that support our frontline teams and unlock new revenue opportunities. We’re seeking someone with a strong foundation (or a strong interest) in Banking, Financial Services, Fintech, or Payments, and the ability to combine strategic thinking with operational execution and content excellence. If you’re passionate about scaling businesses and enabling teams to win, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities
  • Partner with Commercial and Revenue Strategy leaders to identify the highest‑leverage enablement initiatives that will drive growth across the funnel.
  • Translate GTM priorities into clear, actionable enablement programs that improve sales execution across both core and new products.
  • Develop and deliver high‑impact onboarding, product training, and enablement experiences that align with commercial goals and accelerate time‑to‑productivity.
  • Lead the design and rollout of scalable content, AI tools, and systems in partnership with Revenue Operations to improve rep effectiveness and deal velocity.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to strengthen the commercial operating rhythm, including SKOs, training cadences, and feedback loops.
  • Analyse funnel performance and sales data to surface gaps, inform enablement priorities, and guide coaching efforts.

Who You Are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement or Sales, or a related field, ideally in the Fintech field
  • Proven track record of collaborating with commercial leaders and driving impactful enablement programs.
  • Experience designing and delivering sales training, onboarding, and enablement content for commercial teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and in‑person communication skills, with strong cross‑functional management abilities.
  • Highly organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.
  • Self‑starter mentality with a high degree of motivation to understand root causes and deliver success.
  • High attention to detail and a “do what it takes” attitude to own and execute high‑quality outcomes.
  • Experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and familiarity with sales tools (e.g., Chorus, Outreach).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Scale‑up or fintech experience.
  • Experience working with US Enterprise Sales Teams
  • Familiarity with sales enablement platforms (e.g., Highspot, Gong, LMS).
  • Experience with data‑driven enablement program measurement and iteration.

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Equal opportunity

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. 0633e2689518005af28321b7c446392b.snippet:

We are looking for a Revenue Operations (RevOps) Senior Analyst to join our team and play a pivotal role in optimizing our revenue processes. This role sits at the intersection of sales, marketing, and customer success, ensuring seamless lead management, CRM efficiency, and data driven decision-making. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, process-driven, and eager to contribute to RISE programs' growth by improving operational efficiency.

  • For Senior Analyst: Lead process transformation initiatives and drive continuous improvement.

  • Define and track KPIs across sales and marketing teams.
  • Support strategic planning by analyzing market trends and competitor benchmarks.

6. Event Management Support

  • Assist with event logistics and coordination for in-person and virtual outreach events, incl. collaborating with marketing team for EDM creation
  • Liaise with trainers and speakers to ensure content is well-curated and delivered effectively.

  • Work closely with sales and marketing to maximize lead generation from events.

Who You Are:

  • 6-9 years of experience with a proven track record in revenue process optimization and strategic planning.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in HubSpot or other CRM tools.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (Excel, Tableau).

ba1cffe571259c5da159b2ce68288f60.title: Director of Revenue Operations
ba1cffe571259c5da159b2ce68288f60.snippet:
We're representing a fast-scaling B2B technology company whose sales team keeps hitting number, and whose leadership has finally admitted why: the engine behind them.

Now they want that engine owned properly. Reporting into the APAC CRO, this is for the person who builds the playbooks, the deal desks, the data and the training that quota-carriers get celebrated for and who's ready for a seat where that work is finally measured, funded, and named.

What You'd Own

  • Build and run the revenue operations backbone — pipeline hygiene, forecasting the CRO actually trusts, deal-desk rigour
  • Own sales enablement end to end: onboarding, playbooks, and the negotiation and objection-handling training that moves win rates
  • Design the commission and territory models that stop the quarterly arguments before they start
  • Turn revenue data into decisions — win/loss analysis, funnel conversion, pricing discipline
  • Select and run the revenue tech stack (CRM, enablement tools, conversation intelligence) without drowning the team in tools
  • Be the bridge between Sales, Marketing and Finance — the one person all three trust with the number

What You'll Bring

  • 5–10 years across sales operations, revenue operations, or enablement — with at least one function you built rather than inherited
  • Fluency in CRM administration and revenue analytics (Salesforce or HubSpot to admin level; strong Excel/BI)
  • Experience designing or delivering sales training — negotiation, discovery, or deal coaching — with win-rate evidence
  • Commercial credibility: you've carried a bag, supported those who do, or sat close enough to know the difference
  • The composure to tell a VP of Sales their forecast is fiction — with the data to survive the conversation
  • A growth mindset with new technology — you learn the tools before you're told to, and you're honest about what you don't know yet
  • The ability to give feedback that lands and receive it without armour
  • Stakeholder management across functions — you keep the right people close, informed, and on side
  • Communication skills that hold up with senior leaders — clear, concise, and credible in the rooms where decisions get made

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You've watched reps win President's Club on decks and processes you built — and you're done being the footnote
  • You believe revenue is a system, not a heroic act
  • You want your impact measured in win rates and forecast accuracy, not thank-yous

Compensation: S$8,000–11,000/month + bonus.

Data Privacy & Consent

The Talent Lever collects, uses, and discloses the personal data you submit with your application in accordance with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA). Your data will be used to assess your suitability for this role and for related recruitment purposes, will be shared with our client only with your prior knowledge, and will be retained for up to 24 months unless you request earlier deletion. You may withdraw consent, or request access to or correction of your personal data, at any time.

By applying, you also consent to receive communications from The Talent Lever about job opportunities and career development resources that may suit your profile. You can opt out at any time.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. Most people won't put themselves forward unless they meet every line, we'd rather you did. We know our clients well. If you're close, we'll champion you and advise them accordingly.

8d66fb016764089fb448a435dc511901.title: Revenue Operations Team Lead
8d66fb016764089fb448a435dc511901.snippet:
Crown Worldwide Group is a privately owned, global logistics company founded in 1965 and headquartered in Hong Kong. We are an extraordinary and purposeful business committed to making it simpler to live, work and do business anywhere in the world, delivered through our broad portfolio of complementary brands. Together these enable us to; relocate people’s lives and possessions, help companies move teams to new locations near and far and help them manage their workspaces. We also transport, store and install precious art collections and keep company data and records safe, yet accessible.


We oversee a wide-ranging CSR program which supports local and global charities, actively champions employee wellbeing and continually seeks to reduce our environmental footprint. We are also proud of our diverse and inclusive culture. This provides all our employees with a sense of belonging which allows them to reach their full potential.


Discover Crown. www.crownworldwide.com


About Crown Information Management

As part of the global Crown Worldwide Group, Crown Information Management is at the forefront of helping organizations securely manage, access, and leverage their data. We are currently undergoing an exciting period of transformation—driving the market shift from traditional physical carton storage to comprehensive media and file management, Enterprise Content Management (ECM), and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).


The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic, highly analytical Revenue Operations Team Lead to guide our operations team and optimize our end-to-end Lead-to-Cash (L2C) lifecycle. Reporting directly to the Business Unit Head, you will act as the crucial bridge connecting our Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Finance functions while mentoring a dedicated team of operational staff.

This is a highly visible leadership position focused on top-of-funnel conversion, revenue protection, commercial compliance, and process innovation. You will oversee seamless lead routing, ensure our sales pipeline is accurately forecasted, empower your team to enforce strict commercial policies, and guarantee that closed deals transition flawlessly into our billing systems.


What You Will Do

Team Leadership & Lead-to-Cash Governance

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Revenue Operations team, setting the standard for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Oversee top-of-funnel operations, including lead tracking, routing, and conversion metrics, ensuring a frictionless handoff from marketing to the local sales team.
  • Drive CRM data hygiene and govern the pipeline from initial inquiry to closed-won, ensuring accurate stage logging for both recurring services and complex implementation projects.
  • Analyze lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, sales cycle lengths, and win/loss ratios to deliver highly accurate quarterly revenue forecasts to the executive leadership team.
  • Streamline internal approval workflows to support regional pre-sales and technical teams on high-value, multi-site enterprise bids.


Deal Desk & Commercial Compliance

  • Act as the primary commercial gatekeeper, structurally enforcing our risk mitigation policies and empowering your team to oversee deal compliance before reaching "Closed Won."
  • Ensure all new Document Management Storage/Services (DMS) contracts mandate a warehouseman’s lien and a right of disposal clause for accounts in default for over three months.
  • Enforce payment security protocols, ensuring that all private clients and startup organizations commit to mandatory one-year prepayments.
  • Partner with senior sales leadership to structure complex, multi-year commercial agreements that protect required margins.


Billing Alignment & Process Automation

  • Oversee the seamless translation of finalized contract parameters, project milestones, and billing schedules from the CRM to the finance and accounting teams.
  • Audit closed opportunities against the billing ledger to prevent revenue leakage on upfront implementation fees, license costs, and scheduled service escalations.
  • Drive our internal tech evolution by identifying bottlenecks across the entire Lead-to-Cash cycle and scoping repetitive data-entry tasks for our Robotic Process Automation (RPA) initiatives (e.g., UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate).


What You Bring to the Team

  • 5 to 8 years of proven experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Finance, coupled with a strong track record of people management and team leadership.
  • Deep expertise managing the complete Lead-to-Cash (L2C) process—from top-of-funnel lead management to downstream CRM and billing administration.
  • Exceptional commercial acumen with the confidence and authority to hold sales representatives accountable to strict contracting standards.
  • A process-driven mindset with experience or a strong interest in process automation (RPA) and tech stack optimization.
  • A background in Records Management, BPO, Enterprise Content Management (ECM), tech solutions, or the wider information management industry is highly advantageous.


If all above mentioned sounds interesting and motivating for you (and you have a suitable profile) we are looking forward to receiving your updated CV and discussing your career!


Company Values

At Crown we pride ourselves with the quality we deliver and values we stand by.


  • We are CARING about people and their experience
  • Always DETERMINED to do our best and to always keep improving
  • We are genuinely THERE when our customers and colleagues need us
  • We encourage the SHARING of knowledge amongst each other
  • We continuously remain OPEN-MINDED to stay innovative


Equal Employment Opportunity

Crown is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, gender orientation, gender identity, military/veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Crown welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates eligible to live and work in the designated geographical region. We are committed to diversity, and to employee well-being, engagement and development.


NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

3296542a4168c9535a8b4b5b297766fb.title: Chief Marketing Officer
3296542a4168c9535a8b4b5b297766fb.snippet:
Company:


Our client is a high-growth fintech and consumer technology business with an established presence across Singapore and Hong Kong.


The business is entering an important new phase of growth as the way consumers discover, evaluate and engage with financial products changes rapidly. AI is reshaping search and discovery, traditional acquisition channels are becoming more challenging, and new opportunities are emerging across social, content, partnerships, communities and AI-enabled marketing.


This is an opportunity to join a business that is actively embracing this shift and is prepared to rethink how marketing operates from first principles.


The Role:


We are looking for a Chief Marketing Officer to lead the full marketing function and define the next generation of the company's growth playbook.


Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead across performance, organic, social, content, retention, design and brand, as well as owning the company's rewards and loyalty P&L.

This is not a traditional corporate CMO role.


We are looking for a hands-on builder and operator who is comfortable moving between strategy and execution, challenging established assumptions and creating new approaches where the playbook doesn't yet exist.


Key responsibilities include:


  • Develop and execute a new marketing and growth strategy for the AI era, moving beyond traditional acquisition models.
  • Reimagine organic acquisition as search evolves from traditional SERPs towards AI-mediated discovery and new digital surfaces.
  • Build social and content into scalable acquisition and engagement channels.
  • Drive greater efficiency and effectiveness across paid performance marketing, with a strong focus on data, unit economics and commercial outcomes.
  • Develop retention and engagement strategies that increase customer lifetime value and improve the economics of acquisition.
  • Lead brand, content and design while ensuring these functions remain closely connected to measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Identify, test and scale new growth channels including partnerships, communities, distribution and emerging platforms.
  • Own the rewards and loyalty proposition and P&L, using it to strengthen customer engagement and commercial performance.
  • Build AI-native workflows across marketing, using AI to automate, accelerate and fundamentally rethink how the team operates.
  • Build and develop a high-performing marketing organisation capable of operating with greater speed, leverage and experimentation.


The opportunity is to define what modern marketing looks like, rather than simply optimise the existing model.


Requirements:


We are looking for a commercially minded marketing leader who can demonstrate that they are already operating effectively in this new environment.


You should bring:


  • Significant senior marketing leadership experience across multiple disciplines, ideally within fintech, marketplaces, consumer technology, e-commerce or a similarly fast-moving environment.
  • A proven track record across a broad marketing mix rather than deep experience in only one discipline.
  • Demonstrable experience of building and scaling growth channels, particularly organic and social, from relatively early stages.
  • Evidence of how you have already used AI to change the way marketing works — including workflows, automation, content, acquisition, analysis or team productivity.
  • The ability to demonstrate what you have actually built, implemented and delivered using AI, rather than simply having an interest in emerging technology.
  • A first-principles approach to marketing, with the ability to question established assumptions and develop new playbooks.
  • Strong commercial and analytical capability, with a clear understanding of CAC, retention, contribution margins, channel economics and customer lifetime value.
  • A hands-on mindset. You should be comfortable getting into the detail with your team rather than operating purely at a strategic or board level.
  • Strong understanding of the changing search and discovery landscape, including AI-mediated search and emerging acquisition channels.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary marketing teams.
  • Strong understanding of consumer behaviour in Singapore and Hong Kong.
  • The curiosity, pace and adaptability to thrive in a high-growth environment where the answers aren't always obvious.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is energised by building what doesn't yet have a playbook.


If you have already demonstrated how you are adapting marketing for the AI era, and want the mandate to take that thinking much further. This is an opportunity to shape the future of marketing within a high-growth fintech.

4f5131e4b98815e76bcb7d5de38eda6f.title: Chief Executive Officer – Semiconductor / Advanced Electronics
4f5131e4b98815e76bcb7d5de38eda6f.snippet:
Our client is an established Singapore-headquartered organisation with significant operations and business interests across Asia.


As part of its next phase of growth and transformation, the company is seeking an accomplished senior executive to assume the role of Chief Executive Officer.


Reporting to the Board, the CEO will provide strategic and operational leadership for the organisation, with overall responsibility for business performance, sustainable growth and the continued development of the organisation across its key Asian markets.


The successful candidate will be a commercially astute and strategically minded leader with substantial experience in the semiconductor, advanced electronics or closely related manufacturing sector, together with meaningful experience operating and developing businesses in China and the wider Asian market.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide overall strategic leadership and direction for the organisation, working closely with the Board to define and execute its long-term strategy.
  • Assume overall accountability for business performance, including P&L, revenue growth, profitability and sustainable value creation.
  • Lead and develop the senior management team across commercial, operations, technology, engineering, supply chain, finance and corporate functions.
  • Identify and execute growth opportunities across new and existing customers, markets, products and strategic partnerships.
  • Strengthen the organisation's competitive positioning and relationships with key customers and business partners.
  • Drive operational excellence while ensuring alignment between commercial, technology and manufacturing strategies.
  • Provide leadership across China and other key Asian markets and develop strong relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders.
  • Evaluate industry, market and technology developments and translate them into actionable strategic priorities.
  • Drive organisational development, leadership capability and succession planning to support future growth.
  • Maintain effective engagement with the Board and key stakeholders on business performance, strategic initiatives, opportunities and risks.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Substantial senior leadership experience within the semiconductor, advanced electronics, electronics manufacturing or closely related technology/manufacturing sector.
  • Proven general management and P&L leadership experience with responsibility across multiple business functions.
  • Strong strategic and commercial capabilities, supported by a sound understanding of technology, manufacturing and operations.
  • Meaningful hands-on experience managing, operating or developing businesses in China.
  • Strong understanding of the China business environment, customers and stakeholder landscape.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering profitable growth, business transformation and/or organisational development.
  • Experience managing businesses and multicultural teams across Asia.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Experience within a listed-company environment would be advantageous.
  • Experience working within an entrepreneurial or Asian-origin organisation would be advantageous.
  • Willingness to be based in Singapore and travel regularly within Asia, particularly China.



We regret that only short-listed candidates will be contacted shortly.

eaa66bbd08783c2e3b28082a079c5bfb.title: Assistant Vice President/Vice President, Attractions & Destination Experience Revenue Operations
eaa66bbd08783c2e3b28082a079c5bfb.snippet:
Job Summary

The Assistant Vice President/Vice President, Attractions & Destination Experience Revenue Operations, is a senior leadership role responsible for maximising revenue, profitability, and guest experience across all non-ticket revenue streams. This includes end-to-end oversight of Merchandising Planning, Merchandising Operations, Visual Merchandising, Food & Beverage Operations and Culinary Operations. This role drives integrated commercial strategies, operational excellence, and innovation to deliver a cohesive, high-quality destination experience aligned with brand positioning and guest expectations.


Job Responsibilities


Merchandising Strategy & Operations:

  • Oversee end-to-end merchandising, including product development and curation, category management, pricing and promotional strategies.
  • Lead Merchandising Planning, including demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, and assortment strategy across locations and channels.
  • Drive operational excellence in Merchandising Operations, with a focus on supply chain coordination, inventory control and replenishment, vendor management and sourcing.
  • Ensure alignment with brand storytelling and IP where applicable.


Visual Merchandising & Guest Experience:

  • Define and execute visual merchandising standards that enhance storytelling and maximise conversion.
  • Ensure consistent thematic execution across retail and F&B touchpoints.
  • Leverage on store design, layout optimisation, and in-store experiences to increase dwell time and guest engagement.


Food & Beverage (F&B) Operations:

  • Lead all F&B operations, including restaurants (quick service and full service), kiosks, carts, outlets, and event and catering operations.
  • Drive operational efficiency through cost control (COGS, labour optimisation), productivity improvements, and standardisation of processes and systems.

99b3403fa235f0f25eaac1d9d64d6e56.title: Chief Marketing Officer
99b3403fa235f0f25eaac1d9d64d6e56.snippet:
MoneySmart is Southeast Asia's leading personal finance platform, helping consumers across Singapore and Hong Kong find the right financial products and make smarter decisions with their money. We're at an inflection point: moving from a comparison platform to a genuinely personalised financial companion, and marketing is the engine that gets us there.

Mission

This is one of the most consequential roles in the company. You'll own the full marketing function (performance, organic, social, content, retention, design and brand) and your mandate is to make MoneySmart a household name that people actively choose, not just land on. That means driving efficient customer acquisition, building retention and engagement that compounds over time, and growing a value proposition that speaks more clearly to the people we're trying to serve.

You'll be walking into real challenges. SEO traffic is under pressure. Our messaging needs sharpening. Retention hasn't been built to its potential. If you're looking for a role where the engine is already running smoothly, this isn't it. If you're the kind of person who finds that description energising, read on.

You'll report directly to the CEO and lead a team across performance, organic, brand, content, social, retention, and design. You will also own the rewards and loyalty program and P&L.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy to dominate GEO for personal finance search terms and maximise organic demand generation as a channel
  • Turn social into a genuine, scalable demand engine
  • Build a retention and engagement programme that makes CAC a compounding advantage over time, not a fixed cost
  • Drive paid marketing efficiency: better signals, better targeting, better unit economics
  • Develop and execute a brand marketing strategy that materially moves awareness and preference among the right audience
  • Identify and prove out alternative channels (partnerships, communities, distribution) that others haven't fully explored
  • Ownership of the SmartRewards platform and P&L to support business objectives
  • Build AI-native workflows across every marketing discipline so the team produces more, faster, without growing headcount

Requirements

  • You're already using AI to automate and accelerate your marketing work, not experimenting with it. You can show us the workflows you've built and what they replaced
  • You stay current on where AI and marketing channels are moving, and you've changed how you work because of what you've learned, not just added it to your reading list
  • You're not afraid to get into the details. With AI, there's no such thing as a leader who only sets direction and lets the team handle execution. You're expected to be in the details with the team, not just above it
  • You're numbers-driven in the way that matters: you know your CAC, your retention curves, your channel contribution margins, and you make decisions from that, not from intuition alone
  • You've built and proven organic and social channels from early stages. You know what momentum looks like and how to create it, not just scale it
  • You've run retention programmes that actually moved the needle on LTV, not just email open rates
  • You're a strong enough operator to move fast across multiple disciplines simultaneously. And humble enough to know when to go deep versus when to delegate
  • You've worked with or led creative and brand work, and you have a point of view on what good looks like, even if you're not the one executing it
  • You get things done through people, not just process. Your team follows you because they're learning from you, not just because of your title
  • You ideally have experience with marketplace businesses and understand the consumer financial landscape in Singapore

Why this role

  • We're investing aggressively in AI across the whole business. You'll have access to cutting-edge tools and work and learn alongside other leaders who are actively pushing the boundaries of what's possible, not talking about doing it. When you look under the hood, you'll see that our capabilities in AI are genuinely ahead of the curve compared to other established companies
  • Insurance is a massive, fragmented, underserved market in Southeast Asia. As we focus in this space, the marketing opportunity is genuinely wide open. This is a category that hasn't been cracked yet
  • You'll own the full marketing function with real CEO-level visibility and support. The wins and the lessons will both be yours
  • You'll be part of the Executive Committee that leads the business, not just the department
  • The problems are real and unsolved. That means what you figure out here will actually matter, to the business and to what you're capable of next

MoneySmart Culture Values & Tenets

The traits we admire are core intrinsic qualities we look for in someone we want on our team, and we look for people who are Hungry, Humble and Smart. We also expect all our people to uphold the following company values:

  • Play to win as a team
  • Solve for the customer
  • Embrace a personal growth mindset
  • Step up and own it
  • Challenge the status quo and deliver outcomes

MoneySmart Group is an equal opportunity employer. Please include only relevant details and avoid unnecessary information (e.g., photos, age) in your job application to assist us in ensuring that the interview process is devoid of bias.

80a0ad828e593f148e2da09fa1b60a57.title: Sales Enablement & Operations Lead
80a0ad828e593f148e2da09fa1b60a57.snippet:
We are looking for an execution-driven Sales Enablement & Operations Lead to design, run, and scale the revenue engine powering our high-growth sales organization. This position offers location flexibility across Mainland China, Hong Kong, or Singapore, acting as the primary orchestrator across lead distribution, funnel mechanics, compensation architecture, and field enablement.


If you thrive in high-velocity, tech-driven environments (e.g., tech-heavy field sales, fintech, or cross-border payment platforms), know how to manage pipeline rigor down to the transaction level, and take pride in converting messy front-line friction into standardized SOPs and repeatable growth—this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Routing & CRM Funnel Architecture

  • Dynamic Lead Allocation: Architect and enforce fair, data-driven lead routing rules to distribute inbound/outbound prospects to the right regional teams and reps.
  • Full-Lifecycle Funnel Monitoring: Track end-to-end conversion health from initial lead contact through to KYC completion, first-transaction activation, and long-term retention—identifying drop-off bottlenecks in real time.
  • Pipeline Hygiene & Conflict Resolution: Establish strict anti-clash rules and automatic "open pool" (public sea) re-allocation policies for inactive leads to maximize team coverage.


2. Revenue Analytics & Compensation Strategy

  • Quota Cascading: Partner directly with revenue leadership to break down overall ARR and transaction volume targets into regional, team, and individual rep targets.
  • Commission Architecture & Payroll Execution: Own end-to-end commission modeling, monthly payout calculations, and dispute resolution across multi-tiered pricing, transaction volumes, and incentive policies.


3. Field Enablement & Sales Playbooks

  • Sales Collateral & Battlecards: Build high-converting field toolkits, competitive displacement battlecards, and objection-handling guides.
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Translate compliance, product, and legal mandates into streamlined, field-ready execution manuals to reduce deal friction.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, or Revenue Operations within high-growth tech or fintech platforms.
  • Deep CRM & Funnel Mastery: Demonstrated experience managing lead-routing logic, public pool rules, and full-funnel conversion tracking.
  • Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Proven ability to manage multi-tiered compensation systems, volume-based incentive structures, and operational data tracking without error.
  • Execution & Enablement Mindset: Ability to partner closely with front-line sales reps to build practical playbooks, battlecards, and training materials that drive immediate revenue impact.


About OSL

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

08b781bd3fd340b9996af27e94b5a6d0.title: Enterprise Sales Director (AI)
08b781bd3fd340b9996af27e94b5a6d0.snippet:
We're representing an AI platform company scaling fast across APAC from its Singapore hub — real product, referenceable enterprise logos, and a pipeline problem that's a good problem: more serious buyer conversations than sellers who can hold them.


This is enterprise AI sales as it actually is in 2026 — long cycles, C-suite buyers who are equal parts excited and skeptical, procurement teams asking about governance — and it needs a seller who can carry a technical, consultative, board-level sale, not a feature demo.


What You'd Own

  • Own a named-account patch of large enterprises across SEA — full cycle, from first conversation to signed multi-year deal
  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder sales: CIO, CDO, risk, procurement, and the business sponsor who actually feels the pain
  • Build the business case with the customer — value modelling, pilot design, and expansion paths that survive the CFO
  • Navigate AI-specific buying friction: data governance, model risk, regulatory posture — credibly, not defensively
  • Partner solutions engineering and customer success so what you sell is what gets delivered
  • Forecast honestly and carry the number — S$2–3M+ annual quota with commensurate upside


What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with at least 3 selling data, cloud, SaaS or AI/ML into large organisations
  • A record of closing six-to-seven-figure deals in long, multi-stakeholder cycles — with the numbers to show
  • Fluency in the AI conversation at the executive level — use cases, limitations, governance — without bluffing
  • Regional experience across SEA enterprise buyers; financial services or regulated-industry sales a strong plus
  • Consultative craft: discovery that earns trust, negotiation that protects value, and the patience for the real cycle
  • A growth mindset with new technology — you learn the tools before you're told to, and you're honest about what you don't know yet
  • The ability to give feedback that lands and receive it without armour
  • Stakeholder management across functions — you keep the right people close, informed, and on side
  • Communication skills that hold up with senior leaders — clear, concise, and credible in the rooms where decisions get made


You'll Thrive Here If

  • You'd rather sell something genuinely hard and genuinely valuable than something easy and forgettable
  • You treat the customer's skepticism about AI as the start of the sale, not an obstacle to it
  • You want a market at its inflection point — and a number worth carrying


Data Privacy & Consent

The Talent Lever collects, uses, and discloses the personal data you submit with your application in accordance with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA). Your data will be used to assess your suitability for this role and for related recruitment purposes, will be shared with our client only with your prior knowledge, and will be retained for up to 24 months unless you request earlier deletion. You may withdraw consent, or request access to or correction of your personal data at any time.


By applying, you also consent to receive communications from The Talent Lever about job opportunities and career development resources that may suit your profile. You can opt out at any time.


Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. Most people won't put themselves forward unless they meet every line, we'd rather you did. We know our clients well. If you're close, we'll champion you and advise them accordingly.

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished Director of Process Integration provides strategic and technical leadership for new product introduction (NPI), technology transfers, and yield optimization initiatives. This role is accountable for driving manufacturing excellence, ensuring process robustness, and aligning cross-functional teams to achieve business, quality, and customer objectives.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership


  • Lead and oversee end-to-end new product qualification and technology transfers from mother fab to volume manufacturing.
  • Define and execute process integration roadmap aligned with corporate technology strategy and business goals.
  • Establish long-term yield improvement strategies and process capability enhancement plans.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen process stability, scalability, and reliability.


Technical & Operational Excellence

  • Provide executive oversight on complex data analytics to identify systemic process design weaknesses and manufacturing tool performance gaps.
  • Champion advanced DOE methodologies and data-driven decision-making frameworks.
  • Oversee silicon process flow optimization, design rule changes, and layout integration impacts with full reliability consideration (short- and long-term).
  • Ensure world-class yield performance, electrical test robustness, and product reliability across technology nodes.
  • Lead resolution of critical yield excursions, high-impact manufacturing issues, and customer escalations.


Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration


  • Partner with Technology Development, Manufacturing, Yield Engineering, Quality, and Customer Engineering teams to ensure seamless product ramp.
  • Serve as the key executive interface with mother fab during technology transfers.
  • Strengthen collaboration across geographically dispersed teams and foster alignment on KPIs and deliverables.
  • Build strong customer confidence through technical credibility and operational excellence.


Organizational & Talent Leadership


  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing process integration teams.
  • Establish succession planning, capability development frameworks, and technical leadership pipelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, resilience, and continuous learning.
  • Drive performance management and operational discipline across the department.


Qualifications & Core Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related STEM field (Master’s or PhD preferred).
  • 12–15+ years of semiconductor industry experience with:
  • Extensive background in silicon process integration
  • Successful leadership of technology transfers and NPI programs
  • Proven track record in yield ramp and manufacturing scale-up
  • Strong exposure to reliability engineering and electrical test optimization
  • Prior experience leading multi-disciplinary teams in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Influential communicator with executive presence.
  • Decisive leader capable of operating under ambiguity and high-pressure environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management across global and cross-functional teams.

b83b00b3f8245b8b814422e69fa7d931.title: Senior Executive (Communications) ,SingHealth Office of Regional Health (Contract)
b83b00b3f8245b8b814422e69fa7d931.snippet:
Join SingHealth's Office of Regional Health and play a vital role in advancing Singapore's largest public healthcare cluster's mission to help communities "Keep Well, Get Well, and Live Well". You will be part of a dynamic team that collaborates across the care continuum to promote health, prevent disease, and improve quality of life through strategic communications that reach diverse stakeholders.


We are seeking a Senior Executive to serve as the Communications Point-of-Contact for our Regional Health System. You will support integrated communications campaigns that showcase our programmes across Health Promotion and Disease Prevention, Primary Care, Continuing Community Care, Community Nursing, Community Engagement, and Population Health Research, working across mainstream media, digital platforms, publications, and marketing materials.


What You Will Do:

You will support planning and execution of effective communications for Regional Health System programmes, proposing strategic messages and positioning aligned with corporate objectives whilst developing integrated communications campaigns and publicity plans. Your role involves preparing media materials including corporate social media posts, media releases, anticipated FAQs, soundbites and quotes in consultation with relevant stakeholders, establishing and maintaining a media tracking database to record Regional Health System media coverage, and organising publicity events whilst providing counsel on event management and protocol management. You will manage and maintain the Regional Health System corporate website, working with stakeholders and vendors to ensure smooth transition to the revamped website, and propose ideas to ensure correct messaging of Regional Health System content on SingHealth corporate websites and digital platforms whilst managing production of communications materials that effectively convey key messages.


Your responsibilities include proactively engaging internal stakeholders to seek profiling opportunities and helping them meet strategic objectives through sound communication ideas and activities, providing support and internal messaging for staff engagement activities as needed. You will support leadership communications by organising staff engagement sessions and town halls across the three Regional Health System sites, developing key messages for engagement sessions and speeches, staffing senior management during speaking engagements and media interviews, supporting leaders by drafting social media posts for sharing thought leadership on population health, and acting as gatekeeper to help oversee leaders' social media accounts including LinkedIn whilst monitoring social media trends and proposing relevant updates.

Additionally, you will ensure SingHealth Regional Health System branding is strong and consistent across operating sites by working with stakeholders to develop branding kits and providing counsel to programme teams on brand application.


Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in mass communications or a related field
  • At least 2 years' relevant working experience in communications, preferably in healthcare or community care, with proven track record in communications-related work
  • Proficient in English (spoken and written) with natural flair in writing and able to converse and write in a second language
  • Good grasp of communication tools and trends including broadcast, print, digital and social media
  • Possess good presentation skills
  • Proficient in Canva
  • Knowledge in HTML, graphics design and video software would be an added advantage
  • Able to work in dynamic and fast-paced environment whilst being self-motivated, able to multi-task and willing to learn
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, open to feedback and ready to embrace changes, with creative and resourceful team player qualities
  • Proactive and able to manage multiple stakeholders and projects concurrently whilst being resourceful and able to work independently
  • May be required tocheryl.lim.w.c@singhealth.com.sg support events during weekends
