25a9261c9e7a0d1e3fed7141ae339c27.title: Regional Customer Insights Manager
25a9261c9e7a0d1e3fed7141ae339c27.snippet:
About the Company

Club 21, part of COMO Group is a leading international fashion retail company headquartered in Singapore, renowned for curating a portfolio of luxury and contemporary fashion brands across a multi-brand retail platform, alongside the operation of mono-brand luxury boutiques on behalf of globally recognised houses. Operating across multiple markets in Asia, Club 21 combines a deep heritage in fashion curation with an evolving, customer-centric retail model.


Job Summary

The Regional Customer Insights Manager turns customer, sales and marketing data into clear, actionable insights that support commercial and marketing decisions across Club21 regionally. The role owns performance reporting and analytics across customer behaviour, sales and marketing effectiveness — helping stakeholders understand what is happening, why, and where the opportunities for growth lie.


Working closely with Marketing, CRM, Digital, E-commerce, Retail Operations, Merchandising and other teams, the role builds dashboards, analytical frameworks and executive-ready reporting to help stakeholders monitor performance, spot trends and opportunities, and make more informed decisions.


Beyond data collation and reporting, the role is expected to provide clear interpretation, recommendations and data-led narratives that shape marketing strategy, customer engagement and business performance.


Job Responsibilities

Customer & Commercial Insights

  • Analyse customer, transactional and behavioural data to identify trends, opportunities and changes in customer behaviour.
  • Help the wider Club21 team develop a deeper understanding of Club21 customers across acquisition, retention, frequency, cross-brand shopping, customer value and lifecycle.
  • Identify customer segments and behavioural patterns that can inform CRM, clienteling, marketing and commercial strategies.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for Marketing, Retail and other internal teams.
  • Analyse performance across brands, stores, customer segments and channels to identify underlying drivers of growth or decline.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis to address emerging customer and commercial questions and identify new business opportunities.


Business Performance Reporting

  • Develop and manage recurring performance reporting across key business and marketing metrics.
  • Build and maintain dashboards that provide clear visibility of overall performance, including relevant store, brand, channel and customer-level views.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, risks and opportunities, providing clear interpretation rather than reporting data in isolation.
  • Translate complex datasets into concise, executive-ready summaries, visualisations and business narratives.
  • Continuously improve reporting processes and dashboards to make business information more accessible, timely and actionable.


CRM & Customer Growth Analytics

  • Provide the customer insights required to support segmentation, lifecycle and engagement strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer retention, purchase frequency, cross-brand engagement and customer lifetime value.
  • Analyse CRM and clienteling activity to understand customer response and identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Support the development of customer targeting and personalisation by identifying meaningful behavioural and value-based customer segments.
  • Work with Retail teams to translate customer insights into relevant VIP and clienteling opportunities.
  • Track the performance of customer initiatives and provide recommendations for future activity.



Job Requirements

  • Diploma/Bachelor related to Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.
  • 4 – 5 years experience in a consumer insights or data-driven marketing role, experience in Retail/Fashion/FMCG/Bank (Loyalty programme) or related industries would be advantageous
  • Strong analytical capability with experience working with large and varied datasets to identify trends, diagnose performance drivers and generate actionable insights.
  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards, reports and data visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Strong understanding of customer, CRM and marketing performance metrics.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches, metrics and reporting requirements.
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex analysis through concise presentations, visualisations and executive-ready summaries.
  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency and quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins


Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.


Through NEXUS™, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.


Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.


About the Role


The International Sales Representative role at WIN SOURCE is designed for sales professionals who want to build a long-term career in global B2B business development and electronic component supply chain solutions.


In this role, you will focus on customer development, RFQ and quotation support, opportunity follow-up and customer communication, while helping customers address component availability, lead-time pressure, lifecycle transitions and other supply chain challenges. This position goes beyond selling products; it helps you learn how to understand customer procurement and supply chain needs, and create value through WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing and supply capabilities.


Working closely with WIN SOURCE’s sales, sourcing, logistics and quality teams, you will gradually build practical experience in international customer development, electronic component markets and supply continuity solutions.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing customers across assigned markets.
  • Identify potential business opportunities through market research, customer development, industry platforms and consistent follow-up.
  • Support the complete sales process, including customer communication, RFQ handling, quotation preparation, order follow-up and delivery coordination.
  • Collaborate with internal sourcing, logistics and quality teams to help customers address shortages, lifecycle transitions, EOL risks, lead-time pressure and cost challenges.
  • Maintain accurate customer information, opportunity updates, quotation records and CRM data to support long-term customer development.
  • Continuously build product knowledge, market awareness and customer communication skills to strengthen sales capability in the electronic components industry.
  • Support customer meetings, marketing activities and international exhibitions as needed.


Why Join WIN SOURCE


At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond individual transactions. You will have the opportunity to:


  • Build or accelerate your international sales career at the center of the global electronic component supply chain.
  • Learn how manufacturing companies approach procurement and sourcing decisions, and how real supply chain challenges are solved beyond transactional sales.
  • Gain exposure to advanced electronics markets such as industrial, automotive, medical, AI infrastructure and other fast-growing sectors.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing network, market expertise and cross-functional team support to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Follow a clear career path from sales execution into account management, regional market development and broader commercial management roles.


What We Are Looking For


  • 1-2 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.


Benefits & Career Growth


At WIN SOURCE, we support people who are willing to learn, grow and create value in international business.


We offer:


  • Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, giving motivated sales professionals the opportunity to grow their earning potential.
  • Systematic sales training, product knowledge development and hands-on exposure to global electronics markets.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international customers, strategic accounts and experienced internal teams.
  • The opportunity to help solve real customer challenges related to component supply, supply continuity and business growth.
  • Opportunities to participate in international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities as needed.
  • A multicultural and collaborative work environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Representative → Sales Specialist / Sales Supervisor → Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Management


Join WIN SOURCE


Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?


Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

careers@win-source.net

You'll act as strategic advisor and consultant to business leadership, translating business priorities into practical, executable people plans. You'll manage a broad spectrum of people matters - from succession planning and organisational design to performance management and employee relations - with the goal of strengthening organisational capability, engagement, and business performance.   • Lead organisational design, change management, and restructuring initiatives to ensure teams are optimised for agility and scale
  • Analyse workforce trends, employee feedback, and HR metrics to develop insights and recommend data-informed interventions

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to define hiring requirements and ensure a strong pipeline of diverse, qualified candidates
  • Work with Total Rewards to ensure competitive compensation structures and career progression pathways

  • Oversee the annual performance review cycle; guide managers through objective goal-setting, fair appraisals, and structured feedback
  • Coach managers on effective feedback, performance improvement plans, and career development conversations

  • Handle employee information with appropriate confidentiality and professionalism

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4–6 years of HR experience, preferably in a dedicated HRBP or HR generalist role supporting business units
  • Working knowledge of core HR disciplines: employee relations, performance management, talent management, recruitment, and rewards

  • Advisory and influencing skills - able to build credibility and constructively challenge stakeholders

  • Collaborative mindset - you work effectively across the HR team to deliver integrated solutions

Talent Link by e2i is a programme to match candidates to job opportunities offered by e2i’s Industry Partners. Applicable for Singaporeans and Singapore Permanent Residents only.


This job opportunity is from our Industry Partner in the Tech Startup space.


Job Descriptions

  • The geophysical services industry has established ways of working that are only beginning to be challenged by new technology and AI. Our technology changes dramatically what's possible in exploration, which means almost all, except for early adopters, commercial conversations require building a case from first principles.
  • BD here starts before the pitch. It means understanding a client's exploration challenge deeply enough to have a credible first conversation, and knowing what to do with their data once you've earned access to it. You and a small team own the BD function end-to-end, from identifying the right opportunities to signed engagements.

  • Build the commercial thesis from the geology up. Identify prospects through outreach, networks, conferences, and independent analysis of public geological and government exploration data.

Open and advance relationships with exploration companies in mining, new geothermal, oil & gas, geological hydrogen, as well as government agencies for geoscience and defense. Understand their problem, make the case, and earn the right to see their data.
  • Do the analysis. Work through client exploration data independently: characterise the deposit, assess density contrasts, target depth and geometry, signal magnitude, and design the survey logic. Translate findings into clear recommendations for clients and internal alignment alike.
  • Build and deliver proposals. Turn business and geophysical reasoning into proposals and pitch materials that communicate value clearly—to clients in terms relevant to their exploration programme, and to internal team members without requiring them to replicate your analysis.
  • Apply for programs and challenges. Identify relevant industry programs, innovation challenges, and government opportunities. Prepare and pitch.
  • Use GIS tools. Comfort with GIS is expected, or a clear track record of picking up technical tools quickly.

e43f6e78b1d6f401a937b37214766250.snippet:
About DigiFT:

DigiFT is a next-generation exchange for the tokenization, issuance, distribution, and trading of institutional-grade real-world assets (RWAs). Incorporated in Singapore in 2021, DigiFT was built on a single conviction: that institutional investors deserve access to the world's best on-chain financial instruments, through a platform that meets the regulatory standard they require.

Today, DigiFT is the most comprehensively regulated exchange of its kind — licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore as a Recognised Market Operator and Capital Markets Services provider and regulated by the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong for Type 1 (Dealing in Securities) and Type 4 (Advising on Securities) regulated activities. This dual regulatory standing is rare in the digital assets space, and it is foundational to how we operate.

We sit at the intersection of capital markets and blockchain — bringing institutional-grade asset classes on-chain within a fully regulated framework. Our current product suite spans tokenized money market funds, tokenized gold, private credit and pre-IPO equity access, with coverage continuing to expand.

DigiFT operates as a smart contract-based, non-custodial platform, serving accredited and institutional investors across Singapore and Hong Kong.


Role Description:

We’re looking for a driven, results-oriented Partnership Manager to join our fast-moving team. This is a unique opportunity to establish your name in Web3 finance while directly contributing to DigiFT’s revenue growth in Hong Kong and Singapore.

You’ll lead go-to-market strategies, customer acquisition, and partner relationships for DigiFT’s regulated digital asset offerings. The role comes with full ownership of your pipeline and initiatives, supported by marketing, product, and operations functions.

We’re seeking a self-starter with strong B2B sales acumen, the ability to bridge traditional finance and Web3, and a proven track record of converting institutional or accredited leads into revenue. You’ll also represent DigiFT at key events and conferences to build awareness and drive engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage your own pipeline of institutional and accredited clients
  • Contribute to overall sales strategy and business development planning
  • Lead client engagement from first touchpoint through onboarding and account management
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, operations, and compliance
  • Represent DigiFT at industry conferences and networking events
  • Coordinate with ecosystem partners for referrals and joint go-to-market efforts


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in STEM, Finance, Economics or a related technical field
  • 3-5 years of experience in financial services and/or Web3 (buy-side, sell-side, crypto funds, DeFi, CEX, or Web3 payments)
  • Demonstrated ability to drive institutional revenue in crypto or traditional finance
  • Familiarity with client onboarding processes (e.g. KYC/AML, account setup, product integration) is a strong advantage
  • Strong existing network of institutional or professional investors preferred
  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex financial/crypto concepts for a range of stakeholders
  • Comfortable switching between technical and commercial conversations
  • Fluent in English (Additional proficiency in Mandarin would be an advantage)
  • Based in either Singapore or Hong Kong


Why Join DigiFT?

  • Work at the frontier of capital markets and blockchain infrastructure - before it becomes mainstream
  • Direct access to and collaboration with the founding team and CEO
  • A regulated, credible platform - not a speculative project
  • Small team, high ownership: your work is visible and your judgment matters
  • Dual-regulated across Singapore and Hong Kong, which is rare in this space

Senior Business Development Manager (Brands & Retail)

Location: Singapore

Reporting To: Global Lyocell Sales Head (non-China)

Employment Type: Full-time


About Sateri

Sateri is a global leader in man-made cellulose fibre (MMCF), producing renewable fibres used in textiles and hygiene products worldwide. With a production capacity of 2.4 million tonnes across viscose and lyocell, the company operates across the fibre value chain, supported by a global commercial network spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

Sustainability is central to Sateri's operations, with a strong focus on responsible sourcing, environmental stewardship, and safe manufacturing practices. Through innovation and collaboration, Sateri is committed to advancing sustainable fibre solutions and supporting a more responsible global textile ecosystem.

More details at: https://www.sateri.com


The Opportunity

Lyocell is Sateri's premium cellulosic fibre — sustainably produced, high-performing, and increasingly specified by leading brands worldwide. We are now scaling the international commercial presence of Lyocell and looking for a hands-on business builder to lead that effort.

This is a greenfield role. You will be among the first hires in the international team, responsible for opening new brand and retail partnerships and developing the commercial playbook from scratch. Your success will be measured by market penetration — how many accounts specify Lyocell — and the quality of the pipeline you build.

If you thrive on ambiguity, enjoy creating something from nothing, and want to shape a business from the ground up, this is your role.


Key Responsibilities

Market Development & Brand Engagement

  • Identify and pursue new brand and retail partnerships across hospitality, fashion, and consumer goods to drive Lyocell adoption internationally.
  • Develop a structured engagement roadmap for target accounts, tailoring approaches by segment, region, and application.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies that translate early-stage opportunities into measurable commercial outcomes.

Channel Expansion

  • Collaborate with offline and online retail channels to increase penetration and visibility of Lyocell products.
  • Drive end-market pull through brand activation, commercial events, and industry engagements.

Cross-Region Collaboration

  • Partner with Sateri and APR in-country teams to align global brand strategies with local execution — through influence and shared frameworks.
  • Coordinate with China and non-China marketing teams to adapt brand messaging for international markets, maintaining global consistency while ensuring local relevance.


Qualifications & Requirements

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related disciplines; advanced degree preferred.
  • At least 15 years of experience in business development, retail marketing, or brand management across B2B and/or B2C environments.
  • Demonstrated success in building new markets, partnerships, or commercial pipelines from the ground up (0-to-1 track record).
  • Strong understanding of brand engagement within consumer-driven industries (e.g., textiles, fashion, hospitality, retail); textiles or fashion industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience coordinating brand or marketing strategies across multiple markets, including working with regional and headquarters-level teams.
  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders across regions and functions in a matrix or start-up-like environment.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate market insights into actionable roadmaps and repeatable playbooks.
  • Fluency in English and Mandarin at a professional communication level — Mandarin is essential for accessing an extensive body of Chinese-language product research, technical data, and market intelligence that underpins our value proposition.

Character

  • Builder mindset — proactive, persistent, and energised by creating something new. You define what needs to be done rather than waiting for a playbook.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, lean operations, and hands-on execution in a start-up-within-enterprise environment.
  • Collaborative and effective across cultures, with the executive presence to engage senior stakeholders, brand principals, and institutional decision-makers.
  • Willing to travel regularly across Asia and China, including to developing markets.

Good-to-Have

  • Existing network among APAC brand, retail, or hospitality decision-makers.
  • Understanding of textile or consumer-goods value chains.
  • Experience planning or executing commercial events and industry engagements.


Why Join Us

  • Build something from the ground up — shape a new commercial function for a premium sustainable fibre with significant growth headroom. As the business scales, so does your career — within Lyocell and across a diversified group portfolio.
  • Strategy meets action — engage directly with global brands and senior stakeholders to create a new demand channel in an industry ripe for change.
  • Singapore base, global impact — lead the international growth strategy from a regional hub where many target customers' headquarters are located.

About Temus

Temus is a digital transformation company established by Temasek, helping enterprises and public sector agencies across Singapore and beyond bring together strategy, design, data, AI, and cloud. We partner with leading technology and service providers.

About the Role

The Partnership Manager operates Temus’ partnership portfolio with commercial discipline. The role is the single operational point of coordination for partner qualification, activation, records, cadence, programme requirements, funding and claims. It converts validated partner access, referrals, co-funding and capability support into opportunities accepted by named commercial owners and tracks those opportunities through to Finance-validated outcomes.


Responsibilities

Partner portfolio operations

  • Run the operating cadence for approved priority technology and institutional partners; maintain the partner register.
  • Translate approved portfolio priorities into qualification and activation plans. Assess proposed and existing partners against agreed criteria including strategic fit, buyer access, counterpart commitment, delivery readiness, economics, differentiation and evidence.
  • Prepare evidence-based recommendations to activate, remediate, downgrade or exit a relationship; implement the decision once approved and record the rationale.

Opportunity activation, handoff and attribution

  • Coordinate approved co-selling motions, joint propositions, account mapping, seller-to-seller pairings, deal registration, partner campaigns and follow-up actions with named Commercial, Capability and partner owners.
  • For every partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunity, record the source, the partner’s specific contribution, the target buyer, the named Temus commercial owner, the next buyer action and the acceptance, redirection or rejection decision.
  • Maintain / escalate stage gates and exit criteria from partner activation through commercial handoff.
  • Prepare opportunity attribution and partner-economics records for Finance validation. Track progression, realised revenue, gross profit and margin after validation without displacing the accountable commercial owner.

MOU and co-innovation programme execution

  • Convert approved MOUs and co-innovation arrangements into implementation plans with named owners, milestones, dependencies, governance dates, target outcomes, and escalation points.
  • Maintain working-level relationships and programme cadence with partner counterparts, and support executive sponsors in priority engagements. Track whether each arrangement produces qualified access, referrals, co-funding, capability support, programmes or accepted commercial opportunities.

Funding, incentives and grant operations

  • Identify eligible partner incentives, market-development funds, co-funding and relevant government grant routes for ready client, capability or workforce propositions. Coordinate internal approvals, applications, evidence, submissions, queries, claims and reconciliation through to realised value.
  • Maintain / escalate an auditable funding and claims log covering eligibility, deadlines, accountable owners, evidence completeness, approval status, expected value, realised value and rejection reasons.

Tier, competency and programme administration

  • Execute approved partner-tier and competency plans by mapping programme requirements, certifications, references, revenue evidence, deadlines and accountable owners; coordinate submissions and close evidence gaps.
  • Maintain an accurate record of tier status, benefits, renewal conditions and utilisation. Report whether progression is producing usable funding, market access, capability or customer credibility.

Controls, reporting and portfolio hygiene

  • Own the integrity of the partner register, opportunity and attribution register, counterpart map, tier and competency tracker, MOU milestone tracker, subcontractor onboarding tracker, and funding and claims log.
  • Produce a concise regular / ie. monthly performance view covering accepted partner pipeline, progression, Finance-validated outcomes, funding realised, tier milestones, overdue actions, risks, decisions required and inactive relationships.
  • Keep partner and opportunity records current in the designated CRM and operating systems.


Requirements

  • Experience in partnerships, alliances, or channel/business development ideally in IT services, consulting, or enterprise technology
  • Familiarity with hyperscalers and data/AI partner programs, and how their deal registration, incentives, and competency tiers work
  • A track record of turning partnerships into measurable pipeline and closed revenue not just relationships
  • Strong program and stakeholder management across internal teams and external partner leadership
  • Diligence with multi-step processes like incentive claims, registrations, and competency applications

Familiarity with government grant mechanisms (Singapore context advantageous)

b40ca013523030d80dc67ab7e5bd8d59.title: Growth Executive
b40ca013523030d80dc67ab7e5bd8d59.snippet:
About the job



ABOUT US

When Microsoft 365 breaks, a bank goes offline, or a major app stops working, millions of people come to Status Is Down to find out what's happening. We're the outage tracker that confirms failures with a live 24/7 human team — not just bots and crowd noise. We track 2,000+ services, and that trusted data is now the foundation of a fast-growing business helping companies understand and respond to reliability failures.

We're seed-stage, moving fast, and building the commercial engine from the ground up. You'd be one of our first commercial hires, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is for builders. It'll be fast-paced, hands-on, and genuinely high-impact — you won't be handed a playbook, you'll write it. You'll own the top of our funnel across both sides of our flywheel: the free consumer audience that makes our B2B pitch stronger, and the B2B pipeline that makes the consumer product more credible. Your job is to make both spin faster.

You'll work alongside our Account Executive: you create and qualify the demand, they close it.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Generate B2B demand. Run targeted outbound to the people who feel outage pain daily — Managed Service Providers, IT support teams, and digital-operations leaders.

• Grow our B2C audience. Expand and engage the millions who come to us when something's down, through content, social, SEO, and community.

• Run the "outage-trigger" play. When a major vendor goes down, we can reach affected companies within the hour with proof we saw it first. You'll make that outreach fast and consistent — no competitor can do it.

• Feed the closer. Have the first conversations, qualify hard, and hand clean, well-briefed opportunities to our Account Executive.

• Own the growth stack. Outbound sequences, CRM, and AI-agent-assisted prospecting — so a small team produces an outsized pipeline.

• Lift self-serve conversion. Turn site visitors and free users into paying customers by testing messaging, offers, and the sign-up flow.


ABOUT YOU

We're looking for someone who wants to build something new, not just fill a role. Here, your rate of growth matters more than where you're starting from. You're likely:

• Driven and hungry to learn. You take ownership, chase outcomes, and don't wait to be told what to do.

• A fast learner. We're doing things no one has done before — you won't know it all on day one, but you pick things up quickly.

• Scrappy. You get things done despite lean resources. You don't need a full marketing org behind you to make pipeline happen.

• A sharp communicator. You write outbound that actually gets replies, and can hold your own with a technical buyer (no engineering degree required).

• Principled. Our entire business rests on independent, unbought reporting. Everyone here protects that line — it's not negotiable, and it's a big part of what makes the work meaningful.


WHAT'S REQUIRED

• 2–4 years generating pipeline or growing audiences — in B2B SaaS, B2C growth, or both.

ad8c99eac32d9a1421c8eed17c133145.snippet:
About Inclus

Headquartered in Singapore and serving the Southeast Asia region, Inclus is a social enterprise building a world where people with disabilities and their families can thrive, by providing quality support and access to services they need throughout their lives.


We partner with governments, non-profits, and the private sector to design progressive programmes that empower individuals to achieve gainful employment and lifelong independence. We collaborate closely with people with disabilities and their caregivers as we provide different levels of advice, support, and services at every stage of their journey.


Over the years, we have been recognised as a Verified Leading Social Enterprise under raiSE, an SG Enable Enabling Mark Platinum recipient, a DBS Foundation grant recipient, and an ASEAN Inclusive Business awardee.


Learn more at https://www.inclus.sg


----------


Your role

This is a dynamic, client-facing role that bridges corporate Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) goals with impactful, real-world execution. As the primary point of contact between corporate clients and Inclus, you will drive business development and relationship management—partnering directly with corporate HR, Learning & Development (L&D), and Culture teams.


Your core mission is to help companies build truly inclusive workplaces. You will advocate for, propose, and coordinate tailored training solutions—ranging from immersive onboarding/orientation modules and culture-building workshops to formal certification programs for managing and working alongside Persons with Disabilities (PWDs).


Key Responsibilities

  • B2B Partnership Development: Proactively engage and build relationships with corporate prospects, HR leaders, and L&D managers to advocate for inclusive workplace training and culture-building initiatives.
  • Solution Pitching & Needs Assessment: Consult with corporate clients to understand their DEI maturity, onboarding frameworks, and training needs, proposing relevant Inclus training modules, workshops, and certification programs.
  • Account Management & Coordination: Act as the main point of contact and bridge between corporate clients and the Inclus training/operations team, ensuring seamless delivery, logistics coordination, and post-training engagement.
  • Ecosystem & Stakeholder Engagement: Network with industry partners, HR associations, and government agencies (e.g., SG Enable) to stay updated on training grants, SEN frameworks, and industry best practices to add value to corporate partners.
  • Program Feedback & Relationship Growth: Gather client feedback post-training to measure impact, nurture long-term corporate relationships, and identify opportunities for ongoing engagement or upgraded certification pathways.


Who We Are Looking For

  • The Relationship Builder: You are confident engaging corporate stakeholders—from HR executives to L&D heads—and comfortable pitching the business value of DEI and inclusive culture.
  • The Heart & Mindset: Whether you are a fresh graduate or an experienced professional, you possess a genuine passion for inclusivity and a drive to make a tangible impact in the corporate space.
  • Disability Experience: While not mandatory, prior professional experience working within the disability sector or personal lived experience with disabilities is a strong plus.
  • Effective Communicator & Coordinator: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate training value propositions clearly, manage client expectations, and keep multi-stakeholder projects moving smoothly.
  • Adaptable Problem-Solver: Resourceful, organized, and calm under pressure. You excel at navigating client requirements and finding win-win solutions between corporate schedules and training delivery.
  • Eager Learner: You don’t need to know every DEI policy, grant scheme, or disability framework on day one. We value a growth mindset and a readiness to learn on the job alongside our team.


----------


How to Apply

We are looking for someone who brings both a strategic mind and a compassionate heart to thisrole. If this sounds like your next career chapter, we would love to hear from you.


Please submit your application to hr@inclus.sg


To help us get to know you better, please include:

  • Your updated Resume/CV.
  • A brief note (or cover letter) sharing why this specific mission resonates with you, and one growth or partnership initiative you've driven that you are proud of.


Additional Information

Inclus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

You will be responsible for identifying, approaching and signing high-quality merchants onto the CaterSpot platform.

You must be fluent in both English and Mandarin, with the confidence and ability to conduct full sales pitches, negotiations and relationship-building conversations in Mandarin with restaurant owners who may not speak English.


You will manage the full merchant acquisition cycle, from prospecting and pitching through negotiation, contracting and handover to the onboarding team.

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of restaurants, caterers, cafés, bakeries and food groups.

  • Conduct sales pitches, commercial discussions and negotiations in both English and Mandarin
  • Build relationships with non-English-speaking restaurant owners and clearly communicate CaterSpot’s value proposition in Mandarin
  • Identify gaps in CaterSpot’s merchant coverage, cuisines, price points and geographic reach
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through calls, emails, referrals, networking and in-person visits
  • Meet restaurant owners, founders, general managers and senior decision-makers
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commission structures, pricing and partnership conditions
  • Manage the full sales process from initial contact through contract signing
  • Prepare tailored proposals for larger restaurant chains and catering groups
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, activity and conversion data in the CRM
  • Work closely with Merchant Operations, Sales, Marketing and Account Management to ensure successful merchant launches
  • Represent CaterSpot at relevant industry events, networking sessions and partner meetings
  • Develop long-term relationships with key merchant groups and strategic partners

  • Previous experience in merchant acquisition, partnerships or business development
  • Proven experience signing restaurants, retailers, merchants or other business partners
  • Fluency in spoken English and Mandarin is mandatory
  • Strong ability to pitch, negotiate and close partnerships entirely in Mandarin
  • Comfortable speaking with Mandarin-speaking restaurant owners who may have limited or no English proficiency
  • Experience working for a food delivery platform, marketplace, payments company, e-commerce platform, POS provider or another merchant-focused business is highly preferred
  • Ability to manage both high-volume acquisition of independent merchants and longer, more complex negotiations with enterprise groups
  • Strong prospecting, pitching, negotiation and closing skills
  • Comfortable conducting in-person meetings and visiting restaurant and catering locations across Singapore
  • Commercially minded, persistent and highly target-driven
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of the entire acquisition funnel
  • Existing relationships within Singapore’s restaurant, catering or hospitality industry would be an advantage

  • Signing a healthy mix of independent restaurants, multi-outlet brands and strategic food groups

  • Improving CaterSpot’s merchant coverage across key cuisines, locations and price categories
  • Building a reliable pipeline of qualified merchant opportunities

Why Join CaterSpot

9fbfc81e7a2150baec014b3d681e5ae3.title: Studio Operations & Growth Manager
9fbfc81e7a2150baec014b3d681e5ae3.snippet:
About ViFit

ViFit is a Singapore-based platform connecting the Pilates community — enthusiasts, instructors and studios — through seamless booking and management tools. Alongside the platform, we own and run a growing portfolio of studios: our premium ViFit Signature studios and our accessible ViFit Lite studio. We’re growing fast, and we’re looking for someone to help run the studios we have and shape the ones we open next.


The role

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the centre of everything that happens in our studios. You’ll keep our spaces running smoothly day to day, build and nurture our community of instructors, scout the locations that will become our next studios, and help tell the ViFit story to the wider Pilates community. You’ll work directly with the founders and have real say in how the studio business grows.

We work on flexible hours. You’ll be measured on how well the studios run and how the business grows, not on when you’re at a desk — though some evening and weekend presence at the studios will be part of the rhythm, as that’s when they’re busiest.


What you’ll do

Studio operations

  • Own the day-to-day running of all ViFit studios, making sure every space is clean, well-equipped, safe and ready for each session.
  • Manage equipment maintenance, supplies, vendors and facilities issues, and be the go-to person when something needs fixing.
  • Handle member and instructor queries, feedback and booking issues, resolving them quickly and warmly.
  • Track studio utilisation, costs and performance, and suggest ways to improve them.


Instructor recruitment & scheduling

  • Recruit, onboard and build relationships with new Pilates instructors who share our standards and values.
  • Coordinate instructor schedules and studio availability across all locations, keeping the calendar full and conflict-free.
  • Be the main point of contact for instructors — supporting them, gathering feedback and helping them succeed on the ViFit platform.


Expansion

  • Research and scout potential new studio spaces across Singapore, including site visits and initial conversations with landlords and agents.
  • Assess locations on footfall, accessibility, cost and fit with the ViFit Signature and ViFit Lite concepts, and put together clear recommendations for the founders.
  • Support the fit-out and launch of new studios from signing to opening day.


Marketing & branding

  • Support marketing campaigns, launches and promotions (such as new studio openings and class offers) across social media, the website and on-site.
  • Help create content that showcases our studios, instructors and community.
  • Represent ViFit at events, partnerships and community activities to grow awareness and bookings.


Who we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, studio/gym management, hospitality, retail or a similar customer-facing environment. Experience in fitness, wellness or Pilates is a strong plus.
  • A natural organiser who enjoys juggling multiple locations, people and moving parts without losing track of the details.
  • Warm, confident communicator who can build rapport with instructors, members, landlords and partners alike.
  • Self-starter who is comfortable working independently, making decisions and taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Commercial instinct — you notice what drives bookings and costs, and you like finding ways to improve both.
  • Comfortable with everyday digital tools (booking systems, spreadsheets, social media). No technical background needed.
  • Interest in Pilates, fitness or wellness, and excitement about building something with a growing brand.


What we offer

  • Flexible working hours — organise your week around what the studios and your life need.
  • A broad, varied role with real ownership and direct access to the founders.
  • The chance to shape a growing studio portfolio and be part of its expansion story from the start.
  • Complimentary access to Pilates sessions at our studios.
  • Competitive salary, based on experience.

About Us

We're building and growing a crypto product suite spanning both a wallet app and PancakeSwap (DEX). We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who deeply understands both the wallet and DEX/trading space, and can drive growth strategy across these two connected but distinct user experiences — from wallet onboarding through on-chain trading activity.

Responsibilities

  • Own go-to-market and growth strategy across both the wallet app and PancakeSwap, including cold-start acquisition for new surfaces, seed user cultivation (crypto-native users, KOCs, DeFi power users), and content ecosystem build-out
  • Develop strategies that account for the different user journeys and mindsets between wallet users (onboarding, security, asset management) and DEX users (trading, liquidity provision, yield farming, swaps)
  • Drive growth across Douyin, TikTok, X (Twitter), Telegram, and Discord — including KOL/KOC partnerships, content strategy, paid acquisition optimization, and community growth
  • Plan and execute go-to-market campaigns around key milestones — wallet feature launches, PancakeSwap product updates (new pools, farms, IFOs, V3/V4 features, cross-chain expansion, etc.), token-related events, and airdrops
  • Build and optimize growth funnels tailored to each product: wallet (download → wallet creation/import → first transaction → retention) and PancakeSwap (visit → connect wallet → first swap/LP action → repeat trading behavior)
  • Own brand positioning and messaging that stays consistent across the wallet and DEX product lines, while tailoring tone to each audience — casual wallet users vs. active DeFi traders
  • Continuously track competitor activity across both categories — wallets (MetaMask, OKX Wallet, imToken, Phantom, Trust Wallet, Rabby) and DEXs (Uniswap, Curve, Raydium, Aerodrome, etc.) — and translate findings into actionable positioning and growth strategies
  • Design and run crypto-native growth incentive programs (trading competitions, LP incentives, airdrop quests, referral rewards, points systems), balancing growth impact with compliance risk
  • Manage marketing budget and ROI, owning core growth metrics across both products (CAC, wallet activation rate, DEX trading volume, TVL growth, monthly active addresses, retention, etc.)
  • Build and manage partnerships with exchanges, chain ecosystems, DeFi protocols, and liquidity partners to unlock co-marketing and ecosystem distribution opportunities

Requirements

Core Experience

  • 3+ years in product marketing or growth marketing, with at least one complete 0-to-1 experience, ideally spanning both consumer wallet products and DeFi/trading products
  • Proven growth track record on Douyin, TikTok, or similar short-video platforms, with concrete, verifiable results (follower growth, conversion rates, GMV, etc.)
  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with both the wallet industry and DEX/DeFi trading space — you understand wallet mechanics (custodial vs. non-custodial, seed phrases, multi-chain support, gas fees) as well as DEX mechanics (AMM models, liquidity pools, concentrated liquidity/V3, impermanent loss, yield farming, IFOs)
  • Prior experience marketing a crypto exchange, wallet product, DEX, or DeFi protocol strongly preferred; direct experience with PancakeSwap or a comparable AMM is a strong plus

Skills & Capabilities

  • Fluent in crypto-native growth channels and culture (X/Twitter Spaces, Telegram communities, Discord, on-chain analytics platforms like Dune, DeFiLlama, etc.)
  • Strong grasp of growth methodology (AARRR framework, growth hacking tactics) with the ability to adapt these frameworks across different product types and crypto's market cycles
  • Comfortable managing marketing strategy for multiple, connected product surfaces simultaneously without losing brand consistency
  • Data-fluent — comfortable reading on-chain metrics (TVL, trading volume, active addresses, LP activity) and translating them into growth decisions
  • Excellent storytelling and content instincts — able to make both a security-focused wallet product and a technically dense DEX product feel simple and shareable
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to work closely with product, engineering, operations, compliance, and community teams across both workstreams
  • Sharp awareness of crypto's regulatory sensitivities and volatile market sentiment (bull/bear cycles), with the ability to adjust marketing tactics accordingly

Nice to Have

  • Growth experience in overseas markets (Southeast Asia, LatAm, or Western markets)
  • Direct hands-on experience trading, providing liquidity, or farming on PancakeSwap or a similar AMM
  • Familiarity with compliance red lines specific to crypto marketing (e.g. avoiding price/ROI implications, token promotion regulations)
  • A track record of independently planning and executing airdrop, trading competition, or LP incentive campaigns with a full growth loop
  • An active, credible presence in Web3 as a real user — genuine on-chain activity and community relationships in the space

What We Offer

  • A founding/core team seat with direct influence on growth strategy across the full product suite
  • Competitive salary + equity/token incentives (details discussed individually)
  • A flat, fast-moving team with short decision cycles

About Gate

Founded in 2013, Gate is one of the world's leading cryptocurrency exchanges, serving 50M+ users worldwide and consistently ranked among the top 3 exchanges globally. We operate remote-first across multiple time zones, with a culture built on ownership, speed, and direct communication — you'll work with people who move fast and expect the same of you.


Why This Role Exists

Our Global Partnerships team is expanding the kinds of deals it does — beyond asset listings into TradFi and Web3 products such as DEX, wallets and blockchain infrastructure. As the pipeline grows, we need someone to build and qualify it: finding the right partners, running the early conversations, and carrying deals forward alongside our senior partnerships leads. It's a role for someone early in their partnerships career who wants exposure to real deals rather than a support function around them.


What You'll Own

  • Sourcing and qualifying partnership opportunities across asset listings, TradFi and Web3 products
  • Running first-touch outreach and early-stage conversations with prospective partners
  • Supporting live deals through due diligence, proposal preparation and commercial negotiation, with increasing ownership as you grow into the role
  • Managing day-to-day communication with existing partners and keeping relationships warm
  • Preparing partner research, deal materials and internal updates for the team and senior management
  • Coordinating with product, legal, compliance, risk, operations and marketing to move deals through execution
  • Tracking pipeline, deal status and partner activity so nothing goes cold
  • Representing Gate at relevant industry events and partner meetings


Who We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years in business development, partnerships, sales, account management, fintech, financial services, digital assets or Web3
  • Native-level English communication, with strong written and verbal ability; working Chinese is an advantage
  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of crypto and Web3 — you follow the space and can hold a credible conversation with a project team
  • Comfortable with outbound: you can open a conversation with someone who doesn't know you yet and keep it going
  • Organised and self-directed — you can manage your own pipeline without close supervision in a remote-first setup
  • Nice to have: exposure to listings, DEX, wallets, stablecoins, tokenisation or blockchain infrastructure, or an existing network in crypto or Web3


Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

You'll be working on live partnerships across listings, TradFi and Web3 from your first month, not sitting behind a senior BD doing admin. The team is small enough that what you source is what you work on, and you'll get direct visibility with senior management on the deals that land. For someone who wants to build a partnerships career at global scale in crypto, this is an unusually fast way to do it.

9ffb5e822669199ddfc6d228c2dbad92.title: Executive, AI & Data Strategy and Governance
9ffb5e822669199ddfc6d228c2dbad92.snippet:
ORGANISATION / DIVISION INFORMATION


As the holding company of Singapore’s public healthcare institutions, we are always looking for qualified, passionate individuals who are keen to make a valuable contribution to public healthcare. At MOH Holdings, we believe our employees are our greatest asset and we are dedicated in helping them achieve their full potential through professional development and by providing an environment to develop their leadership skills and competencies.


The AI and Data Office (AIDO) drives MOHH's enterprise AI and data agenda by enabling AI and data to deliver organisational value while ensuring they are used responsibly, safely and in accordance with established policies and standards. The Office works across business, technology and governance functions to support AI and data strategy, portfolio oversight, governance operations, capability development and organisational adoption.


Join us and be part of a team - a uniquely MOHH spirit that propels us forward through every circumstance we face.


  • Acting Tomorrow For Today: We work pragmatically with the realities of the present, with a mindset that is geared to the needs of the future.
  • Starting Where You Can: We take a can-do approach to problem-solving, even if it means starting small, because every contribution counts.
  • Leaving No Job Undone: We take pride in seeing things through. Our high standards means it’s not just about getting the job done, but getting it done well.
  • Moving Together as One: Care for all starts within, with us as an organisation. We look out for one another, leaving no on behind as we grow.


SUMMARY OF THE ROLE


The Executive, AI and Data Strategy and Governance, supports MOHH's enterprise AI and data agenda across strategy, portfolio management and governance operations. The role contributes to portfolio monitoring, reporting and governance activities, and helps translate governance requirements into practical processes and governance practices. The incumbent will gather, analyse and maintain data, information and documentation required to support management reporting, decision-making and governance reviews.


This is a hands-on role involving direct work with data and information sources. The incumbent will be expected to independently extract, clean, validate, analyse and present information required for reporting, portfolio oversight and governance activities. As part of a newly established function, the incumbent will have opportunities to contribute to the continuous improvement of the Office's processes, practices and ways of working.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


AI and Data Strategy Support

  • Conduct research and analysis on how AI and data may support improvements in operational effectiveness, service delivery, risk management and organisational capability.
  • Support assessments of MOHH's current capabilities across data, technology, people, operating processes, governance and partnerships.
  • Analyse data, information and trends to identify capability gaps, operational needs and improvement opportunities.
  • Support the preparation of analyses relating to options such as build, buy, partner, reuse or defer, taking into account cost, capability, interoperability and risk considerations.
  • Prepare analysis and materials to support strategy discussions, prioritisation and decision-making.
  • Assist with the development and periodic review of MOHH's AI and data strategy, priorities and roadmap.


Portfolio Monitoring and Performance Reporting

  • Maintain information on MOHH's AI and data initiatives, including objectives, ownership, progress, outcomes, dependencies, risks and key decisions.
  • Gather, consolidate and analyse information from initiative owners to support portfolio monitoring and reporting.
  • Work directly with source data to prepare, clean, reconcile and validate information used in management reporting.
  • Prepare portfolio reports, management papers, presentations and briefing materials to support management discussions and decision-making.
  • Support initiative owners in establishing baselines and tracking measures relating to adoption, capability development, operational outcomes and value realisation.
  • Analyse initiative proposals and progress updates to support assessment of business need, expected outcomes, delivery readiness and key trade-offs.
  • Identify emerging issues, duplicated efforts and shared dependencies across initiatives, and highlight observations for management consideration.


AI and Data Governance Operations

  • Support the implementation of AI and data governance policies, standards, processes, templates and guidance materials.
  • Administer governance workflows relating to AI initiatives, including intake, assessment coordination, review routing, conditions tracking and lifecycle updates.
  • Maintain governance records and artefacts, including the AI Register, decision records, exceptions, incidents, material changes and remediation actions.
  • Support Business Owners, System Owners and Product Teams in understanding governance requirements and identifying appropriate evidence, controls and safeguards.
  • Coordinate inputs from business, technology, cybersecurity, data protection, legal and other stakeholders as part of governance reviews.
  • Support activities relating to data governance, including data ownership, definitions, documentation and data quality.
  • Monitor governance, data quality and control-related issues, and support follow-up and remediation activities where required.
  • Assist in reviewing governance processes and identifying opportunities to improve effectiveness, efficiency and proportionality.
  • Support awareness and implementation activities that embed AI and data governance practices within business and technology processes.


Management Forums and Secretariat Support

  • Support the secretariat functions of the AI and Data Oversight Committee (ADOC) and other relevant governance forums.
  • Coordinate meeting schedules, agenda planning, paper submissions and stakeholder engagements to support governance forums.
  • Review submissions to ensure that decision requests, supporting evidence, options, risks and recommendations are appropriately documented prior to tabling.
  • Prepare and consolidate materials required for management discussions and decision-making.
  • Record meeting outcomes, decisions, action items and follow-up requirements accurately and promptly.
  • Track action items and follow up with stakeholders to support timely completion or escalation where appropriate.


Research, Engagement and Capability Development

  • Monitor emerging developments, trends and practices relating to AI, data, governance and regulation, and summarise relevant implications for MOHH.
  • Support workshops, discussions and working sessions involving business, technology and governance stakeholders.
  • Assist in developing communications, guidance materials, examples and learning resources that support the responsible and effective use of AI and data.
  • Document lessons learnt, good practices and observations from initiatives, reviews and incidents to support organisational learning.
  • Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.


JOB REQUIREMENTS


Education Requirement(s):

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline such as Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Economics or a related field, with demonstrated analytical aptitude and practical data skills.


Key Qualities:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity, evaluate evidence and identify practical solutions.
  • Practical data literacy, including the ability to locate, extract, clean, validate and present information from multiple sources.
  • Working understanding of AI, including agentic AI, and of associated opportunities, limitations and risks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear reports, presentations and briefing materials, and engage effectively with stakeholders across business, technology and governance functions.
  • Good organisational and coordination skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.
  • Demonstrates sound judgement, professionalism and adaptability, and is comfortable working in a developing environment where processes and practices are still evolving.


Years of Experience Required:

  • Fresh graduates with strong academic, project or internship experience are welcome to apply.
  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in business analysis, data and reporting, governance, risk, audit, transformation, portfolio management or related fields would be advantageous.
  • Experience in healthcare, the public sector or another regulated environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. Job description

We are seeking an operational, highly adaptable Marketing & Digital Growth Specialist to serve as the direct support to the Marketing Manager. This role is designed to bridge traditional on-the-ground marketing operations with full-stack digital performance execution. You will be responsible for managing day-to-day sales enablement, event execution, vendor logistics & field media capture, while simultaneously owning performance ad management (Meta/Google), e-commerce storefront optimization (Shopify/Shopee/Lazada/TikTok) & lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo/WhatsApp). Furthermore, you will support regional marketing rollouts & localization efforts as we expand across Southeast Asia & target Greater China markets.


Key Responsibilities:

1.Digital Marketing, Creative Strategy & Performance Media

  • Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google):

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Ads & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

  • Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g., Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners)
  • A/B Testing & Optimization: Formulate hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles, copy length) & run A/B tests to systematically improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all campaigns, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify. Monitor the customer path from first touchpoint to conversion
  • Media Budget Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, scaling winning creatives & optimise underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) data

2.Content Production

  • Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing
  • Video & Static Creation: Produce & edit native social content, including UGC-style video, product demos & testimonials using tools like CapCut or Premiere Pro, as well as static ad variations & storefront banners
  • Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social captions that align with brand voice & healthcare regulatory requirements
  • Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for testing cycles

3.E-Commerce & Social Media Account Ownership

  • E-Commerce Storefront Custodian: Maintain & integrate winning creative messages across official storefronts on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop (product pages, banners) to maximize conversion rates
  • Social Accounts Ownership & Community Management: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure profiles feature updated bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & highlighted stories
  • Content Programming & Scheduling: Maintain a consistent content calendar balancing educational, lifestyle & promotional posts
  • Active Social Listening & UGC Mining: Monitor comments & DMs to identify customer pain points for new content hooks & curate customer testimonials to deploy as high-converting growth assets

4.CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

  • EDM & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency newsletter calendar via Klaviyo, including educational insights & promotional product-launch/seasonal campaigns
  • Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp automation (e.g., Welcome series, Post-Purchase care, Win-back flows & Replenishment Reminders)
  • Subscription & Loyalty Optimization: Craft compelling creative & copy for subscription programs, optimizing triggers to reduce churn, increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
  • WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid promotions

5.Day-to-Day Marketing Operations & Brand Execution

  • Execute Business & Marketing Initiatives: Execute effective marketing & business development initiatives tailored to each health supplement brand to increase market share, achieve revenue & reach profitability targets in line with overall business objectives
  • Budget & Spend Monitoring: Track & monitor marketing budget allocations, campaign expenditures, purchase orders (POs) & invoices to ensure optimal ROI, resource allocation, & strict adherence to financial targets
  • Marketing Collateral Development: Manage the end-to-end production of printed & digital collaterals (e.g., product packaging, brochures, POSM displays & email newsletters), liaising with print vendors & briefing internal design teams
  • Marketing Collaterals Inventory Management: Monitor & maintain inventory levels of promotional materials, product samples & event displays to support ongoing on-ground campaigns

6.Field Media Capture & Event Execution

  • Medical Conferences & Sponsorships: Lead on-the-ground setup, booth operations & logistics for major medical association conventions & trade events (e.g., Singapore Orthopaedic Association - SOA, Malaysian Orthopaedic Association - MOA)
  • CME Workshop Coordination: Support Continuing Medical Education (CME) seminars for healthcare professionals—managing attendee invites, venue logistics, collateral preparation & post-event survey collation
  • On-Site Media Capture: Direct & capture raw video footage & photos during events, social media content creation & patient/doctor testimonial shoots using mobile/camera gear
  • Digital Handoff & Asset Tagging: Organize raw media assets, write clear creative briefs & storyboards & transfer files to internal design teams (for video editing/graphics) or deploy them directly across paid ad channels

7.Sales Team Enablement & Trade Support

  • Sales Collaterals: Develop & update product brochures, product samples & promotional offers to empower the Sales team
  • Retail Pharmacy Activations: Coordinate trade marketing collaterals, listing campaigns & point-of-sale displays for retail pharmacy chains

8.Compliance & Brand Integrity

  • Regulatory Compliance: Safeguard brand credibility by ensuring all promotional messaging remain factual, align with company values & strictly comply with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • 2–4 years of hands-on marketing executive experience, combining general marketing operations with full-stack digital marketing & e-commerce execution
  • Proven hands-on experience setting up, managing & optimizing paid ad campaigns within Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads
  • Direct experience managing content, storefronts & promotions on Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok Shop
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), UTM tracking structures & CRM/EDM automation tools (Klaviyo preferred)
  • Proficient in producing rapid static & video content using CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or Illustrator
  • Fluency in spoken & written Mandarin is required to effectively liaise with Mandarin-speaking healthcare professionals, retail pharmacy partners, media platforms & suppliers/vendors
  • Strong event execution, vendor management & trade marketing coordination skills
  • Confident in capturing raw smartphone/camera footage during events & directing quick on-site interviews

8ae3ba554714629ef48e43ac77de747f.title: Digital Product Owner - Digital Operations

Responsibilities

  • Product & Delivery Roadmaps: Lead product and delivery roadmaps for digital operations, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and constraints to support scalable and standardised digital operational processes that enable faster deployment across countries. 
  • Process Re-engineering: Re-engineer operational processes and workflows with responsible AI, automation, and straight-through processing (STP), from business case through redesign to benefit realisation. 
  • Use Case Creation: Translate business needs and operational pain points into use cases and delivery scope that reduce waste, improve efficiency, and increase reliability across the digital value chain. 
  • Performance Metrics: Define and track KPIs connected to lean performance drivers, including customer experience, productivity, stability, and cost-to-serve, while establishing structured continuous improvement feedback loops with country teams. 
  • Operations Execution: Orchestrate complex operations execution across cross-functional teams and functions by combining AI automation with strategic human oversight (human in the loop), maximising efficiency in a fluid, fast-evolving environment.

Operational Efficiency & Business AI Transformation 

  • Drive Lean AI Transformation: Lead end-to-end operational reviews across Digital Consumer workflows to eliminate waste, reduce manual rework and bottlenecks, and redesign processes through responsible AI, automation, and STP. 
  • Deliver Measurable Business Impact: Partner with business leaders to prioritise and launch high-value AI use cases, with clear ROI metrics tracking cycle time, transaction cost, accuracy, and efficiency gains. 


High-Performance, AI-Augmented Delivery Leader 

  • Team & Delivery Leadership: Build high-performing, AI-native teams with clear ownership, execution discipline, and strong onshore/offshore governance. 
  • AI-Augmented Delivery: Use responsible AI tools and practices to improve squad velocity, engineering quality, sprint output, and organisational capability at scale.

  • Governance & Ownership Transfer: Establish human-in-the-loop controls, fallback protocols, risk frameworks, playbooks, and readiness tracking to enable compliant AI use and sustainable BU ownership. 


Risk, Compliance & Operational Readiness 

  • Risk & Delivery Governance: Proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, blockers, documentation, approvals, audit trails, and governance evidence across delivery activities. 
  • Operational Readiness & Compliance: Support platform readiness, operational controls, security requirements, compliance reviews, and business go-live preparation with relevant teams.

  • Experience initiating and driving strategic projects to completion with minimal guidance

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

1f534abc375cd60f55315f824a8bbe87.title: Data Scientist/Senior Data Scientist – Digital Health & AI
1f534abc375cd60f55315f824a8bbe87.snippet:
Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be passionate about utilizing data science methodologies to derive insights from digital device sensor data coming from clinical studies and contribute to the development and implementation of algorithms in this area. As a Data Scientist, you will work closely with customers to analyze data and build models and tools that enhance understanding of clinical outcomes and solve their business problems.


Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with customers to identify key questions, develop hypotheses, and test those hypotheses with clinical study data.
  • Develop and implement machine learning algorithms for processing and interpreting sensor data (e.g., accelerometers, heart rate monitors, etc.). Research and develop novel digital measures with clinical significance.
  • Design, develop, and implement solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies, including prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Apply data preprocessing techniques to optimize large sets of sensor data processing and analysis, handling issues like noise, missing data, and time-series synchronization.
  • Validate and interpret results to ensure accuracy, performance and scalability in real-time processing of sensor streams.
  • Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders through clear and compelling visualizations, reports, and presentations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop data-driven solutions to address business needs.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in data science and clinical research to continuously improve methodologies and approaches.


Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science, with a focus on sensor data analysis or digital health.
  • Strong understanding of time-series analysis, signal processing, and feature extraction techniques.
  • Proficiency in programming languages and libraries (e.g, Python/R, TensorFlow/Pytorch) for data analysis and machine learning.

We’re GF, the global leader in Flow Solutions with over 200 years of expertise. We help solve some of the world’s most urgent challenges. We are seeking a strategic and commercially astute Head of Sales to lead our Singapore sales organization and drive sustainable business growth, profitability, and market expansion across key industry sectors.

  • Commercial Excellence: Leading major bids, strategic pursuits, and complex project opportunities with rigorous discipline

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with execution excellence—bringing deep industry knowledge, proven commercial leadership, and the ability to inspire teams while driving operational rigor and customer-centricity throughout the organization

Sales Leadership & Strategy Execution – Lead the sales team to achieve annual revenue, margin, and market share targets. Develop and execute strategic sales and business development plans that drive growth across core and emerging segments. Oversee major project bids and tender pursuits with disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and rigorous opportunity qualification.


Team Development & Performance Management – Build and develop high-performing external sales teams through targeted coaching, skills development, and individual performance plans. Foster a performance-driven, customer-centric culture that emphasizes consultative selling and commercial excellence.


Business Development & Key Account Management – Identify, evaluate, and convert new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and key accounts in collaboration with the Project Sales Manager. Lead prospecting initiatives, customer value discussions, and solution-based positioning to unlock new revenue streams. Collaborate with global teams to strengthen system utilization, embed best practices, and develop sales tools, playbooks, and enablement resources that support consultative, solution-oriented selling.

Partner with Marketing to refine go-to-market strategies, segment prioritization, pricing frameworks, and value propositions that strengthen competitive positioning and market relevance.

  • A minimum of 8 years experience in a sales role with proven track record in meeting or exceeding given sales targets
