This role is posted on behalf of Portcast, a startup supported by SGInnovate.


Background

Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology company building AI-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.


Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.


Job scope

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C-suite. This is a senior individual-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.


At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross-sell, and new teams and regions.


You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C-suite level.
  • Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
  • Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high-impact experience.
  • Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
  • Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
  • Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.

d169d097a970733ef1d74ed5bab6db86.title: Business Development Consultant, AI & Automation (Commission-Based)
d169d097a970733ef1d74ed5bab6db86.snippet:
About Roqley

Roqley helps Singapore SMEs identify where AI and automation can make a practical difference, then builds the systems and processes that deliver it.


Many business owners know AI will affect how they work but are unsure where to begin, or which opportunities are worth pursuing. We help them examine their operations, identify valuable use cases and turn those into working solutions.


Our projects are delivered in focused phases. Clients see useful progress early, avoid committing to a large project upfront, and decide whether to continue based on tangible results. This keeps risk manageable and holds us accountable for delivering value.


The opportunity

Roqley has active clients and ongoing delivery work, and that's exactly the problem. As the founder I lead both delivery and business development, and client work has taken priority. So I'm looking for someone to own new business conversations and build a consistent pipeline.


You will:

  • Identify Singapore SMEs that could benefit from practical automation
  • Open conversations through your existing network, and any channels you judge will work, running your own pipeline and follow-up
  • Lead initial discovery calls to understand how each business operates, where time is being lost and which problems are worth solving
  • Work with me to shape proposals and guide opportunities through to a signed engagement


You'll also have real input into Roqley's positioning and how we go to market, if that's something you want to shape.


Once a client signs, I take responsibility for solution design and delivery. You stay focused on the next opportunity, and I’ll keep you informed as delivery progresses so you can speak confidently about the work.


Who this may suit

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have trusted relationships with Singapore SME owners, founders or senior operators
  • Have sold consulting, agency, technology or other B2B services
  • Can hold a thoughtful conversation about operational problems rather than relying on a scripted pitch
  • Understand the practical possibilities and limitations of AI, or are motivated to learn through hands-on use
  • Work independently and manage your own pipeline well
  • Are comfortable joining an early-stage business where you can influence how the commercial function develops


Compensation

This is currently a commission-based role with no fixed salary. Commission is uncapped and paid on successful client engagements.


The commission percentage, payment timing, treatment of repeat work and opportunity attribution will be agreed clearly in writing before you begin.


As Roqley develops more stable recurring revenue, there is potential for this role to become salaried. We'll agree in advance when that conversation takes place and what commercial milestones would support it.


What you will receive

Direct support during later-stage client conversations, and the materials to represent Roqley properly: service information, examples of our delivered work, proposal support, and help assessing whether an opportunity is technically and commercially viable.


You'll also have my technical support in building your own AI tooling for prospecting, research and follow-up, so the role itself becomes a demonstration of what we sell.

444a67ec6749c9e6cc07e7e62bd85d1b.title: Account Executive, Startups (AI Solutions)
444a67ec6749c9e6cc07e7e62bd85d1b.snippet:
About the Team

The Startups team at Airwallex partners with the most promising venture-backed companies across Asia to provide seamless access to our global financial infrastructure — empowering them to scale without borders. We sit at the intersection of fintech product, venture capital networks, and founder communities, taking a hands-on, consultative approach to helping startups professionalise their cross-border financial operations from their earliest institutional funding round through to growth stage and beyond.

Our motion is equal parts commercial and ecosystem. We build deep relationships with top-tier VCs, co-host events with accelerators and ecosystem partners, and embed ourselves in the startup communities across Singapore and the broader region. We are a tight, high-conviction team seeking to seed and grow lasting relationships with the companies that will define the next decade of innovation in Asia.


Why This Role Is Different — AI Solutions

This is not a standard payments sales role. Airwallex has built AgentOS — a production-grade toolkit that lets AI agents work directly with a company's Airwallex account, so founders and finance teams can run cross-border finance operations in plain English instead of clicking through a dashboard. We're one of the first cross-border platforms in the world to ship this, and Singapore is one of the first markets where we're taking it to founders.

As the AI Solutions AE for Singapore startups, you'll be on the front line of that motion. You won't just sell accounts and FX — you'll help AI-native and AI-curious founders reimagine how their finance function runs: multi-currency cash visibility, supplier onboarding, corporate cards and spend, and billing, increasingly driven by agentic workflows. You'll be expected to become genuinely fluent in our AI finance story, translate an early and fast-moving capability into concrete value for each company, and help us build some of our first AgentOS customer stories. Comfort with ambiguity and a real interest in where AI is taking finance are essential — this is beta-stage, frontier work.


What You'll Do

As an Account Executive on the Startups team, you will own the full sales cycle — from sourcing and prospecting through to close, onboarding, and ongoing account growth. You will work closely with venture capital partners, ecosystem organisations, and founders directly to build pipeline, convert high-value startup customers, and grow their usage of the Airwallex platform — including our AI finance and AgentOS capabilities — over time.

This is a role for someone passionate about the startup world, energised by founder conversations, excited by AI, and looking to be known in the ecosystem as a trusted partner who helps startups get their financial plumbing right and points them toward what's next.


Responsibilities


Full-Cycle Sales & Consultative Selling

  • Own the end-to-end sales process for startup prospects — from initial outreach and discovery through to commercial negotiation, onboarding, and go-live.

  • Build and present tailored business cases that go beyond feature comparison, helping prospects understand the downstream implications of their current setup and the strategic value of upgrading their financial infrastructure early.


AI Finance & AgentOS Solutioning

  • Develop deep, credible fluency in Airwallex's AI finance offering and keep pace as the product rapidly evolves.
  • Identify which prospects and existing customers are the best fit for agentic finance workflows, and design concrete, company-specific use cases that map AgentOS skills to real pains.
  • Run discovery and demos that bring the workflow shift to life, while framing trust and safety honestly for non-technical founders (the agent prepares and drafts; humans approve anything that moves money).
  • Help seed and document our first AgentOS customer stories in Singapore, and feed learnings back to product and the broader Startups team to sharpen the motion.


Backbook Ownership & Account Growth

  • Retain and grow a named portfolio of existing startup customers, ensuring they remain active, satisfied, and expanding their usage of the platform.
  • Monitor customer activity levels, flag churn risks early, and proactively identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities — particularly around product adoption (e.g. spend management, billing/PA, yield, and AI finance workflows).
  • Serve as the primary relationship holder for your portfolio, maintaining regular touchpoints with founders and finance teams and acting as their internal advocate.
  • Identify and action graduation opportunities — surfacing high-growth accounts to enterprise or theme teams when deal complexity or GP potential warrants a co-sell or handover.


VC Partnerships & Warm Introductions

  • Work closely with our Venture Partnerships function to convert VC relationships into qualified, warm introductions to portfolio companies.
  • Develop familiarity with the portfolio companies of our priority VC partners and maintain a clear view of which companies represent the strongest product-market fit for Airwallex.
  • Contribute insights back to the Venture Partnerships team on what's resonating with portfolio companies, what objections arise, and where we can sharpen our value proposition to VCs.


Community, Events & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Actively participate in startup community events, founder networking sessions, VC-hosted gatherings, and ecosystem activations.
  • Represent Airwallex at external events with credibility and enthusiasm, engaging founders in genuine conversation and building relationships that extend beyond a single transaction.
  • Attend and engage with industry meetups, accelerator demo days, and partner events.
  • Contribute to the team's community presence through activities such as social media engagement, content sharing, and being a visible and helpful presence in the startup ecosystem.


Who You Are


Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of sales experience in a B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments environment, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
  • Experience selling into venture-backed startups or working within the startup/VC ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with the Asia startup landscape — key VCs, accelerators, co-working communities, and the general rhythm of the ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to run a full sales cycle independently — from self-sourced prospecting through to negotiation and close.
  • Strong consultative selling instincts — you lead with curiosity, ask sharp discovery questions, and build value through understanding rather than pitching features.
  • Strong acumen with current AI tools, deploying and managing agents, and AI-native solution design. You're the kind of person who experiments with AI tools, follows where the space is going, and gets energised (not intimidated) by an early-stage, fast-changing product.
  • Genuine affinity and experience in the startup ecosystem.
  • Comfort with cross-border financial operations concepts.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills — you're articulate, professional, and equally comfortable presenting to a room of founders as you are doing a 1:1 deep-dive with a finance lead over coffee.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and structured pipeline management.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial services with an understanding of products such as global accounts, payment acceptance, FX, card issuing, or spend management.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude, Cursor, or similar), or a track record of being an early adopter who can make new technology tangible for non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing a backbook or portfolio of accounts alongside new business responsibilities, with demonstrated ability to retain and grow existing customers.
  • A visible personal presence in the startup community — whether through event attendance, LinkedIn activity, community involvement, or existing relationships with founders and investors.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — prior founder experience or side-project background is a genuine plus, as it deepens your empathy for the customers we serve.

  • External communications accurately reflect the company’s real progress and capabilities.
Why Join UnlockLand
  • Build the public narrative of an ambitious AI-native Singapore company.

  • Take ownership across PR, social media, blogs, video and thought leadership.
  • Join the company during a period of rapid product and international growth.

48b129c48172447611b2cc5cb447b6bb.snippet:
DUBAI BASED ROLE. Relocation would be required but with highly competitive, tax free salary package.



Company Profile:


Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.


Role Summary:


Property Finder is the leading property portal in the UAE and MENA, and one of the most visited Real Estate destinations in the region. Millions of people use it every month to find a home, and most of them arrive because the product itself brought them there.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our product-led growth work: making the product easier to discover, faster to get value from, more rewarding to come back to, and something people want to share. You will lead a cross-functional squad, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the results.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a rare kind of generalist: someone with a quantitative mind, real depth across product, SEO, performance marketing, research, data and engineering, and the taste and presence to carry a growth story from a spreadsheet to the executive room.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own and lead the product-led growth roadmap, from discovery to delivery to results.
  • Grow the product's organic reach: the pages, tools and content surfaces that make Property Finder the place people land when they search for anything to do with property, including through AI assistants.
  • Make the product shareable and viral. Build the moments people want to send to a partner, a friend or a colleague, and make sharing effortless.
  • Design first sessions that get new visitors to value quickly, and experiences that bring people back throughout their property journey.
  • Bring engagement and gamification into the product with taste: recognition, progress and reward that feel natural in a high-stakes decision like finding a home.
  • Turn user contributions into product: reviews, questions, opinions and local knowledge that make the product richer for everyone.
  • Run a disciplined experimentation programme: hypotheses, guardrails, clean reads and honest write-ups when a test loses.
  • Work hand in hand with performance marketing so paid and organic reinforce each other rather than compete.
  • Use AI as a working method, not a slide: research, analysis, prototyping, content and data workflows.
  • Lead the squad day to day: prioritisation, specs, experiments, readouts and shipped work.
  • Work closely with SEO, Data Science, Engineering, Design, Analytics and Marketing, and keep growth on the consumer side aligned with the business.
  • Communicate crisply with senior stakeholders and represent the growth story across the company.


Desired Experience:


  • You have built products that grew on their own having spread through its own users and search, and you can explain what worked, what did not, and why.
  • Eight or more years in product, most of it on consumer products at scale, with at least three in a growth role where you owned the number.
  • Quantitative by training. A degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science or a similar discipline, ideally with an MBA or comparable business education on top.
  • First principles reasoning and you are comfortable with models.
  • End to end knowledge. Discovery, user research, specs, prioritisation, experimentation and readouts.
  • You have designed and read A/B tests properly, including the messy ones with lag, seasonality and interference, and you know when not to trust a result.
  • Hands-on with SEO. Technical, content and off-page.
  • You have worked in Search Console and crawl data yourself, shipped templated pages at scale, and understand how search engines and AI assistants source and cite answers.
  • Deep understanding of performance marketing. Paid search, paid social and app campaigns: how they are bought, measured and attributed, and how they interact with organic.
  • User research. Interviews, surveys, usability sessions and behavioural analysis, and you know which one answers which question.
  • Strong with data. SQL and product analytics as a daily habit, statistics you can apply rather than recite, and dashboards you built yourself.
  • You can code and you speak engineering. Python or JavaScript well enough to pull data, prototype a feature or automate a workflow, and enough architecture to have a real conversation about trade-offs and effort. Engineers trust your judgement.
  • AI skills. You use LLMs and agents as a working method for research, analysis, prototyping and content, you have built or orchestrated agentic workflows, and you have a grounded view of where they help and where they hurt.
  • You can take a complex story to an executive room, hold attention, answer the hard question and leave with a decision.


Nice to have:


  • Marketplace experience where you have worked on a two-sided product and know that growth on one side has consequences on the other.
  • Real Estate, classifieds or marketplace background in the UAE or GCC.
  • Experience with user-generated content, loyalty or gamification products, or App Store Optimisation.
  • Arabic language skills


Why this role?


  • Scale and stakes: millions of monthly users, the leading position in the market, and a mandate to extend it.
  • Real ownership: a squad, a roadmap and a budget conversation that are yours to shape.
  • A team that treats growth as a product discipline, not a marketing tactic, and works with data science and engineering as peers.
  • Direct exposure to the executive team, and a manager who expects you to disagree with him when the evidence says so.

d18d9a0c63c24cc9298fdcb34bc4ecfe.title: Business Development Lead - Emerging Market / LATAM (Payments)
d18d9a0c63c24cc9298fdcb34bc4ecfe.snippet:
• This is a fully remote role


About the Company

Better Payment Network (BPN), Incubated through Binance Yzilabs, is a next-generation stablecoin settlement network designed to power cross-border payments in emerging markets.

Rather than serving consumers directly, BPN connects licensed financial institutions on both sides of cross-border payments:


  • PSPs in markets such as Hong Kong and Singapore serving large numbers of cross-border merchants;
  • Banks, PSPs, VASPs and stablecoin institutions in emerging markets providing local collection, FX and settlement capabilities.


BPN enables businesses across cross-border e-commerce, trade, logistics and digital entertainment to collect local fiat, move value globally through stablecoins, and settle into their preferred currencies.


Today, BPN connects 50+ financial institutions across 20+ markets and serves thousands of cross-border SMEs. https://www.bpn.finance/


Role Overview

This is a hybrid role combining Financial Institution Business Development and Merchant Acquiring. We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in Latin American payments who deeply understands the banking and payment ecosystems in Brazil, Mexico and Argentina, with an established senior network across banks, PSPs, acquirers, fintechs and other financial institutions.


You should be equally comfortable sitting with the CEO of a local payment institution to structure a strategic partnership and sitting with a large merchant or PSP to win payment volume.


The mandate is simple:

Build the network, bring the flow, and turn LatAm into a meaningful revenue and profit center for BPN.


What You Will Own

1) Financial Institution Network

  • Develop and own BPN’s FI network across Latin America, with an initial focus on Brazil, Mexico and Argentina.
  • Build strategic relationships with banks, PSPs, acquirers, VASPs and other licensed financial institutions.
  • Identify the strongest local partners for collection, payout, FX and stablecoin settlement.
  • Structure partnerships covering commercial terms, use cases, pricing and expected payment flows.
  • Maintain senior-level relationships and develop BPN into a meaningful strategic partner rather than another payment vendor.


2) Merchant Acquiring & Volume Growth

  • Build and own the LatAm merchant acquisition strategy.
  • Directly originate large merchants and payment flows, particularly across e-commerce, cross-border trade and logistics.
  • Develop relationships with marketplaces, exporters/importers, merchant aggregators and PSPs with meaningful payment volume.
  • Convert BPN’s network capabilities into concrete merchant propositions and scalable payment corridors.
  • Own pipeline quality, conversion, activation and ultimately TPV and revenue, not simply signed partnerships.


3) Commercial & P&L Ownership

  • This is not a partnership role measured by the number of logos signed.
  • You will be expected to understand the full economics of the business — including pricing, FX, liquidity, partner costs and contribution margin — and make commercial decisions accordingly.
  • Candidates who have previously owned a country, regional or business-line P&L are strongly preferred.


What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years in payments, fintech, banking, acquiring or cross-border payments in Latin America.
  • Deep first-hand knowledge of the Brazilian, Mexican and Argentine banking and payment ecosystems.
  • Strong existing senior network across banks, PSPs, acquirers, fintechs and major merchants.
  • Proven ability to originate and close complex FI partnerships.
  • Strong merchant acquiring track record with demonstrable payment volume.
  • Particularly strong exposure to e-commerce, cross-border trade, logistics or B2B payments.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to understand payment economics, FX and margin.
  • Experience managing teams and senior external stakeholders.
  • Fluent professional English; Portuguese and/or Spanish strongly preferred.


Strong Plus

  • Previous country/regional GM or P&L ownership.
  • Experience building a payments business or market from an early stage.
  • Deep knowledge of local payment rails such as Pix and SPEI, local acquiring and alternative payment methods.
  • Experience in stablecoins, crypto payments, cross-border FX or treasury.
  • Existing relationships with major LatAm e-commerce platforms, exporters/importers and payment aggregators.


What Success Looks Like

  • We are not looking for someone whose strength is simply having a large network.
  • The right person knows which institutions matter, which merchants control meaningful flow, what commercial proposition will move that flow, and how to turn relationships into sustainable revenue.
  • You will have significant ownership over BPN’s Latin America strategy and will work directly with the Founder & CEO to determine where and with whom the network expands.
  • This role reports directly to the Founder & CEO.

Location: Singapore

3K Construction Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based electrical engineering company with a strong focus on EV charging infrastructure. Beyond EV charger installation, supply, and maintenance across leading AC and DC brands, we also undertake broader electrical works including commercial fit-out projects. We serve property developers, MCSTs, main contractors, and corporate/fleet clients, and are expanding into Charge Point Operator (CPO) and Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS) models. We're looking for a Sales Engineer who can bridge technical know-how with business development to grow our footprint across both EV charging and general electrical works.


Role Overview

You will own the full sales cycle for EV charging and electrical projects — from lead generation and site assessment, through technical proposal development, to contract closing and handover to the project team. This role sits at the intersection of sales, engineering, and project coordination, working closely with property management (MCSTs, building management), main contractors, and corporate/fleet clients.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Sales

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across EV charging and general electrical works (e.g. commercial fit-out projects) with property management corporations (MCSTs), building owners, main contractors, and corporate/fleet operators
  • ⁠Develop and present CPO/CaaS proposals, including revenue-share models and commercial terms
  • ⁠Prepare quotations and tenders for electrical works packages, working with main contractors and project teams on scope, pricing, and timelines
  • ⁠Manage the end-to-end sales pipeline: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, and closing

Technical Pre-Sales

  • ⁠Work with the engineering team to size systems and recommend appropriate AC/DC charger configurations
  • ⁠Prepare technical proposals, cost estimates, and single line diagrams (SLDs) in coordination with internal engineering
  • ⁠Address client questions on charger specifications, compliance (e.g. LTA requirements), and safety features


Project Coordination

  • Act as the client-facing point of contact from proposal through installation
  • ⁠Coordinate with internal technical and operations teams to ensure smooth project handover and delivery timelines
  • ⁠Support after-sales relationship management, including maintenance contract renewals and upsell opportunities


Requirements

  • ⁠Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

  • ⁠Excellent communication, negotiation, and proposal-writing skills
  • ⁠Self-driven, comfortable managing a full sales cycle with minimal supervision


Nice to Have

  • ⁠Existing network within property management, MCST, or fleet/corporate sectors
  • ⁠Experience reading or interpreting electrical drawings/SLDs
  • ⁠Valid driving license (site visits across Singapore)


What We Offer

  • ⁠Direct exposure to CPO/CaaS business model development
  • Performance-based incentives on top of base salary
  • Small, agile team with room to grow into a leadership role as the business scales

99e94dab3651575033bfcb577e841198.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
99e94dab3651575033bfcb577e841198.snippet:
Looking to take your digital marketing career to a whole new level? Then this role is for you!


First Page is a global digital marketing firm that transforms the way companies do business online. Since 2011 our mission has been to create amazing digital experiences by implementing game-changing digital strategies. As APAC’s highest-rated digital agency, First Page has seen insane growth and won numerous awards over the past 3 years.


The Opportunity: Be the Engine for Client Growth

We are currently undertaking a major strategic evolution: shifting from a defensive strategy of minimizing client loss to an offensive strategy of “Net Zero Churn.”


Search itself is evolving just as fast. Clients no longer just want to rank on Google, they want to be the answer that shows up in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Google’s AI-driven results. We're looking for a Strategic SEO Account Manager who can own that full spectrum: classic SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).


This is not just a passive reporting role. You will be the commercial owner of your portfolio, responsible for achieving a Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate of >100%. You will transform our Account Management function from a service centre into a proactive profit centre, acting as a business consultant who connects search visibility across traditional and AI-driven channels directly to our clients’ bottom line.


Key Responsibilities

1. Commercial Ownership & NRR Growth

  • Own the Portfolio P&L: You are responsible for the financial health of your client base. Your primary KPI is achieving 100%+ Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by balancing retention (Gross Revenue Retention) with aggressive expansion revenue.
  • Proactive Expansion: Systematically identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You will use data signals (e.g., high traffic/low conversion, strong SEO rankings but low AI-answer visibility) to pitch solutions like AEO/GEO or unexpected growth in one channel to diversify into others (e.g., SEO to Paid Social, or SEO to GEO).
  • Productised Selling: Leverage our service tiers and add-on modules, including our AEO and GEO packages, to reduce sales friction and constantly upgrade client engagements.


2. Search & AI Visibility Strategy

  • SEO Foundations: Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO strategy for your portfolio, site health, content strategy, keyword targeting, and authority building.
  • Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Structure and optimise client content so it is surfaced directly in AI Overviews, featured snippets, People Also Ask, and voice search results. Winning the answer, not just the click.
  • Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Improve how clients are represented, cited and recommended inside generative engines such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot. Through structured data, entity and brand authority building, and third-party citation strategy.
  • New Metrics, New Story: Track and report on emerging visibility metrics, such as share of voice in AI answers, citation frequency, and brand mention sentiment, alongside traditional rankings and organic traffic.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Brief and align internal SEO, content and technical teams so that SEO, AEO and GEO workstreams move as one integrated strategy rather than three separate services.


3. Strategic Consultancy & ROI Communication

  • C-Level Business Partnership: Move beyond day-to-day execution updates. You must understand your client’s business model, revenue targets, and competitive landscape.
  • High-Value QBRs: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews that function as strategic workshops, not just past-performance reports. You will set future goals and align the roadmap across SEO, AEO and GEO with the client’s 12-month business objectives.
  • Translate Metrics to Money: You will stop reporting on “clicks” and start reporting on business impact. You must be able to calculate and articulate ROI, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) to CFOs and CEOs. Including the commercial case for investing in AI-driven visibility.


4. Client Health & Retention

  • Early Warning System: Monitor leading indicators of churn (e.g., declining engagement, change in stakeholders, drops in AI-answer visibility) and intervene proactively before a cancellation request is made.
  • Account Value Vision: Create and maintain a 12–24 month “Value Vision” roadmap for every key account ensuring the client always sees the next step in our partnership.


What We Need from You

Experience & Skills

  • 3+ Years in Digital Agency or SaaS Customer Success: proven experience managing high-value portfolios. Experience with NRR/Net Retention targets is a massive plus.
  • Search Expertise: solid grounding in traditional SEO, plus genuine curiosity about or hands-on exposure to AEO and GEO, structured data/schema markup, entity-based SEO, and how generative engines source and cite content.
  • Consultative Sales DNA: You are comfortable negotiating contracts, discussing budgets, and “asking for the sale” when you know it will help the client succeed.
  • Financial Literacy: You understand how businesses make money. You can calculate margin, ROI, and CAC/LTV ratios and explain them simply.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: You don’t just export PDF reports. You analyse data from GA4, SEMrush, and CRM to find the “insight” and the “opportunity” hidden in the numbers.
  • Comfortable Working With LLMs: Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) in your day-to-day workflow is a strong plus, whether for research, content drafting, data analysis, or client reporting. At minimum, you’re genuinely open to adopting LLM-assisted workflows as part of the role.


Mindset

  • Offensive, Not Defensive: You don’t wait for a client to complain to fix a problem. You actively seek ways to improve their business.
  • Forward-Looking: You track how search is changing and get genuinely excited about helping clients win in AI-driven discovery, not just classic Google rankings.
  • Radical Transparency: You believe in sharing real-time performance dashboards and having difficult conversations early to build trust.


Why Join Us?

  • Performance-Based Compensation: Competitive base salary + a significant variable commission structure tied directly to your Portfolio Expansion and NRR targets.
  • Career Trajectory: Be part of the team leading this strategic agency transformation, and helping define what SEO/AEO/GEO account management looks like at First Page.


Benefits at First Page

  • Flexible work arrangements & great office culture
  • Guaranteed yearly salary increment
  • Dental & Medical benefits
  • ClassPass gym access & wellness sessions
  • Birthday cakes and celebrations
  • In-house company-wide training
  • Monthly team building events
  • Structured rapid career progression

Coordinate UAT activities with business users, including test planning, execution, defect tracking, and sign-off. Analyse defects, clarify expected system behaviour, and support defect prioritisation and resolution. Verify that delivered solutions meet agreed business and functional requirements before deployment. Requirements

Good understanding of the end-to-end SDLC. Hands-on experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect management. Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and documentation skills. Ability to effectively bridge business requirements and technical implementation.

As search evolves beyond traditional search engines into AI-powered discovery and generative search, we are strengthening our capabilities across both SEO and GEO.


We are looking for an experienced SEO & GEO Lead to lead our SEO/GEO team, strengthen our established SEO practice, and contribute to the continued development of our GEO and AI Search capabilities.

As the SEO & GEO Lead, you will own the overall quality, strategic direction and development of Verz’s SEO/GEO practice.


You will lead and develop the SEO/GEO team, oversee strategies across a diverse client portfolio, support complex and underperforming campaigns, work closely with Digital Marketing Account Managers, and contribute to client retention, account growth and new business opportunities.


You will also play an important role in evolving our GEO and AI Search capabilities as search behaviour and discovery continue to change.


This is a leadership role requiring strong strategic and technical SEO expertise, people leadership, client-facing ability, analytical thinking and commercial judgement. Hands-on GEO/AEO experience is preferred, but extensive years of formal GEO experience are not required.

SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Diagnose underperforming campaigns and guide clear optimisation and recovery strategies.
  • Guide GEO/AEO strategies covering prompt research, AI visibility, citation/source analysis, content optimisation, entities, topical authority and third-party signals.
  • Set strategic priorities and quality standards across the SEO/GEO client portfolio.
  • Evaluate emerging search technologies, AI platforms and tools, and translate relevant developments into practical strategies for the team and clients.


Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor and develop SEO/GEO Specialists, Coordinators and junior team members.
  • Set clear priorities, responsibilities, accountability and quality expectations.
  • Review strategies, audits and recommendations while coaching team members towards stronger solutions rather than simply taking over execution.
  • Identify capability and knowledge gaps and develop relevant training, documentation and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, performance development and resource planning.
  • Build scalable team capabilities and reduce dependency on individual team members.


Client & Campaign Leadership

  • Work closely with Digital Marketing Account Managers to ensure SEO/GEO strategies support clients’ broader business and marketing objectives.
  • Act as the senior SEO/GEO subject-matter expert for strategic accounts, escalations and complex campaign challenges.
  • Participate in client reviews and strategic discussions where senior SEO/GEO expertise is required.
  • Monitor overall portfolio performance and proactively identify risks, opportunities and areas requiring intervention.
  • Ensure campaign reporting provides meaningful insights, business context and clear next steps.
  • Drive strong client satisfaction, retention and renewals by working with Account Managers to identify performance risks and long-term account growth opportunities.


Business, Service Development & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to grow the SEO/GEO portfolio through renewals, GEO adoption, account expansion and relevant cross-service opportunities.
  • Develop and improve SEO/GEO methodologies, service packages, SOPs, workflows and quality standards.
  • Evaluate and test new SEO, GEO, AI visibility, analytics and automation tools to improve campaign performance and team efficiency.
  • Stay updated on search engine and AI developments, and translate relevant changes into practical strategies, training and processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement of Verz’s own SEO/GEO visibility, authority and qualified inbound lead generation.


What Success Looks Like

  • Strengthen client retention, satisfaction and long-term account growth.
  • Deliver measurable SEO/GEO improvements aligned with clients’ visibility, qualified traffic, leads, conversions and broader business objectives.
  • Grow the SEO/GEO portfolio through renewals, GEO adoption, account expansion and strategic support for new opportunities.
  • Build a high-performing SEO/GEO team with strong campaign quality, accountability, technical capability and strategic thinking.
  • Proactively improve underperforming campaigns and overall portfolio health.
  • Strengthen Verz’s own SEO and GEO performance, contributing to greater market authority, AI/search visibility and qualified inbound leads.
  • Continuously improve our SEO/GEO methodologies, tools, processes and service capabilities as search and AI platforms evolve.


Qualifications

About Aleph

Aleph was founded by engineers who lived a problem firsthand: solving operational issues in asset-intensive industries required deep domain expertise that was scarce, impossible to scale, and locked inside the heads of a handful of experienced people. There was no product that captured this knowledge and made it available on demand. So we built one. Aleph is an AI agent platform trained on the physics, chemistry, and operational knowledge specific to each industry we serve, giving engineers and operators across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, utilities, aviation, and logistics the capability to troubleshoot faster, optimise continuously, and make better decisions without being limited by the availability of human expertise.


We are pre-Series A-funded, Singapore-based, and at an early but decisive commercial stage, with customers across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. We are scaling toward Series A and building toward a future where every engineer and operator in asset-intensive industry has an AI agent trained to their domain. This is a large, largely untouched problem. The companies that solve it will define a category. We intend to be one of them.


The Role

This is a high-ownership commercial role sitting directly under the CEO. You will own how Aleph grows: the channels we sell through, the price we charge, the partnerships we build, and the story we tell investors as we raise our Series A.


Aleph has proven that the product works and that enterprise customers will pay for it. The next phase is converting that proof into a repeatable commercial engine. You are the person who builds it. You will work alongside the CEO on every commercial decision that matters, and you will be expected to lead the execution rather than wait for direction.


Roles and Responsibilities


1. Growth and Commercial Strategy

  • Identify, build, and manage new go-to-market and sales channels end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to activating the channel and driving measurable revenue through it
  • Own the land and expand motion alongside the CEO: our enterprise customers operate twenty to forty facilities each, and growing from one site to many is the single largest revenue lever we have
  • Develop and continuously improve Aleph's pricing model, packaging, and contract structure across customer segments; identify where Aleph is leaving money on the table and build the commercial mechanisms to close those gaps
  • Build and manage partnerships as a route to market: identify system integrators, distributors, and industry bodies that multiply Aleph's commercial reach, structure the economics, and manage the relationships to drive revenue
  • Identify which product outcomes drive retention and expansion among existing customers, and feed those signals back into the sales motion to improve win rates
  • Own Aleph's competitive positioning: track the landscape, understand how Aleph is perceived against alternatives, and continuously sharpen how we are priced, packaged, and positioned


2. Commercial and Partnership Execution

  • Join the CEO in enterprise and C-suite customer meetings, partner discussions, and commercial negotiations as an active contributor
  • Map buying committees at large enterprise accounts: identify decision makers, build internal champions, and design the path to organisation-wide adoption
  • Own the commercial pipeline operationally: forecasting, conversion tracking, and reporting against targets
  • Build and maintain proposals, commercial materials, and sales playbooks that make the motion repeatable as the team grows
  • Drive outbound and channel-led lead generation in support of revenue targets


3. Fundraising and Finance Support

  • Own the Series A preparation process operationally: data room build and maintenance, financial modelling, KPI dashboards, and due diligence coordination
  • Own financial planning and analysis: build and maintain the operating model, track burn and runway against plan, and flag variances early enough to act on them
  • Own the commercial and financial reporting cadence to the CEO and board: revenue, pipeline conversion, unit economics, and the metrics that determine whether Aleph hits its Series A milestones
  • Prepare investor-ready materials, supporting analysis, and the metrics story behind the raise
  • Manage the investor update cadence: monthly and quarterly updates to existing investors, board observers, and warm prospects
  • Research and qualify target investors for Series A, including financial VCs, corporate VCs, and strategic investors aligned with our expansion across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe


Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone commercially sharp and genuinely hands-on. You have sold, priced, partnered, or built a channel yourself. You can build a model and also sit in the room when the deal is negotiated. You are equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and in front of a plant director who has been doing the job for twenty years.


Requirements

  • 6 to 7 years of working experience in a B2B or enterprise technology environment, with direct involvement in growth, go-to-market, commercial strategy, or enterprise sales
  • Hands-on commercial experience: you have built or managed a sales channel, a pricing model, or a partnership, rather than only analysing one
  • Experience working closely with founders or senior leadership, with a track record of driving outcomes independently
  • Strong financial literacy: you can build and interrogate a commercial model, understand unit economics, and speak credibly about business performance to investors
  • Comfort in enterprise sales environments with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, and procurement-heavy buyers
  • Strong written and verbal communication: you can distil complex commercial information into a clear narrative for customers, partners, and investors
  • High ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity: you identify what needs to be done and do it

Alternatively

  • 2 to 3 years in investment banking, venture capital, or strategy consulting, followed by at least 4 years in a B2B tech startup in a commercial, growth, or strategy role where you owned outcomes independently
  • The structured background gives you modelling rigour and investor communication skills. The startup years mean you have already operated without the scaffolding.


Good to Have

  • Background in or exposure to asset-intensive industries including chemicals, pharmaceuticals, utilities, aviation, or logistics
  • Experience supporting or running a fundraising process from seed to Series A
  • Experience selling or partnering into large enterprise accounts across multiple geographies


Who This Role Is Not For

  • Someone who wants to build the strategy and hand the execution to someone else
  • Someone who needs a senior commercial leader above them to validate their work before it goes out
  • Someone who has only worked in large organisations and has never had to build something from scratch


What We Offer

  • Direct partnership with the founding team on every commercial decision that shapes the company
  • Meaningful equity with a standard vesting schedule, reflecting genuine skin in the game as we build toward Series A and beyond
  • Full ownership of how Aleph grows, at a company with real customers, real revenue, and a clear path to Series A
  • A small, high-calibre team with no bureaucracy, no politics, and complete clarity on what matters
  • A clear growth path into senior commercial leadership, such as Director of Strategy & Growth and Chief Operating Officer, as Aleph scales

This is a new foundational role responsible not only for delivering high-impact analytics and machine learning solutions, but also for helping establishing the data science function, standards, and roadmap. As the first data science hire in the region, you will play a critical role in driving digital transformation across wafer fabrication, assembly, and test operations. This role requires a balance of deep technical expertise, manufacturing domain awareness, and strong stakeholder engagement across multiple fabs and business units. You will deliver high-impact use cases while building a scalable data science foundation to support smart manufacturing, yield improvement, and operational excellence


Essential Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the data science and AI strategy aligned with business priorities by partnering with process, equipment, and integration engineering teams to operationalize insights and drive adoption of data-driven decisions
  • Establish best practices for data collection, preparation, modeling, and deployment including development of scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and integration of manufacturing, sensor, and tool data
  • Develop models to solve manufacturing challenges, such as:
  • Predictive maintenance
  • Yield/quality optimization
  • Demand forecasting
  • Process optimization
  • Apply statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI techniques to generate actionable insights
  • Drive AI/ML Adoption in Manufacturing using existing internal tools and identifying additional platform to Industrial IoT analytics, Computer vision, and Optimization algorithms for scheduling
  • Define success metrics (yield improvement, cycle time reduction, equipment uptime, cost savings) and track measurable ROI of data science initiatives
  • Design, deploy, and maintain production-grade machine learning models (MLOps), including monitoring model performance, drift detection, and lifecycle management


Other Responsibilities

  • Promote a data-driven culture across the organization
  • Identify and advocate for scalable data platforms and tools (cloud, IoT, edge analytics where applicable)
  • Collaborate with IT engineering to: (i) Define data architecture and pipelines; and (ii) Improve data quality and accessibility


Skills and Competencies Profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 5–8+ years of experience in data science or machine learning (experience in semiconductor or manufacturing strongly preferred)
  • Strong programming skills in Python, R (or similar)
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
  • Expertise in data analysis, statistical process control, and experimental design (e.g. DOE)
  • Knowledge and experience with time-series analysis (sensor, machine data); predictive maintenance models, and process optimization frameworks
  • Experience working with large datasets and data wrangling
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Able to communicate effectively across functions and work well with different departments

e2af40f2027d859ad4f4ca64fc8f2b5b.title: Senior/ AI Scientist - Hiring across various levels
e2af40f2027d859ad4f4ca64fc8f2b5b.snippet:
Our client is a product-focused technology company building large-scale AI systems that power personalized discovery and search for its global user base. The team is now scaling its core AI capabilities to redefine how users find, discover, and engage with content.


You will work on core AI that powers what millions of users see, search, and engage with daily. This is not a service role - this is a core product AI role with direct impact on user metrics, retention, and revenue.


What You Will Do:

1. AI Model Development & Research:

  • Design, develop, and deploy state-of-the-art ML/DL models for Recommendations, Ranking, Search Relevance, Query Understanding, and User Personalization.
  • Work across the full ML lifecycle: problem formulation, data exploration, feature engineering, model training, offline evaluation, online A/B testing, and production deployment.
  • Build models for Learning-to-Rank (LTR), Two-tower retrieval, Collaborative Filtering, Sequential Recommendations (SASRec, BERT4Rec), Click-Through-Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR) prediction.


2. Search & Recommendations Systems:

  • Improve search relevance, auto-complete, query rewriting, spell correction, and semantic search using LLMs and vector embeddings.
  • Develop personalized recommendation systems for feed, content discovery, and user-to-user / user-to-item matching.
  • Optimize for multiple objectives: relevance, diversity, freshness, fairness, and long-term user engagement.


3. GenAI & LLM Integration:

  • Apply LLMs, RAG, and embedding models to enhance search understanding and recommendation explainability.
  • Fine-tune foundation models for domain-specific tasks like intent classification, content understanding, and conversational search.
  • Evaluate LLMs for latency, cost, and quality trade-offs for large-scale production.


4. Data & Engineering Excellence:

  • Work with massive scale datasets (user behavior, content, graph data) and collaborate with Data & ML Platform teams.
  • Define and track key metrics: NDCG, MAP, Precision@K, Recall, AUC, engagement, retention.
  • Write production-grade code in Python and work with ML frameworks - PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Spark, Ray.


What We Are Looking For (Must-Have):

  • Education: MS / PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Mathematics or related field. Exceptional Bachelors with strong product experience will also be considered.
  • Experience: 2-12 years in Applied ML / AI Scientist roles in a product-based tech company.
  • Core ML Skills: Strong fundamentals in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Recommender Systems.
  • Tech Stack: Expert in Python, SQL, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn. Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, FAISS) and big data tools (Spark, Hive).
  • Proven Impact: Hands-on experience building and shipping models for at least one of: Search Ranking/Relevance, Recommendations/Personalization, User Search/Intent, Ads Ranking.
  • Evaluation: Strong understanding of offline and online experimentation, A/B testing, and causal inference.


Highly Preferred / Differentiators:

  • Publications at top conferences - NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, SIGIR, RecSys, WWW, ACL
  • Experience with multi-stage ranking architecture (Retrieval -> Pre-rank -> Rank -> Re-rank)
  • Experience with LLMs for search (query embeddings, dense retrieval, E5, Contriever)
  • Experience optimizing for low-latency inference at scale (model quantization, distillation, ONNX/TensorRT)
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or Kaggle Grandmaster/Master level

About the team

We partner closely with leaders across regions to build high‑performing, engaged teams and a consistent employee experience. From hiring and onboarding to performance, development, operations, and workplace experience, we focus on practical, high‑impact work that supports our business and our people as we grow.


Role overview (this is a 7-month contract role)

As our Senior People Operations Partner in Singapore, you will be the on‑the‑ground owner for day‑to‑day people operations across our SEA &EA regions. You will run the core HR operations rhythm across the full employee lifecycle, work with the payroll team to provide payroll inputs and HR governance in partnership with our payroll provider and internal stakeholders, and ensure our local processes stay compliant, accurate and scalable as we grow. You will also be required to continuously seek to improve our processes and/or automate processes.

You’ll partner with SEA & EA leaders and our global People & Talent teams, including our Shared Service Centre team to deliver both global and local people programs—making sure they land in a way that works for our SEA&EA team. This is a hands‑on role with a high degree of ownership in a fast‑growing environment.


What you’ll be doing

Day‑to‑day SEA & EA people operations

  • Own day‑to‑day people operations for our SEA & EA entity across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, changes and offboarding in HR System, payroll platforms and related tools.
  • Maintain high data integrity in our HR systems and trackers; ensure changes are processed accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate with various functions and managers to ensure a smooth experience for new joiners, internal moves and exits.

Payroll coordination and HR governance

  • Coordinate monthly SEA & EA payroll operations end‑to‑end in partnership with payroll vendor and Finance, including managing inputs (new joiners, exits, changes, allowances, variable pay), reviewing draft reports, and resolving discrepancies.
  • Ensure pay, tax, CPF, and other statutory components are calculated and processed correctly and on time.
  • Maintain strong HR governance for SEA &EA region operationalising employment policies, templates and controls (contracts, letters, checklists, approvals, audit trails).
  • Partner with Legal, Finance and global People Ops on entity‑related changes, audits and compliance requirements.

Manager and employee support

  • Act as the day‑to‑day People Operations contact for managers across various regions and employees on topics such as contracts and letters, leave and scheduling, probation administration, data changes, and use of People tools.
  • Provide clear, practical guidance that balances employee experience, compliance and operational feasibility.
  • Escalate higher‑risk or complex cases to People Partners and Legal as appropriate, while owning follow‑through.

Global and local people programs

  • Localise and deliver global and regional people programs in SEA & EA (e.g. performance and feedback cycles in Lattice, manager training, benefits changes, HR systems changes).
  • Support initiatives on our SEA & EA People & Talent roadmap, such as wellbeing benefits administration, automation projects and process improvements projects
  • Partner with the Workplace Experience team to ensure people programs and events are operationalised smoothly.

Process improvement and scaling

  • Build and refine standard operating procedures, checklists and controls for SEA & EA HR operations, especially in the context of ongoing scaling.
  • Spot recurring issues or failure points in processes and work with global People Ops and Systems teams to improve workflows, templates or automation with AI
  • Use tools (AI/Sheets/Excel, HRIS exports, basic reporting) to monitor data quality, payroll accuracy and adherence to timelines.


Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but not mandatory.


Minimum qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in HR / People Operations or HR Generalist roles, including direct ownership of day‑to‑day HR operations for a SEA & EA employee population.
  • Hands‑on experience coordinating SEA & EA payroll with an in‑house or outsourced provider, including managing monthly inputs, validating outputs and resolvingpayroll‑related employee queries.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEA & EA employment fundamentals, such as offer / contract structures, salary components, leave and time‑off rules, and core statutory requirements
  • Demonstrated experience working in a fast‑growing or high‑change environment where headcount and processes evolve quickly, with comfort balancing execution detail against changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing process improvements and automation solutions within People Operations to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and build scalable processes.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to improve People Operations processes, enhance employee experience, and drive greater efficiency and effectiveness. Experience identifying and implementing practical AI use cases within HR/People Operations is highly desirable.
  • High attention to detail, strong organisation and follow‑through, and proven ability to run recurring operational cycles (payroll, onboarding, offboarding, data updates) alongside ad hoc requests.
  • Confident using HR and people systems (HRIS, payroll, performance tools) and Google Workspace, with the ability to learn new tools quickly and spot data or process issues in exports and reports.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain HR operations and policies clearly to managers and employees.


Preferred qualifications

  • Exposure to building or improving HR governance frameworks, including SOPs, controls and documentation for a new or scaling entity.
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of ownership as the on‑the‑ground People Operations contact for a growing hub, including liaising directly with external partners (e.g. payroll, benefits, insurance providers) to troubleshoot and improve processes.

0927d99feeb1c684686f9d02f08b9dfe.snippet:
About Axiler

Axiler is an AI-native application security startup building Athena, a platform that orchestrates SAST, DAST, SCA, and WAF into a unified detection-to-remediation pipeline. Athena applies Bayesian confidence scoring, NLP-driven CWE normalization, and reachability analysis to cut through vulnerability noise and route fixes to the right place, automatically. We work with enterprise clients in regulated industries where the cost of a missed vulnerability is not abstract.

Role Overview

You are the technical lead in Athena's pre-sales and proof-of-value motion. You understand how real AppSec stacks are built, where they break down, and how to demonstrate concretely why correlation and AI-driven prioritization change the equation. You can speak to a CISO about business risk and then sit with a security engineer and walk through CWE taxonomy, WAF rule logic, or SAST false positive rates in the same afternoon.

What You Will Do
  • Lead technical discovery with enterprise prospects to map their current AppSec toolchain and identify where Athena's correlation layer plugs in
  • Scope, deploy, and document proof-of-value engagements, configuring Athena against the client's existing security tooling across SAST, DAST, SCA, and WAF
  • Demonstrate Athena's seven-stage correlation pipeline to technical audiences, including CWE normalization, reachability gating, Bayesian confidence scoring, and virtual patch generation
  • Translate PoV findings into business-language outputs for CISOs and CROs, covering false positive reduction, priority rank accuracy, and WAF rule coverage
  • Build and maintain integration playbooks for Athena's connector catalog across issue trackers, CI/CD pipelines, compliance platforms, and communication tools
  • Represent Athena's ML-driven prioritization model credibly to security-sophisticated buyers, explaining how Bayesian scoring combines CVSS, reachability, and business context signals
  • Feed structured client feedback to the product team, particularly around correlation edge cases and connector gaps
What We Are Looking For
  • 3 to 5 years in application security engineering, DevSecOps, or AppSec pre-sales
  • Hands-on experience operating or evaluating SAST, DAST, SCA, and WAF tooling in enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of CWE taxonomy, OWASP Top 10, and how vulnerability classes map across detection tool categories
  • Familiarity with how ML-based prioritization models work conceptually, including scoring signals, confidence thresholds, and false positive tradeoffs
  • Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical executives through risk framing rather than raw severity counts
  • Exposure to CI/CD security gates and how AppSec integrates into developer workflows
Nice to Have
  • Experience with PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 compliance workflows in a banking or fintech context
  • Familiarity with WAF virtual patching workflows and rule generation logic
  • Prior work with AI-assisted triage or security automation tooling
  • Understanding of reachability analysis or taint tracking in SAST


Location: Singapore (Hybrid) Type: Full-time

Solution Engineering

projects.

or equivalent practical experience.

  • 1-3 years of experience in event management, marketing, experiential marketing, consumer marketing or a related field.

  • Strong organisational skills

Having an interest in Weddings, Interior Design, Pets, Korean Wave, Travel, Kids and Fitness events is a plus point.

We have a healthy company culture, and a very cohesive team. One of our key value of running consumers events are exceeding creativity expectation and visitors experience We are currently the top consumer event company in the verticals that we organise and will continue to excel.

About Us


Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.


Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.


We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.


Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.


We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.


About the Role


We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling narratives that compel buyers and enable sales teams. You'll own product areas and strategic go-to-market initiatives end to end, working in close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams.


This is a highly cross-functional and strategic role that blends storytelling, market insight, go-to-market strategy and execution to fuel growth and improve conversions.


What You’ll Do



  • Messaging and Positioning: Develop and maintain product-level messaging and positioning. Translate what Canary builds into language that resonates with specific personas, tailoring it to SMB, mid-market, and enterprise audiences.

  • Sales Assets: Build the sales and marketing assets that clearly communicates Canary’s value and differentiation that resonates for each stage of the marketing funnel. Understand from the Sales and Customer Support teams what’s working and what improvements are needed to improve how we communicate with customers and prospects.

  • Storytelling and Content: Craft engaging and persuasive presentations including sales decks, webinars, and presentations in collaboration with growth, partner, and content marketers.

  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a working understanding of the competitive landscape in your product areas. Know how competitors position, what claims they make, and where Canary wins and loses.

  • Data and Analysis: Utilize data to measure the success of go-to-market initiatives, marketing campaigns, and product adoption, reporting on key metrics and providing actionable insights for optimization.


What We’re Looking For



  • +5 years of product marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment

  • Strong communicator, both internally as well as to the market. You are a strong writer and visual storyteller able to communicate complex topics in a simple, digestible way.

  • Comfort working with data and deriving actionable insights — you measure the impact of your work and use that to make better decisions

  • Experience bringing new products to market

  • A high quality bar for external assets — you know what \"ship-ready\" looks like and won't submit something half-finished

  • Strong cross-functional instincts — you work well with product, sales, and design without needing heavy coordination overhead; you’re able to effectively influence without direct authority

  • Preferred: Management consulting experience, hospitality and/or travel tech experience, and multi-product, platform, and AI products experience.


Perks & Benefits


We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:


Time Off



  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.

  • Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.

  • Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!


Travel & Office Flexibility



  • Office Exchange: A travel stipend to visit the team in person at our SF, NY, or Dallas hubs.

  • Canary Hotel Experience: Staying at a Canary hotel? We’ve got you covered with a credit toward your stay.

  • Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.


Growth & Community



  • Self Improvement Club: A monthly budget to help you smash your personal goals.

  • Professional Development: Level up your career with a dedicated learning stipend to fuel your skills and cross-functional connection.

  • Referral Program: Help us grow the flock and score a cash bonus for successful hires.

Working closely with Product, Sales, Business Development, Compliance and Marketing teams, you will ensure our products are positioned effectively for target customers and markets.

Position Summary

This role is responsible for driving market share, revenue and profitability for the Digital Appliances business. It leads product line-up, lifecycle and pricing strategies to expand market coverage, maximise sales opportunities and minimise business risks, while coordinating cross-functional execution to achieve business targets.

Role And Responsibilities

Business and Growth Strategy

  • Develop and execute product and growth strategies to achieve sales, profitability, API and market-share targets.
  • Translate market insights and business priorities into action plans across products, channels and customer segments.
  • Identify new opportunities to strengthen competitiveness and market leadership.

Market-Share Management

  • Monitor market share, sell-out performance, competitor activities and consumer trends.
  • Identify performance gaps and recommend timely countermeasures to defend or grow market share.
  • Track results and refine action plans to improve effectiveness.

Line-up and Portfolio Management

  • Develop and manage the product portfolio to maximise market coverage, competitiveness and efficiency.

  • Conduct competitive benchmarking to identify portfolio gaps and differentiation opportunities.

Launch and Go-to-Market Management

  • Lead product launches, including timelines, target volumes, pricing, profitability and channel plans.
  • Define the product proposition, target audience and communication priorities.
  • Partner Brand and Retail Marketing on campaigns, displays, launch readiness and in-store execution.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Coordinate Sales, Marketing, Retail, Online, Supply Chain, Finance, Service and other relevant functions.
  • Establish clear priorities, ownership, timelines and deliverables.
  • Manage business reviews, resolve issues and ensure consistent execution across channels.

Pricing and Profitability Management

  • Develop pricing strategies by segment, model and channel.
  • Conduct regular pricing reviews and recommend responses to market changes.
  • Assess the profit-and-loss impact of pricing and promotional decisions.

Sales Forecasting and Supply Management

  • Work with Sales and Supply Chain teams to establish and review weekly forecasts.
  • Monitor stock availability, sell-in, sell-out, weeks of stock and ageing inventory.
  • Recommend corrective actions to support sales and inventory objectives.

End-of-Life Management

  • Establish product discontinuation timelines and transition plans.
  • Manage inventory clearance to minimise ageing and obsolete stock.
  • Ensure smooth model transitions and continued market coverage.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
  • Resourceful, sharp-minded and solution-oriented.
  • Positive, resilient and willing to take on challenges.
  • Committed, accountable and able to work independently.
  • Strong ability to prioritise, multitask and meet timelines.
