Responsibilities


Team Introduction


TikTok Pangle is TikTok's exclusive Ad Network, currently available in nearly 50 markets. TikTok Pangle empowers advertisers to extend their reach beyond TikTok by accessing top local publishers through trusted, intelligent and performance-driven advertising solutions. TikTok Pangle has established an industry-leading Ad Network in 20+ emerging markets, with proven success in Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America.


The Pangle Product Strategy & Operations (PSO) team is part of the Global Monetization Product & Technology (GMPT) organization and has a strong advertiser focus and a dedication to technical excellence. We work with advertisers from all verticals, regional business teams, TikTok product pillar counterparts, and Pangle headquarters product and tech teams, aiming to deliver highly efficient advertising solutions to drive TikTok for Business performance ads revenue growth.


Responsibilities



  • Own the Go-To-Market Strategy to drive overall adoption of Smart+ auto-placement and unlock scalable business growth.

  • Design, manage, and execute Pangle GTM programs in collaboration with HQ and regional teams, ensuring successful and sustainable scaling of Smart+auto-placement across all Pangle markets.

  • Develop compelling, audience-centric product marketing content and data insights to strengthen sales effectiveness and build advertiser confidence in adopting Smart+auto-placement solutions

  • Monitor and report ongoing progress and business impact to key stakeholders on a regular basis.

  • Identify product gaps and growth opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis, and recommend improvements in close partnership with HQ vertical and regional teams.

  • Lead and drive product marketing initiative on TikTok Ad Network Placement module iterations, partnering closely with the platform product team to shape strategy, inform roadmap decisions, and ensure successful product rollout.


Qualifications


Minimum Qualification(s)



  • Bachelor's degree or above, minimum 3 years of experience in the internet industry, preferably with experience in product marketing or strategy operations

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin, with the ability to communicate fluently and professionally with English and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders. This role has a global scope supporting all Pangle markets, including the China Outbound (CNOB) business. It requires frequent coordination with external stakeholders, including Mandarin-speaking clients and partners. Mandarin proficiency is therefore essential to ensure effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong research, data analysis and problem solving skills, with customer centric mindset.

  • Solid project management skills with proven success driving complex and multi-stakeholders programs independently or with limited guidance.

  • Strong sense of ownership in identifying business opportunities and drive realization.

  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment.

  • Comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders across timezones

  • Team player, think strategically and act tactically


About TikTok


TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us


Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an “Always Day 1” mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.


Diversity & Inclusion


TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives.


Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.


To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

644af46a4e89c8757f965f358d4d43f7.snippet:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

At Netflix, the Ads Product Marketing Team specializes in bringing our Ad products, measurement solutions, and buying methods (like Programmatic) to the B2B Advertising marketplace.

Product Marketing plays a key role in developing go-to-market strategies for Ad solutions. You will work collaboratively and cross-functionally with the APAC Ad Sales and Measurement teams, global product marketing and product/commercialization teams, and other key stakeholders to define our product narrative. Our goal is to deliver products that meet (and exceed) the market’s needs and position them in a unique, compelling way that highlights the advantages that only Netflix can deliver.

Functional expertise on Digital Ads ecosystem and Measurement is critical for this job.Additionally, considering the regional scope of this role, if you have experience managing or working within the Japan and Korea markets, this would be an advantage; proficiency in Japanese or Korean is highly preferred, but not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the definition and development of go-to-market efforts across new ad product solutions, specifically in the near term, for new programmatic capabilities and measurement solutions

  • Work to enhance existing offerings in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders (ad product, Sales & commercial leaders, Ads Marketing, UX, measurement, policy, etc)

  • The focus for this role would be on supporting APAC programmatic & measurement efforts in collaboration with APAC and global XFN teams.

  • Be a trusted partner to the product, measurement, and sales teams, and assist in establishing a feedback loop that encompasses all necessary customer and market inputs to influence product development

  • Identify and execute marketing needs to support Measurement solutions in the market (e.g. materials, demos, assets, etc) that bring solutions to life in a succinct and exciting way

  • Work across teams to align on and incorporate solutions messaging across our narratives and marketing events and activations

  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Comms, Ad Product, Marketing) to ensure a consistent Ads product narrative

  • Lean into other areas of the business, when needed, specifically across our Measurement products to enable more ways for our advertisers to track and evaluate success, as well as programmatic offerings to enable more ways for advertisers to buy into Netflix ads

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years experience in product marketing within the digital advertising and/or B2B Advertising space; specific experience in GTM for Programmatic/Measurement products would be an added advantage

d983505c3318e0f06fed5dcabde76a34.title: Product Marketing Manager (Platform & AI Solutions)
d983505c3318e0f06fed5dcabde76a34.snippet:
Job Summary

We are looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to own the positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategy for Landi's platform and AI-enabled solutions. The role covers our SaaS platform portfolio — device and estate management, application and content management, remote deployment and lifecycle services — together with the AI capabilities delivered on top of it.

This is a 0→1 role: as the first PMM in a newly centralized function, you will write the playbook rather than inherit one — designing how Landi positions, prices, launches and scales its platform and AI-powered solutions globally.

You will develop a deep understanding of our customers, markets, products and emerging AI capabilities, and translate that insight into compelling narratives that drive adoption, retention and recurring revenue. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, Legal, Communication and Operations to ensure our solutions deliver clear value at every stage of the customer lifecycle.

The role carries end-to-end ownership of the commercial story: value proposition and messaging, pricing and packaging, go-to-market strategy for new solution launches, features, AI capabilities and external partner integrations, and the market, competitive and customer research that informs them.

Responsibilities

Platform Positioning, Messaging & Value Proposition

  • Own positioning and messaging for the platform portfolio — device and estate management, remote deployment, monitoring and terminal lifecycle management — articulating the total cost of ownership and operational efficiency case to acquirers, PSPs, ISVs, retailers and distributors

  • Build differentiated value propositions per segment, market and vertical, translating platform and SaaS capabilities into clear customer outcomes

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback to sharpen product-market fit and messaging

  • Cooperate with Product Management to influence product direction and prioritize customer needs, bringing market insight into product planning

Application, Content & Ecosystem Marketing

  • Market the application and content management layer: app catalogue and distribution, remote software and content updates, configuration, versioning and controlled rollout — turning platform capability into measurable estate-owner and merchant outcomes

  • Build the ecosystem and partner-integration narrative: third-party application onboarding, ISV enablement and marketplace value for both platform operators and application partners

  • Position the platform as the foundation on which AI capabilities and value-added services are delivered, so the platform and AI stories reinforce rather than compete with each other

  • Support the attach and expansion motion: position platform subscriptions, modules and managed services alongside device deals so recurring revenue grows with estate size

AI Solutions Marketing

  • Own product marketing for AI-enabled features and solutions, converting technical capability into concrete customer use cases, business outcomes and proof points

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and relevant AI/technology teams to understand AI capabilities, limitations, roadmap and customer requirements

  • Develop go-to-market strategies for AI-powered launches, including target segments, use cases, positioning, messaging, launch plans, adoption programmes and success metrics

  • Support customer education and adoption of AI capabilities by communicating practical use cases and expected business value in clear, non-technical language

Pricing, Packaging & Commercial Structure

  • Own the Pricing and Packaging lifecycle; collaborate with Finance and Product to define subscription models that balance market competitiveness with high-margin SaaS profitability

  • Define and maintain the commercial structure of the solutions portfolio (SKUs, software bundles, service packages, options and add-ons)

  • Assist in RFP/RFI responses and design tailored commercial offers where required

Go-to-Market, Launch & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Shape and execute go-to-market strategies for new solutions, features, platform modules and partner integrations

  • Collaborate with the Communication team on campaigns that drive pipeline, conversion, retention and expansion

  • Support customer lifecycle marketing including onboarding, adoption, retention, upsell and cross-sell initiatives

Sales Enablement & Field Engagement

  • Enable Sales teams with sales decks, battle cards, demos, solution and use-case narratives, FAQs, objection-handling guides, pricing narratives and training

  • Go further than materials: actively push and animate the sales organization around the story through field engagement, deal support and regular pipeline-facing touchpoints

Trust, Security & Responsible AI Messaging

  • Work with Legal, Security and Product teams to ensure platform and AI messaging accurately reflects data privacy, security, certification and governance commitments

  • Build the trust narrative enterprise buyers ask for — data handling, model limitations, human-in-the-loop safeguards and auditability — and translate evaluation and monitoring practice into assurance that shortens security and procurement review cycles

  • Maintain claim discipline across all messaging: no capability is marketed beyond what the product reliably and demonstrably delivers

Market Intelligence & Performance

  • Conduct market, competitive and technology trend analysis across platform, SaaS and AI to identify emerging customer needs, whitespace opportunities and points of differentiation for Landi's solutions

  • Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence to ensure SaaS profitability

  • Establish and track key performance indicators for platform and AI launches — awareness, adoption, usage, conversion, customer feedback and commercial impact — and use those insights to refine positioning and GTM strategy

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

  • At least 4-7 years of experience in product marketing or related roles within a SaaS or B2B software environment

  • Proven track record marketing platform, SaaS or AI-enabled solutions in a B2B/B2B2C environment, with direct, hands-on involvement in getting deals across the line

  • A track record of pushing and animating a sales organization around a story — in the field with reps and prospects, not just producing collateral from behind a desk

  • Entrepreneurial, high-energy operator profile: comfortable building a function and a narrative from a near-blank page, and writing the playbook rather than waiting for one

  • Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — able to ship, learn and iterate rather than wait for perfect information

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, pricing, packaging and customer lifecycles, including subscription and per-device or per-estate commercial models

  • Experience launching SaaS platforms, modules and features to market

  • Strong understanding of AI/GenAI concepts — including model capabilities, limitations and evaluation considerations — and the ability to translate technical capability into customer-centric business value; hands‑on technical development experience is not required

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security and governance considerations, and the ability to turn them into credible customer-facing assurance

  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear customer value

  • Proven cross-functional collaboration skills, including with Product, Engineering and Legal

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English

  • Experience in Atlassian products (JIRA/Confluence) is a plus

  • Not required: a payments-hardware, POS-device, or terminal-manufacturing marketing background — this is a software, platform and AI positioning role, not a hardware product marketing role

Preferred skills

  • Experience marketing device management, endpoint or estate management platforms (MDM/TMS), application distribution, app stores or content management solutions

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, familiar with Telecom and/or Payment, FinTech or Financial Services industries

  • Experience marketing AI-enabled, data-driven or automation products in a B2B environment

  • Experience building a product marketing function from scratch, or in a newly centralized or fast-scaling organization

  • Experience marketing to or through partner and ISV ecosystems

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and win/loss analysis

24ca4d4e70af981a3fe42feac6581500.snippet:
PURPOSE

The Device Technology Business Manager is responsible for driving the growth, profitability and transformation of the Device Technology portfolio. The role combines product marketing, commercial management, pricing governance, marcom, demand generation, A&P management, inventory governance, programs management & development, analytics and digital transformation.

This is a broad business management role requiring someone who can connect product, pricing, sales, marketing, supply chain, operations and customer needs into clear business actions. In an AI-enabled business environment, the role is expected to use data, automation and AI tools to improve decision-making, workflow design, productivity and business outcomes.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

Business & Commercial Management

  • Manage DT revenue, profitability, pricing, margin and business outlook across machines, accessories and related solutions.
  • Develop and maintain pricing frameworks, cost references, price bulletins and commercial guidelines for Direct Sales and Channels.
  • Review discount requests, promotions, complex deals and profitability considerations, with clear recommendations to management.
  • Support management reviews, business planning and performance tracking by highlighting revenue risks, margin risks, growth gaps and corrective actions.

Product Management & Go-To-Market

  • Own GTM planning for DT products, services and business initiatives, from launch to end-of-life.
  • Develop product positioning, value propositions, sales narratives, FAQs, customer-facing materials and internal sales enablement content.
  • Coordinate launch readiness, product transitions, end-of-sale/end-of-service communications, upgrade campaigns and last-buy planning.
  • Work with regional and HQ stakeholders on product roadmaps, launch requirements, product information and strategic initiatives.

A&P Planning, Marcom & Demand Generation

  • Develop and support monthly DT A&P planning, budget submissions, budget shifts and utilization tracking.
  • Represent DT in monthly Marcom planning and coordinate campaign updates, product announcements, sales communications and internal briefings.
  • Partner with Marcom and Demand Generation teams to design customer acquisition, nurture and engagement campaigns across target segments and personas.
  • Track campaign effectiveness, lead quality, customer engagement signals and contribution to pipeline, with recommendations for improvement.
  • Develop lifecycle marketing programs across onboarding, adoption, retention, renewal and expansion stages.

Stock Forecast, Supply Planning & Inventory Governance

  • Consolidate and maintain rolling forecasts for DT machines and accessories using SFDC pipeline, order bank, sales outlook and business plans.
  • Work with Sales, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Order Fulfilment and Regional Planning teams to improve forecast accuracy and supply visibility.
  • Monitor stock availability, replenishment needs, lead-time issues, supply constraints and fulfilment risks for standard and bulk requirements.
  • Support inventory planning for tenders, large deployments and strategic accounts, including expedited fulfilment or air-freight business justification when required.
  • Identify excess, aging and slow-moving inventory risks and drive clearance, mitigation and lifecycle transition actions.

Program Development, Analytics, Digital Transformation & AI

  • Drive and develop new marketing program initiatives including offering, pricing, sales enablement, process design, performance tracking and customer adoption.
  • Use Power BI, Excel, Power Platform and AI tools to improve analysis, productivity, reporting and decision support.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and redesign workflows across pricing, reporting, sales engagements, campaign management, forecasting and customer engagement.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled and digitally led business opportunities around document digitization, intelligent document processing, workflow automation and new service models.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business IT, Infosystem with at least 4-5 years of similar experience
  • Demonstrated success in product or services launches, pre-sales engagements and presentations
  • Good at multitasking, comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and possess strong interpersonal skills
  • Be a self-starter, energized by challenges
  • Motivated team player and excellent communicator
  • Analytical mind with the ability to join the dots and interpret the big picture and resulting action lines
  • Strong situational awareness, ability to grasp market trends and identify opportunities
  • Independent and dynamic team player with strong written and verbal communication skills and a “can-do” attitude

a5798506ba9049893006c895e07cb8f0.title: Regional Associate Product Marketing Management Manager
a5798506ba9049893006c895e07cb8f0.snippet:
JOB PURPOSE

The Regional Product Marketing & Management Manager, being the owner of assigned products, is primarily responsible for ensuring that products are launched effectively, marketed successfully and tendered properly, generating the intended profitability and impact sustainably.

The incumbent of this job is also tasked to own and drive the success of the wellness product portfolio.

CRITICALWORK FUNCTIONS & KEY TASKS

1. Products Marketing

a)For existing products and new products that have been decided for launching, work with the Regional Director and Business Development to formulate products marketing strategies and initiatives to:

  • influence demand creation
  • expand and refresh product offerings (entailing research on customers’ needs, receptiveness of product offerings and future demand for product offerings)
  • launch related products
  • drive the adoption and sales of the products.

b)Working collaboratively with the Regional Director, develop the product value proposition and positioning for each product. This entails:

  • analysing and understanding the market conditions and competition landscape
  • analysing and understanding customers’ evolving needs, profiles, perceptions and buying behaviours
  • assessing the market awareness of sleep products
  • selecting the target markets and customer segments and defining them
  • determining the product pricings, benefits and terms

c)Working collaboratively with the Regional Marketing Manager, plan and execute strategic marketing communications to increase the awareness and adoption of the sleep products/solutions.

d)Prepare or oversee the preparation of marketing and product collaterals, ensuring that the contents are up-to-date and comply with the brand positioning and specifications.

e)Collaborate with and support the country-based Business Development and Sales Teams to drive the sales of products (include plan and organise marketing initiatives and events to generate sales leads, monitor the success of the marketing campaigns and conversion rates and recommend follow up actions).

f)Track and analyse the performance of each product in details to generate insights for business decision-making and strategic planning.

g)Manage/provide responses to product-related inquiries from sales personnel such as product features, functionalities, pre- and post-sales services and support, pricings and discounts.

h)Continually engage doctors and health care professionals and develop them as Key Opinion Leaders and nudge patients as advocates for the Company.

2. Products Management and Support

a)Undertake the ownership of the products assigned and oversee

  • the performance and functioning of the products, ensuring that the products perform well technically as intended and issues, both technical and non-technical, are being addressed
  • the commercial performance (sales) of the products, ensuring that the intended results are achieved.

b)Prepare or oversee the preparation of training materials and contents as well as assessment requirements and direct the roll out of such training and assessment to help ensure that Sales, Clinical Applications and Customer Service personnel are familiar with the products.

c)Working collaboratively with RCQA (may have to deal with regulatory restrictions and terms), ensure that the products are timely and currently registered and licensed.

d)Collaborate with the Operations Team to ensure that the products are secured and delivered timely to TAS, stored safely and made available promptly to customers.

e)Project the demand for various products and collaborate with and advise the Operations Team to make the required orders in a timely manner, ensuring that the products are optimally stocked.

f)Update and coordinate with the Engineering Services Team to ensure that they are familiar with the technical features and functioning of the products and ready to provide technical services and support as needed.

g)Periodically(or as triggered by developments) review the performance of various products and make appropriate recommendations (eg discontinue, phase out gradually, repackage, reprice, reinforce marketing/push, seek/ride on opportunities)

3. Management of Suppliers

a)Engage and manage suppliers to maintain mutually beneficial relations and enlist their help and sponsorships when necessary

b)Negotiate terms and pricings with suppliers (final terms and pricings to be decided by Regional Director)

c)Serve as the contact point between the internals sales personnel and customers and the suppliers

4. Wellness Products

a)Take ownership in starting and driving the wellness product portfolio.

b)Analyse the market demand for wellness products, identify plausible products and evaluate their potential and economics and make appropriate recommendations.

c)Source for the products, negotiate for terms and pricings and secure the supply.

d)Determine the products packaging (and bundling if appropriate), pricings and formulate the marketing plan (including product positioning, marketing communications and collaterals)

e)Direct and work with the sales teams and retail outlets to prepare them to sell the products (training, merchandising, etc).

f)Monitor and analyse the sales of the products and evaluate their profitability and value add and recommend/determine follow up actions.

5. People Management and Development

a)Guide and advise Sales, Clinical Applications and Customer Service personnel to hone their knowledge of the products.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

(a)Degree in Marketing, Product Marketing or Sciences or in related fields

(b)Minimum 8 years of product marketing and management experience, preferably in healthcare industry dealing withmedical products, medical equipment, or consumer healthcare products

(c) Strong in execution, resource management and project management

CRITICALCOMPETENCIES REQUIRED

  1. Execution and Result
  2. Ownership and Initiative
  3. Organisational Commitment
  4. Growth and Change Mindset
  5. Collaboration

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES REQUIRED

  1. Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
  2. Business and Finance Acumen
  3. Managing and Developing People

TECHNICALCOMPETENCIES REQUIRED

  1. Products Marketing
  2. Products Management
  3. Pricing Management
  4. Market Segmentation & Positioning
  5. Competitive Analysis & Differentiation
  6. Events Planning and Management
  7. Products and Services Promotions
  8. Clinical Insight & Evidence-Based Messaging
  9. Data Analytics

dc23db765bfe9ddee640890c8ebe028f.snippet:
Position Summary

As the Regional Product Marketing Manager, you will drive the Monitor business across Southeast Asia and Oceania (SEAO), translating HQ strategy into regional priorities and market-level action plans that drive sustainable revenue, profitability and market share growth. You will be part of the TV/AV/Monitor Product Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), working closely with Samsung’s HQ in South Korea, country subsidiaries and cross-functional teams across the Regional HQ. The role combines business strategy, performance management, product portfolio and pricing strategy, go-to-market planning and product marketing capability development across markets. Your primary focus will be the Monitor business, covering Gaming, Office/General Use and Smart Monitors. Depending on business needs and your experience, the scope may also expand over time to include Sound Devices such as Soundbars, Party Audio and Wi-Fi Speakers.

Role and Responsibilities

As part of the TV/AV/Monitor Product Marketing COE, you will own the regional Monitor business across eight markets and report to the TV/AV/Monitor Product Marketing Head. Regional Business Strategy: Translate HQ TV/AV/Monitor strategy, product direction and priorities into clear regional strategies and market-level action plans. Develop a strong understanding of assigned markets, analyzing market trends, competitors and business performance to identify growth opportunities and gaps by country. Develop and drive regional growth initiatives and strategic projects, with clear objectives and measurable business impact. Business Performance Management: Analyze regional and market performance across key metrics including sales, market share, profitability and product mix, and provide regular updates to management. Review country business plans, identify performance gaps and root causes, and work with local teams to develop and track corrective and recovery actions. Monitor sell-in, sell-out, inventory, weeks of supply and aging to identify demand and stock risks early and drive appropriate actions. Product Portfolio & Pricing Strategy: Optimize the regional Monitor portfolio and price-band architecture to strengthen market coverage, competitiveness and profitability. Consolidate market requirements and provide HQ with regional input on product line-up, specifications, positioning and market needs. Define regional pricing and promotional guardrails while allowing appropriate adaptation to local market conditions. Go-to-Market Planning: Define regional GTM direction for key product launches, priority growth segments and strategic campaigns, with a particular focus on the Monitor business. Review local launch plans, challenge assumptions, provide feedback and track execution across key launch indicators such as sales ramp-up, awareness and in-store/display execution. Develop regional promotions and product bundles, and analyze promotional ROI to assess business impact. Product Marketing Capability Development: Identify high-performing market initiatives and global best practices, and develop playbooks and toolkits to scale effective approaches across the region. Build common PM tools, templates, dashboards and analytical approaches to improve consistency, efficiency and decision-making. Leverage automation and AI tools to streamline recurring reporting and analysis. Strengthen country PM capabilities through business reviews, coaching, shared standards and capability-building initiatives.

Skills and Qualifications

Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualifications such as an MA or MBA are preferred. 8+ years of relevant experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, Commercial Strategy or a related function within consumer electronics, technology or device businesses. Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate business objectives into practical plans and measurable actions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and translate data into actionable insights. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders, country teams and cross-functional partners. Proactive, practical and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced regional environment. Comfortable leveraging AI and digital tools to improve analysis, reporting and ways of working.

Preferred Qualifications

Product Marketing experience in the Monitor business, particularly Gaming Monitors, is highly preferred. Regional or subsidiary Product Marketing experience within Consumer Electronics, particularly across SEAO markets.

Company Description

Samsung Electronics is a global leader in technology, opening new possibilities for people everywhere. Through relentless innovation and discovery, we are transforming the worlds of TVs, smartphones, wearable devices, tablets, digital appliances, and network systems, and the entire semiconductor industry with our memory, system LSI, foundry, and LED solutions. Samsung is also leading in the development of the Internet of Things through, among others, our Smart Home and Digital Health initiatives. Since being established in 1969, Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, and become recognized as one of the top global brands. Our network now extends across the world, and Samsung takes great pride in the creativity and diversity of its talented people, who drive our growth. To discover more, please visit our official newsroom at https://news.samsung.com/global/.

b2af100a3bac8ef0ee037cdecb9d6267.snippet:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Marketing Operations is a team of marketing execution experts and systems thinkers focused on efficiency. We partner closely with Regional and Demand marketing, Growth, Martech, and creative teams to deliver scalable, high-impact campaigns across channels. While we operate globally, this role is focused on supporting the APAC region.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Program Manager to serve as the end-to-end marketing operations process owner for in-person and online events. In this role, you will collaborate with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Marketing Operations teammates to identify audiences, track and drive attendance, produce high-performing and measurable campaigns, accurately process attendee and non-attendee data, route leads accurately and quickly, and provide sales follow-up reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end marketing operations for in-person and online events, from campaign intake through post-event reporting.
  • Partner with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Sales to define operational plans, timelines, responsibilities, and success metrics.
  • Manage audience strategy and campaign execution, including segmentation, registration, email, testing, launch readiness, and attendance tracking.
  • Monitor registration and attendance, address risks and dependencies, and identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement.
  • Manage the accurate capture, validation, enrichment, and reconciliation of attendee and non-attendee data.
  • Oversee lead scoring, classification, routing, nurture, sales notifications, and handoff within agreed service levels.
  • Report on campaign performance, attendance, engagement, lead routing, sales follow-up, and pipeline impact.
  • Maintain high standards for data quality, privacy, consent, and contact governance throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Identify and address process, data, and technology gaps by implementing scalable documentation and operating procedures that improve consistency and performance.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation operations, event operations, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of proven expertise in Marketo, with a strong track record of developing scalable programs and driving successful campaign outcomes.
  • Proven track record of optimizing campaign and execution workflows within event and webinar platforms (such as Splash and ON24).
  • Experience with audience segmentation, campaign workflows, lead management, and sales follow-up processes.
  • Strong program-management skills, with the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and multiple concurrent events.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience using campaign data to identify issues and improve performance.
  • Understanding of data quality, consent, privacy, and contact-governance practices.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and experience working across Marketing, Sales, and Technology teams.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
  • Experience integrating AI into scalable marketing operations workflow designs and streamline processes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the technology or financial services sectors, ideally within a high-growth company.
  • Knowledge of marketing automation tools and processes to enhance efficiency and scalability in campaign execution.
  • Strong adaptive skills with a proven ability to thrive in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Experience managing or collaborating with an offshore production team to streamline operations.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 164,300 - SGD 246,500. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing and Communications, you will work closely with internal stakeholders across divisions including Investment, Product, Client Solutions, and Legal and Compliance, to build the product marketing discipline and raise the standard of investment-led marketing across the firm.

This role combines market insight, product strategy and technical storytelling. It is suited to someone who wants to influence both what we take to market and how we explain its value.

Key duties and responsibilities

  • Set the product marketing strategy for Fullerton's priority investment capabilities, strategies and funds, aligned with the firm's business, distribution and growth priorities.
  • Own market and client insight by analysing investor needs, market trends, competitor positioning and distribution feedback to identify opportunities and inform product priorities.
  • Define differentiated product positioning and propositions, including target audiences, client needs, competitive differentiation, reasons to invest and core messaging for each priority strategy.
  • Lead go-to-market strategy for new fund launches, product enhancements and repositioning initiatives, coordinating across Investments, Product, Distribution, Marketing and Communications.
  • Translate investment expertise into compelling commercial narratives, ensuring complex investment strategies are communicated clearly, consistently and in a way that resonates with clients and distributors.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Client Solutions to identify client opportunities, understand barriers to product adoption and equip teams with the investment stories, product decks, talking points and other tools required to win business.
  • Own the product marketing content framework, ensuring product presentations, campaign materials, digital content and other sales-enablement materials tell a consistent and differentiated story across markets and channels.
  • Maintain strong competitive intelligence, monitoring competitor products, positioning, messaging, market developments and investor trends to identify opportunities and strengthen Fullerton's competitive differentiation.
  • Drive product lifecycle marketing, determining how priority products should be launched, built, sustained, repositioned or reactivated as market conditions and client needs evolve.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across Investments, Product, Distribution, Marketing and Communications on product priorities, market opportunities and go-to-market decisions.
  • Measure commercial effectiveness through market feedback, client engagement, product adoption, qualified opportunities, pipeline and flows, using these insights to continually sharpen product strategy and marketing investment.
  • Build and champion the product marketing discipline across Fullerton, establishing best practices, frameworks and standards that raise the quality and commercial effectiveness of investment-led marketing.

  • Professional investment qualification such as CFA is preferred.

Experience and skills

  • At least 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in asset management, investment product development, product marketing, investment communications, client solutions, sales enablement, RFPs or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of investment products, asset classes and investment processes.
  • Experience in translating complex investment concepts into clear and persuasive content.
  • Experience in developing product positioning and go-to-market plans.
  • Strong understanding of institutional and intermediary client needs.
  • Strong commercial judgement and market awareness.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to write with clarity and structure. The individual must be able to simplify complex subject matter without losing technical accuracy.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work with senior Investment, Product, Sales and Marketing stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage several priorities and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and strong numerical aptitude.
  • Good understanding of investment management regulation and content approval requirements.

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing, founder-led events and experiences house operating across Singapore and Hong Kong, delivering high-end corporate activations, brand launches and private occasions for a client base of luxury brands, financial institutions and multinational corporations. Client name withheld at this stage — full details shared with shortlisted candidates.

The Role

This Manager role is the operational engine behind a portfolio of corporate events and B2B client projects — translating client commitments into meticulously executed events and activations that hold to an exacting brand standard. Whether it's a marquee corporate launch, a UHNW private occasion, or a luxury brand activation, this is a detail-obsessed, commercially disciplined, calm-under-pressure operator role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of corporate events and client activations — from briefing through execution and post-event close.
  • Manage all vendor relationships for assigned projects — AV, production, venue, catering, décor, floral and entertainment.
  • Build and manage event budgets, track costs in real time, and protect margin across every project.
  • Develop detailed run sheets, production schedules, vendor SOWs and briefing documents for every event.
  • Lead on‑site execution — coordinating vendors and staff, managing real‑time decisions, and staying composed under the live pressure of high‑end event delivery.
  • Support proposal development and creative concept work for existing and prospective accounts.
  • Identify and flag risks to delivery quality, timeline or budget early — with solutions, not just problems.
  • Mentor and develop junior team members.

What We're Looking For

  • Direct experience with luxury brands, financial institutions and/or UHNW clients — this is essential, not a nice-to-have. Mass‑market or purely B2B experience alone won’t translate here.
  • 5–7 years in event production, luxury events delivery, or B2B corporate event management.
  • Strong, independent vendor management experience (AV, production, venue, catering) at the luxury or premium corporate end.
  • Proven budget management discipline on events of S$100k and above.
  • Excellent multi‑tasking and composure — able to run several concurrent projects under pressure without a drop in quality.
  • Polished written and verbal English — comfortable producing client‑facing materials independently.
  • Experience in proposal/new‑business development and managing an integrated creative process.
  • A track record of coaching or developing junior team members.
  • Stable, senior tenures (3+ years per role) preferred — happy to discuss any shorter stints in context.

Nice to Have

  • Technical production knowledge — build, printing, F&B, AV, rigging, lighting, staging.
  • Existing vendor relationships across the premium event supply chain.
  • Prior exposure to UHNW private events or high‑stakes social occasions.

Join Us In Building the Future of Precision Health!

Lucence is a precision health company accelerating early detection of cancer and age-related diseases. We help people live longer, healthier lives through advanced testing that identifies risks before symptoms appear. Operating from twin hubs in Singapore and Silicon Valley, our multidisciplinary team spans tech, commercial, and clinical roles.

Join us to build a world where cancer and diseases of ageing are caught early and treated accurately. Together, we are making this future a reality.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will handle marketing execution across writing, web, social, and events, and coordinate delivery of materials to clinics and sales teams. You will also translate clinical study data into clear content, working closely with Medical Science Liaisons, and handle translation of documents like brochures and reports. This is a hands‑on role: you take a launch, campaign, or partner request and turn it into a finished, delivered asset.

Content and collateral

  • Write, translate and maintain core product marketing assets: one-pagers, FAQs, comparison sheets, battle cards, brochures
  • Support end to end product launches: messaging documents, brochures, onboarding materials, forms, reports, sales training materials, launch timelines
  • Work with Medical Science Liaisons to translate clinical study data into content that is accurate and easy for a non-scientist to follow

Web and social

  • Manage and update website content: product pages, blog posts, landing pages, partner page
  • Run social media channels: content calendar, content development, posting, engagement and reporting

Events and field support

  • Support events: conference booths, webinars, internal launches, logistics and on-site materials
  • Coordinate the delivery of marketing materials to clinics and sales teams
  • Partner with the sales team to build and refresh pitch decks and objection-handling materials

Design and market intelligence

  • Produce simple design and media assets: social graphics, short videos, event collateral
  • Run competitive tracking: what competitors claim, price, and launch, and what that means for our positioning
  • Support broader marketing initiatives as priorities shift

WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER

  • Meaningful Mission: Being at the forefront of the fight against cancer!
  • Global Exposure & Mobility: Collaborate with world-class talent across Asia and the US.
  • Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget for professional development and training.
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous annual leave and parent-care leave to support your well‑being.
  • Dynamic Culture: A fast-paced, inclusive, and highly collaborative environment where ideas become reality

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & INCLUSION

Lucence is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

RECRUITMENT POLICY

Lucence does not accept unsolicited resumes from external agencies or recruiters. Any resume or candidate details submitted to Lucence employees, offices, or aliases without a prior written agreement and a specific search assignment from our HR Department will be considered the property of Lucence. No fee will be paid if Lucence hires the candidate as a result of such unsolicited submission.

302a9e176df45b2b505c7bb7584b538d.snippet:
Events Manager - Luxury & Corporate Events (Singapore)

About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing, founder-led events and experiences house operating across Singapore and Hong Kong, delivering high-end corporate activations, brand launches and private occasions for a client base of luxury brands, financial institutions and multinational corporations. Client name withheld at this stage - full details shared with shortlisted candidates.

The Role
This Manager role is the operational engine behind a portfolio of corporate events and B2B client projects - translating client commitments into meticulously executed events and activations that hold to an exacting brand standard. Whether it's a marquee corporate launch, a UHNW private occasion, or a luxury brand activation, this is a detail-obsessed, commercially disciplined, calm-under-pressure operator role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of corporate events and client activations - from briefing through execution and post-event close.
  • Manage all vendor relationships for assigned projects - AV, production, venue, catering, décor, floral and entertainment.
  • Build and manage event budgets, track costs in real time, and protect margin across every project.
  • Develop detailed run sheets, production schedules, vendor SOWs and briefing documents for every event.
  • Lead on-site execution - coordinating vendors and staff, managing real-time decisions, and staying composed under the live pressure of high-end event delivery.
  • Support proposal development and creative concept work for existing and prospective accounts.
  • Identify and flag risks to delivery quality, timeline or budget early - with solutions, not just problems.
  • Mentor and develop junior team members.

What We're Looking For

  • Direct experience with luxury brands, financial institutions and/or UHNW clients - this is essential, not a nice-to-have. Mass-market or purely B2B experience alone won't translate here.
  • 5-7 years in event production, luxury events delivery, or B2B corporate event management.
  • Strong, independent vendor management experience (AV, production, venue, catering) at the luxury or premium corporate end.
  • Proven budget management discipline on events of S$100k and above.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and composure - able to run several concurrent projects under pressure without a drop in quality.
  • Polished written and verbal English - comfortable producing client-facing materials independently.
  • Experience in proposal/new-business development and managing an integrated creative process.
  • A track record of coaching or developing junior team members.
  • Stable, senior tenures (3+ years per role) preferred - happy to discuss any shorter stints in context.

Nice to Have

  • Technical production knowledge - build, printing, F&B, AV, rigging, lighting, staging.
  • Existing vendor relationships across the premium event supply chain.
  • Prior exposure to UHNW private events or high-stakes social occasions.

To Apply
This search is being handled on a confidential basis by Melior. Please apply via Mycareersfuture or email (HIDDEN TEXT) (subject: Luxury Events Manager Application) - client details will be shared once we've had an initial conversation.

919bccf70c3b3558e8dacffbd804c227.snippet:

Our client is looking for a Marketing Specialist to support the development and execution of marketing strategies that build awareness, engagement, and trust across its financial services offerings.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Develop and execute end-to-end marketing campaigns and communications to drive customer awareness, engagement, and business growth.

- Collaborate closely with Internal and external partners to deliver impactful campaigns.

Who We’re Looking For

- 2–3 years of marketing experience, preferably within the Banking, Financial Services, or Fintech industry.

- Good understanding of the Singapore marketing and media landscape.

“I can succeed as an Associate Product Marketer.\" The Associate Product Marketer supports the development and execution of product marketing strategies across Capital Group's investment capabilities and strategic growth priorities. Working at the intersection of Product, Sales and Marketing, this role helps develop product positioning, messaging, launches, campaigns and client engagement initiatives. The successful candidate will learn how to transform complex investment expertise into compelling audience‑relevant narratives that support client understanding, adoption and long‑term engagement. This role is ideal for an early‑career marketer who is interested in investment products, strategic storytelling and client behaviour, and wants exposure to regional marketing initiatives across Asia.

Product Positioning & Messaging
  • Support the development of product positioning, value propositions and messaging frameworks for Capital Group investment solutions.
  • Help articulate product benefits, competitive differentiation and client relevance across key client segments.
  • Partner with investment specialists and product experts to translate technical investment concepts into clear and compelling marketing messages.
  • Ensure consistency of product narratives across campaigns, content and client‑facing materials.
Product Marketing & Go‑to‑Market Execution
  • Support product launches, strategic campaigns and marketing initiatives across Asia.
  • Assist in developing go‑to‑market plans and marketing activity that support awareness, engagement and adoption objectives.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Client Marketing and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution.
  • Help manage timelines, priorities and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
Audience Insight & Narrative Development
  • Develop an understanding of client audiences, their objectives and the barriers they face when making investment decisions.
  • Help identify the most relevant product stories for different client segments.
  • Build narratives that connect product capabilities with investor needs, behaviours and outcomes.
  • Support efforts to create more audience‑led and decision‑focused marketing experiences.
Content & Client Enablement
  • Develop and adapt product‑related content across a range of formats, including presentations, emails, webpages, articles, videos, social content and campaign assets.
  • Support the creation of sales enablement and client education materials.
  • Ensure content is accurate, engaging and aligned with approved messaging.
  • Work with content marketers to deliver integrated marketing experiences across the client journey.
Measurement & Optimization
  • Monitor engagement metrics and stakeholder feedback to assess marketing effectiveness.
  • Support competitor reviews and market analysis.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen positioning, messaging and client engagement over time.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

Experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in product marketing, marketing, communications, consulting, research or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Exposure to financial services, investments or related industries is advantageous.
Skills
  • Strong interest in product marketing and strategic marketing.
  • Excellent written communication and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex concepts and make them relevant to different audiences.
  • Strong organisation, project management and prioritisation skills.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively across functions.
Personal Attributes
  • Naturally curious and eager to learn.
  • Empathetic and audience‑focused.
  • Strong listener who seeks to understand before acting.
  • Collaborative and comfortable working across functions.
  • Proactive, resourceful and willing to take ownership.
What Success Looks Like
  • Demonstrate strong understanding of key client audiences and their needs.
  • Independently develop audience‑led messaging and content briefs.
  • Manage smaller narrative and content initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Become a trusted partner to stakeholders seeking help translating investment expertise into client‑relevant stories.
  • Contribute meaningfully to strategic growth priorities, product initiatives and investor education programs.

44eeb1ccd2627caba11000f8e05aebc5.title: Events Manager - Sales
44eeb1ccd2627caba11000f8e05aebc5.snippet:
Your mission: Turn “We’re planning an event” into “YES, we want that!”

You’ll be the fun-loving sales wizard who connects clients with the right mix of arcade games, carnival games, inflatables, F&B stations and event experiences.

What you’ll do:
  • Hunt for new opportunities and turn leads into bookings.
  • Understand what clients want and build exciting event packages around it.
  • Prepare quotations, proposals and pitches that make people want to play.
  • Manage client relationships from first “Hello!” to event day.
  • Work closely with our ops team to make sure what was sold can actually happen.
  • Hit sales targets, grow accounts and occasionally perform the ancient ritual of following up with clients.
We’re looking for someone who is:
  • Sales-driven, energetic and comfortable talking to people.
  • Creative enough to think beyond “just rent a few machines.”
  • Organised enough to juggle multiple events without dropping the ball.
  • Confident in negotiating, pitching and closing.
  • A team player who enjoys a fast-paced, slightly chaotic event environment.
In short:If you love sales, events, games and making things happen, this might be your kind of playground. #J-18808-Ljbffr

8768724dda0bbad9553a3a724402520a.snippet:
Partnerships & Events Manager

Location: Singapore
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

UFIT is looking for a Partnerships & Events Manager to grow and manage our partnerships, events and community activations across Singapore.

This role combines relationship building, business development and hands-on event execution. You will identify and develop relevant partners, create meaningful activations, and manage events from planning through to delivery.

We are looking for someone who understands the Singapore fitness, health and wellness landscape, is comfortable building relationships across the industry, and can turn ideas into well-executed events that generate real value for UFIT.

What You'll Do
  • Identify and develop new partnerships across fitness, health, wellness, sports, lifestyle and community
  • Build relationships with brands, organisations, clubs, communities and event partners
  • Manage partnership discussions, proposals and agreed deliverables
  • Develop and coordinate events, activations and community initiatives
  • Own event planning including timelines, staffing, venues, suppliers, equipment and logistics
  • Be the on-ground lead for key events and activations
  • Coordinate closely with UFIT's Fitness, Health, Marketing and Hub teams
  • Ensure events include effective lead capture and follow-up processes
  • Track partnership and event performance including attendance, leads, revenue and ROI
  • Manage UFIT Rewards and member-benefit partnerships
  • Maintain a pipeline of partnership and event opportunities

The role combines the commercial partnership responsibilities in the existing framework with the end-to-end event ownership defined in the Events Coordinator role.

What We're Looking For
  • Experience in partnerships, events, business development, activations or community management
  • Strong knowledge of the Singapore fitness, health and wellness market
  • Existing relationships within Singapore's fitness, wellness, sports or lifestyle ecosystem would be an advantage
  • Preferably an active fitness participant yourself and genuinely interested in health, fitness and wellness
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Commercially minded and comfortable discussing partnership value and opportunities
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple events and stakeholders at the same time
  • Confident working independently and taking ownership
What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if you:

  • Build strong, relevant partnerships for UFIT
  • Deliver professional and well-organised events
  • Generate quality leads and commercial opportunities
  • Grow UFIT's presence within Singapore's health, fitness and wellness community
  • Create partnerships that deliver measurable value rather than activity for activity's sake
  • Become a trusted point of contact for UFIT's partners and community
About UFIT

UFIT is one of Singapore's leading integrated health and fitness businesses, bringing together fitness, physiotherapy, podiatry, osteopathy, massage, nutrition and other health services through our Circle of Care.

Our goal is to help people move better, feel better and perform at their best through an integrated approach to Movement, Mindset, Recovery, Nutrition and Community

d586cf3e4e1236928f58a8cd4fcbb684.snippet:
Knotz is an integrated wedding company that operates two wedding venues - The Secret Haven and The Secret Patio. We have openings for versatile and motivated individuals to be part of our core team, mainly focusing on weddings and events at The Secret Haven. You'll be tasked with client servicing, responding to (and closing) new leads, and executing the event logistics to the standard that our clients have come to expect from our brand. Through your work, you'll have the opportunity to not only develop valuable career skills but also make tangible contributions to the success of the business.

We want team members who are receptive to constructive feedback, and aren't afraid to get their hands dirty. Our ideal candidate is someone with a bit of experience in events (preferably B2C), or related environments such as F&B/hotels. Having said that, we value the right attitude just as much as experience, so feel free to write to us with your story even if your background isn't a perfect fit!

We are firm believers in paying for performance, and all our employees have ample opportunity to boost their salary by hitting targets and KPIs. Sounds good? We look forward to hearing from you!

bcb4f50c2bfb10e1bfa0322f2f360fb6.title: Product Marketing & Operations Specialist
bcb4f50c2bfb10e1bfa0322f2f360fb6.snippet:
We're seeking candidates with keen interests marketing, project coordination, and operations to bring technology-driven products and initiatives to life.

Be apart of our team as a Product Marketing & Operations Specialist to support the marketing and operational execution of mapping, location-based, and technology-enabled products.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns for mapping, IoT, and consumer-facing products.
  • Translate product and business objectives into campaign plans, target audiences, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics.
  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to support product awareness, adoption, and customer experience.
  • Coordinate end-to-end operational activities for mapping initiatives, including site access, field activities, data collection, and quality tracking.
  • Plan and execute partner events and engagement activities, covering event planning, vendor coordination, communications, logistics, on-site execution, and post-event reporting.
  • Manage relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, property managers, site operators, and other stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with regional marketing teams and external partners to leverage specialist support when required.
  • Maintain campaign assets, event logistics, participant information, location data, and operational trackers.
  • Use data and reporting to monitor project progress, campaign performance, and operational outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in marketing operations, campaign execution, project coordination, events, or field operations.
  • Experience with Consumer Maps, GIS, POI data management, navigation, or geospatial products will be an advantage.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of marketing, technology, and operations, and are comfortable managing projects across multiple stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you!

Bonuses

2ba21a0bbc74753d93749273bc34c78d.title: Head of Brand & Product Marketing
2ba21a0bbc74753d93749273bc34c78d.snippet:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a Head of Brand & Product Marketing to join our team. This is building, not maintaining. You will own how Workstream is positioned, launched, and remembered, at the moment we expand from a vertical SaaS leader into an AI-native platform for the entire frontline workforce. You'll run product marketing, brand, content, and design as one team, report directly to our revenue leadership, and see your work show up in the pipeline within weeks, not quarters.

We are looking for leaders that thrive in a fast-paced environment. Ex-founders thrive here.

Location & Relocation

  • This is a 4 to 5-days-per-week in-office role at our San Francisco office. We believe being together is important for building quickly, collaborating closely, and shaping the next chapter of Workstream
  • We support relocation and visa sponsorship for the right candidate

Day In The Life

  • Positioning & Narrative: Own Workstream's positioning and messaging end to end, including the biggest open strategic question we have: leading with our restaurant dominance vs. the broader frontline-workforce story. You'll test it, not debate it.
  • Product Launches: Run GTM launches for a portfolio that now ships AI products (like our AI assistant for frontline teams) alongside hiring, HR, and payroll. Messaging, pricing & packaging input, launch plans, and the enablement that makes Sales dangerous in the first week.
  • Brand & Content: Lead our content and design team across the website, case studies, video, webinars, and social. Raise the bar on everything customer-facing, and use AI to produce at a pace a team twice our size couldn't match a year ago.
  • Working with Sales: Arm AEs and partnerships with narratives, competitive teardowns, ROI stories, and customer proof. Sit in on deals. Talk to lost prospects. Change the message when the market tells you to.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and grow a small, high-output team of product marketers, content marketers, and designers, and be the strongest IC on it when it matters.

Who You Are

  • Slope over pedigree: 5+ years in B2B marketing with real product marketing depth, but we care more about what you've shipped and how fast you're improving than the logos on your resume.
  • Management experience: You have built and led hungry and dynamic marketing teams in the past.
  • Founder energy: you've started something (a company, a category, a function from zero) and you default to action; former founders welcome!
  • A writer and an operator: you produce sharp positioning yourself, and you build systems so the team produces it without you.
  • AI-native: you already use AI agents across your daily work and you'll push the team to do the same.
  • Commercially ruthless: you measure marketing in pipeline and revenue, not impressions.
  • Hungry: you outwork the market and you want the scope of a VP role earlier than a big company would ever give it to you.
  • Experience with SMB buyers, hourly/frontline workforces, HR tech, or payroll is a strong plus.

Travel & Location

  • Willing to relocate to San Francisco; in-office at least 4 days per week
  • Occasional travel for customer visits, conferences, and team events

What We Offer

  • Pay directly to your bank account (once a month)
  • Health Insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Follow Singapore Holidays
  • Company-issued device will be provided
  • Workstream will process CPF and taxes
  • Experience using AI to automate repetitive and data processing tasks.
  • Prior exposure to code-based automation workflows (e.g. Python scripts, APIs, Zapier, or similar) - no need to know how to code!
  • Familiarity with common marketing tools (e.g. HubSpot, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager)

Know More About Workstream

  • https://www.workstream.us/blog/funding-series-b
  • https://techcrunch.com/2021/08/26/workstreams-text-based-recruitment-tool-gets-a-48m-bet-from-bond-and-beyond/
  • https://techbuzz.news/buzzworthy-august-27-2021/

Additional Information

Workstream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

886d0339dc85eafdde526f480d11b2f0.snippet:
Department

Marketing

Location

Singapore

Job Title

APJ Web & SEO Manager

Department

Digital Marketing

Job Description

As the APJ Web & SEO Manager for the Digital Experience Team at Infor, you will serve as the regional authority for website management, search engine optimization (SEO), and localized digital content across Japan and other APJ markets. This is a highly hands-on, individual contributor role with day-to-day responsibility for ensuring regional websites are optimized for discoverability, relevance, and performance across diverse search ecosystems including Google, Yahoo Japan, Naver, and Baidu.
In this role, you will lead keyword research, SEO strategy execution, website and competitive content gap analyses, and the localization of global content to ensure it is fully optimized for regional audiences and search visibility — accounting for the linguistic, cultural, and search-engine nuances unique to APJ markets. You will also identify, source, and develop new content opportunities that improve organic performance and user engagement.
Working closely with regional stakeholders and the Singapore-based creative team, you will coordinate ongoing website updates, localization reviews, content publishing, and performance reporting, while continuously identifying opportunities to enhance SEO effectiveness and overall website experience across APJ markets.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

  • Serve as the day-to-day web and SEO manager for Japan and broader APJ markets, acting as the regional subject-matter expert for website optimization and organic search performance across multiple search engines (Google, Yahoo Japan, Naver, Baidu).
  • Lead keyword research and search demand analysis to inform content strategy, on-page optimization, and localization priorities across APJ markets — recognizing that search behavior and query patterns differ significantly across languages and platforms.
  • Conduct website audits and competitive content gap analyses to identify opportunities to improve organic visibility, engagement, and conversion performance.
  • Localize global web content for APJ audiences, ensuring language, messaging, structure, cultural relevance, and SEO best practices are fully adapted for regional markets — especially Japan.
  • Source, brief, or develop new regional content (pages, landing experiences, and supporting assets) to address SEO gaps and improve organic performance.
  • Coordinate closely with regional marketing stakeholders across multiple APJ time zones to prioritize updates, manage requests, and align website initiatives with regional business goals.
  • Partner with the Singapore-based creative team to manage content updates, localization workflows, QA reviews, and publishing timelines.
  • Ensure all website updates follow SEO best practices, accessibility standards, and brand guidelines.
  • Monitor and report on SEO and website performance across multiple markets and search engines, providing regular insights, recommendations, and optimization opportunities to stakeholders.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve site structure, internal linking, content quality, and user experience to drive sustained organic growth.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of proven experience in a hands-on web management and SEO role, ideally supporting multiple regional or international markets.
  • Strong understanding of SEO/GEO fundamentals, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO concepts, and content strategy.
  • Experience managing website content updates and localization in collaboration with creative, content, and regional teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, cross-functional environment spanning multiple time zones.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required; additional APJ spoken languages (Japanese, Mandarin, Korean, Bahasa Indonesia/Malay, Thai, or Vietnamese) a strong plus.
  • Experience optimizing for non-Google search engines prevalent in APJ — Yahoo Japan, Naver (Korea), and/or Baidu (China) — including familiarity with their respective webmaster tools.
  • Experience working with global or enterprise-scale websites and content management systems (Sitecore, WordPress, Drupal, or similar CMS).
  • Familiarity with SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, enterprise SEO platforms) and regional equivalents (Naver Search Advisor, Baidu Webmaster Tools).
  • Experience collaborating with distributed or nearshore creative teams across time zones.
  • Cultural fluency and experience navigating the diverse business and consumer landscapes across APJ markets.
