About Us

We're NUS Enterprise, the entrepreneurial heart of the National University of Singapore (NUS). Our mission: turn frontier science into globally transformative products and companies by fostering entrepreneurial journeys and building thriving ecosystems worldwide. We back bold ideas with the potential to reshape entire industries—and we're just getting started.

The Role: Visual Storyteller

As a Visual Storyteller at NUS Enterprise, you’ll shape how we inspire the world with the stories of our entrepreneurs, innovators, and game-changing research. From designing striking visuals to producing engaging videos, you’ll bring ideas to life in ways that connect, move, and inspire.

This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who thrives at the intersection of storytelling, design, and digital media. You’ll work across programmes, initiatives, and events to develop visuals and create content that not only informs but leaves a lasting impression.

What You’ll Do
  • Tell stories visually – Translate complex ideas into clear, powerful narratives through graphics, presentations, and campaigns.
  • Design with impact – Create marketing collaterals (brochures, infographics, event materials, digital assets, etc.) that communicate our mission and align with our brand identity.
  • Bring stories to motion – Conceptualise, plan, shoot, and edit videos that showcase our programmes, start-ups, and impact stories.
  • Amplify campaigns – Collaborate with programme teams to deliver creative assets for events, social media, and digital platforms.
  • Push creative boundaries – Explore design and multimedia trends to keep our storytelling bring fresh and innovative.
  • Own your craft – Drive projects from concept to executive, managing timelines with minimal supervision.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design, multimedia production, or creative communications.
  • A Strong storytelling instinct: you can distil abstract ideas into engaging visuals and narratives.
  • Proficiency with design and editing tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, Final Cut Pro, or similar).
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects independently while delivering on time.
  • Understanding of how visual elements work together to build cohesive brand experiences.
  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.
  • A collaborative spirit, comfortable working with diverse stakeholders—from researchers to entrepreneurs to senior leaders alike.
Bonus Points For
  • Skills in photography, illustration, motion graphics, or animation to create dynamic content.
  • Experience tailoring content for different platforms and social media formats.
  • Familiarity with start-ups, innovation ecosystems, venture capital, or education-focused organisations.
Why Join NUS Enterprise?

This is more than a design role—it’s your chance to shape how Singapore’s innovation and start-up stories are told and remembered. You’ll be at the heart of our ecosystem, bringing to life the journeys of entrepreneurs and the impact of research. Your work will not just create assets, but craft narratives that inspires future generations.

Marketing Operations is a team of marketing execution experts and systems thinkers focused on efficiency. We partner closely with Regional and Demand marketing, Growth, Martech, and creative teams to deliver scalable, high-impact campaigns across channels. While we operate globally, this role is focused on supporting the APAC region.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Program Manager to serve as the end-to-end marketing operations process owner for in-person and online events. In this role, you will collaborate with Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Technology, and Marketing Operations teammates to identify audiences, track and drive attendance, produce high-performing and measurable campaigns, accurately process attendee and non-attendee data, route leads accurately and quickly, and provide sales follow-up reporting.

Purpose:
We are seeking an Associate Marketing Manager to build, execute, and optimize data-driven marketing programs that strengthen customer engagement across the full customer lifecycle. This role will be responsible for translating customer data, segmentation insights, campaign performance, and business priorities into structured lifecycle programs that improve onboarding, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal readiness, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a strong program builder with a balance of marketing strategy, campaign execution, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and operational discipline. The role requires close collaboration with sales, product marketing, customer experience, digital marketing, analytics, and business operations teams to design scalable programs that deliver measurable customer and revenue outcomes.

What does the role look like: Customer Lifecycle Program Development
  • Design and manage customer lifecycle marketing programs across key stages, including onboarding, activation, engagement, expansion readiness, retention, renewal, and advocacy.
  • Develop customer journey maps, communication cadences, and content frameworks tailored to customer segments, lifecycle stages, personas, and business objectives.
  • Move marketing execution from ad hoc campaign activity toward structured, always-on lifecycle programs that support customer value, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Identify key customer milestones and trigger points to deliver relevant communications at the right time through the appropriate channels.
Data-Driven Segmentation & Personalisation
  • Leverage customer data, CRM insights, installed base information, campaign engagement, behavioural signals, support trends, and renewal timelines to define target cohorts and program priorities.
  • Build segmentation strategies based on customer lifecycle stage, product ownership, industry, account size, engagement level, propensity signals, and renewal risk.
  • Partner with analytics and sales operations teams to interpret dashboards, customer health indicators, funnel metrics, and campaign performance data.
  • Translate insights into actionable marketing programs, nurture journeys, and sales handover triggers.
Campaign Execution & Marketing Automation
  • Plan and execute multi-touch marketing programs across email, landing pages, digital channels, webinars, customer portals, and sales-enabled touchpoints.
  • Work with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems to build nurture flows, trigger-based journeys, scoring rules, suppression logic, and customer communication governance.
  • Ensure lifecycle communications are coordinated to avoid over-communication and maintain a consistent customer experience.
  • Collaborate with content, brand, digital, and product teams to develop relevant assets such as welcome guides, usage tips, thought leadership articles, case studies, renewal toolkits, value summaries, and campaign landing pages.
Performance Measurement & Optimization
  • Define program success metrics, including engagement, conversion, pipeline influence, renewal readiness, expansion opportunities, meeting bookings, customer satisfaction indicators, and revenue impact.
  • Monitor campaign and lifecycle program performance, identify trends, and recommend data-driven optimization actions.
  • Build regular reporting updates for stakeholders, including program status, insights, learnings, and recommended next steps.
  • Support attribution and measurement frameworks to connect marketing activities with sales pipeline, customer retention, and business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Program Management
  • Lead cross-functional alignment with sales, product marketing, customer experience, analytics, digital marketing, agencies, and business stakeholders to deliver programs on time and at scale.
  • Manage program timelines, campaign calendars, stakeholder reviews, dependencies, and execution risks.
  • Coordinate sales enablement requirements, including call guides, battle cards, follow-up actions, and lead handover processes.
  • Continuously improve program workflows, content operations, campaign governance, and marketing execution processes.
Key Skills & Competencies
  • Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, customer journey design, segmentation, nurture strategy, and campaign orchestration.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret customer data, campaign performance, funnel metrics, and business insights.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, Pardot, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar tools.
  • Ability to translate data into practical marketing actions, customer programs, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, timelines, and stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop clear briefs, updates, campaign messaging, and stakeholder presentations.
  • Customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on relevance, value delivery, and experience quality.
What are we looking for:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in marketing programs, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, demand generation, CRM marketing, or customer engagement roles.
  • Proven experience building and executing multi-touch marketing campaigns or customer nurture programs.
  • Experience working with customer data, segmentation, reporting dashboards, and campaign performance analytics.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, technology, managed services, SaaS, print solutions, digital transformation, or related industries is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Excel, or similar reporting tools is preferred.
  • Experience working with sales teams and supporting lead handover, pipeline tracking, or revenue-linked campaign measurement is preferred.

f87066d03b8339bd35a4af9c27ca8726.snippet:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000359

About The Team

We are building a performance marketing organization where every dollar of spend is justified by evidence, not intuition. As a Manager on this team, you will own a portfolio within one of our paid acquisition channels (SEM, Metasearch, Display, Affiliates, or App Installs) and be accountable for the performance of that portfolio across our APAC markets.

Job Summary

This role sits at the intersection of execution and analysis. You will run campaigns at meaningful scale, design tests to measure their incremental impact, and translate the results into clear recommendations for how we deploy growth capital. You will not be optimizing toward vanity metrics or chasing last‑click ROAS. You will be expected to interrogate the data, separate signal from noise, and build a defensible point of view on what is actually working.

This role can be structured as an individual contributor or as a first‑line manager with a small team, depending on the candidate's strengths. Deep channel expertise is welcomed but not required. What matters is analytical rigor and the ability to learn fast in a high‑velocity environment. If you come from a consulting, analytics, or growth background and want to apply that thinking to performance marketing, we want to hear from you.

How You Will Work

You will operate with a clear scope and high accountability. We expect you to form hypotheses, test them, and update your point of view based on what the evidence shows. You will have direct access to senior leadership through regular reviews, and your analyses will inform decisions on where the company invests its growth capital.

We are not looking for someone who runs the existing playbook. We are looking for someone sharp enough to question it, structured enough to test it, and credible enough to change it.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own a performance portfolio. Manage day‑to‑day execution and optimization of campaigns within your assigned channel and markets. Set targets, monitor pacing, and make trade‑off decisions on bids, budgets, audiences, and creative with full ownership of outcomes.
  • Measure what matters. Design and run experiments (geo holdouts, A/B tests, audience splits, lift studies) to isolate the incremental contribution of your spend. Push back on attribution‑based reporting when it overstates impact, and replace assumptions with evidence wherever possible.
  • Work the data yourself. Pull, query, and validate data directly. You should be comfortable in SQL and able to build the analyses you need without waiting on the analytics team. Translate raw output into clear narratives that leadership and stakeholders can act on.
  • Improve the operating rhythm. Identify manual reporting and optimization workflows that should be automated. Partner with analytics and engineering to put better tools in your team's hands. Faster cycle times and cleaner data are part of the job, not an afterthought.
  • Collaborate across functions. Work with product, commercial, finance, and creative to ensure your campaigns are connected to broader business goals. Bring channel‑level insights into cross‑functional planning conversations and translate them into language non‑marketers can use.
  • Develop team capability. If managing direct reports, set the analytical bar and coach your team toward it. If operating as an IC, mentor more junior analysts and contribute to playbooks the wider team can lean on.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics, computer science) or strong demonstrated quantitative ability in another discipline.
  • 5 to 9 years in performance marketing, growth, analytics, management consulting, or a similarly analytically intensive role.
  • Working SQL proficiency. You can write your own queries against transaction‑level data, validate the output, and trust your own numbers.
  • Experience designing or interpreting tests (A/B, holdouts, geo experiments) and translating results into business decisions.
  • Comfort with budget ownership and the trade‑offs involved in scaling spend efficiently across multiple markets or campaigns.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can structure an analysis, present it to a senior audience, and defend it under questioning.

Strong Plus

  • Hands‑on experience with one or more paid channels: SEM (Google, Bing), Metasearch (Skyscanner, Kayak, Trivago, Google Hotel Ads), Display (Meta, TikTok, Criteo, RTB), Affiliates, or App Install networks.
  • Familiarity with incrementality measurement, media mix modeling, or causal inference methods.
  • Background in travel, e‑commerce, marketplace, or another high‑volume transactional business.
  • BI tool fluency (Tableau, Looker, Data Studio) and scripting (Python, R).
  • Multi‑market or APAC regional experience.
  • People management experience for the manager‑track variant of this role.

70e4f6c8cf0d0d265c84d9377021093c.snippet:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Technical Account Managers work cross-functionally to support the largest and most complex Stripe users. Through trusted relationships, we offer customized, strategic consultations and proactively identify opportunity areas to help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize technical operations on their teams, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you'll do

Responsibilities

  • Provide a Gold Standard Experience to your assigned accounts' key stakeholders
  • Work with the wider Operations team to provide current state, resources, and knowledge to enable Gold Standard Experience across teams interacting directly with the user via support channels, external documentation, or product and feature feedback or development
  • Foster long-term user relationships that grow loyalty to Stripe and Stripe products
  • Work cross-functionally both internally and within your user's organizations to provide and implement operational solutions on subjects not limited to fraud, disputes, declines, product adoption, and global expansion
  • Work closely with Customer Success and other user-facing teams as part of a larger effort to support users on Stripe
  • Lead user-facing meetings both in person and through video chat
  • Collaborate on the continued design of this support offering
  • Create user-facing content for long-term solutions

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in enterprise-level client-facing work in the Greater China Region
  • Fluent business level Chinese as this role requires the successful candidate to work with users in the Greater China Region
  • Strong product sense and a drive to solve difficult, user-related problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to lead complex integration conversations in a highly consultative and proactive manner
  • Familiarity with APIs and ability to explain API concepts to the largest and most technical Stripe customers
  • Familiarity with SQL and the ability to build basic queries and modify more complex ones
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and comfort interfacing with technical teams
  • A professional, confident, and collaborative personality as an adept client relationship manager, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization

Preferred Qualifications

  • An operations-savvy mindset, with the ability to identify and eliminate process friction while continuing to build scalable processes
  • Experience in small-to-medium-scale project management
  • Strong organizational skills and self-starting mindset
  • Experience with tools like Postman, Xcode, Python, Webhooks, and ETL
  • Experience in the payments industry

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 161,600 - SGD 242,400. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

36d47095a0c08da7b2519bf1b2be9c30.title: Technical Account Manager
36d47095a0c08da7b2519bf1b2be9c30.snippet:
The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on, latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts - owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures, deepening technical expertise in databases, containers, networking, and capacity planning, and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews, cost planning, and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities - Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, advising on cloud architecture, operational strategy, and launch readiness across global AWS regions. - Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints, then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns. - Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns. - Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture, cost efficiency, and system reliability. - Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and reusable automation, and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group.

A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning, then jump into a call with their engineering team - in Mandarin as the role deals with clients who predominantly communicate in Mandarin - to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology, and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership, highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead.

About the team We are a cross-border Enterprise Support team within AWS that serves enterprise customers headquartered in Singapore while their production infrastructure runs in global AWS regions. Our closest partners are the account teams and Solutions Architects on our shared accounts, along with AWS service teams in compute, database, container, and networking. As our customer portfolio grows and workloads become more demanding, we are looking for a senior engineer ready to take designated ownership of key accounts and help us scale proactive delivery through better mechanisms, deeper technical expertise, and shared tooling. Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience - 7+ years of technical engineering experience Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment - Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

As a trusted advisor you’ll have a direct impact in helping our customers gain the most value from cloud technology. You’ll craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services.

collection and expert human analysis to transform how intelligence is operationalized across modern security
operations. Our mission: secure the world with intelligence.

expertise. You can translate complex intelligence and security concepts into tangible and measurable customer
value. You are proficient at tailoring your consultative engagement for both tactical and strategic audiences,
mapping technical intelligence outcomes to quantifiable business risk reduction. and proactive guidance, helping organizations to fully realize the value of Recorded Future's Intelligence Cloud through unquestionable intelligence-driven ROI and risk reduction.

Proficiency in English and Korean (spoken and written) is required for this role to effectively support and engage Korean-speaking customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams in regional business operations.

  • Partner with customers to define and deliver intelligence-led outcomes using Recorded Future's full suite of capabilities across the platform, integrations ecosystem and services portfolio
  • Monitor and drive intelligence platform adoption, analyze usage patterns and integration health to ensure sustained operational success
  • Conduct regular executive and technical business reviews, presenting value realization metrics and maturity progression
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks to account health and renewal, including budget related constraints, competitive pressure, and loss of champion or stakeholder turnover
  • Preempt customer needs and proactively identify growth opportunities to ensure customer satisfaction, retention and platform expansion
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison, collaborating with the customers SOC, CTI, engineering, GRC, threat hunting, vulnerability management and other security teams on configuration, data integration, and optimization
  • Design and execute strategic customer success and intelligence adoption plans that align business priorities with Recorded Future capabilities and measurable outcomes, in partnership with account directors and cross-functional Recorded Future teams
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, product management, data science and intelligence teams to ensure a unified customer experience
  • Lead bespoke intelligence advisory engagements, addressing emerging threats, collection priorities, intelligence workflows, configuration and tuning, and strengthening of customer tradecraft and platform proficiency

20eca0a68b240c604bb90ae131255096.snippet:
Overview

Role Summary

The Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is accountable for helping strategic customers realize measurable business value from Microsoft cloud investments. The role connects customer success planning, adoption execution, commercial governance, and executive stakeholder orchestration across the Customer Success Unit (CSU). In addition to standard CSAM accountabilities, this role carries focused business ownership on ASEAN AI Copilot Value Realization, by Owning and leading the governance, planning, and successful execution of M365 Copilot across the Top accounts. Act as a Senior Advisor and orchestrator between Microsoft, customer stakeholders, and partner organizations to ensure trials deliver measurable business value and support successful adoption and commercial outcomes.

Role Purpose

The role exists to improve customer outcome realization from our AI platform while strengthening CSU contribution to growth. The CSAM leads through influence across customer executives, CSU leaders, Sales stakeholders, Unified teams, and CGMs, ensuring that customer success plans translate into measurable adoption, consumption, and return on investment.

Responsibilities

Core Accountabilities

Establish clear success criteria and business outcomes with customer executive sponsors and key stakeholders for top Copilot deals, aligning priority use cases and expected value realization. Lead the adoption governance, including program management, milestone planning, scheduling, and progress tracking across the customer and the wider Microsoft deal team. Own executive relationship orchestration and success plan governance for strategic customers, Provide customers, partners, and internal Microsoft teams with adoption and measurement toolkits, including performance monitoring frameworks, survey templates, feedback mechanisms, and success metrics to assess trial effectiveness. Facilitate ongoing governance reviews and performance checkpoints to monitor progress against established success criteria and drive issue resolution where required. Lead cross-functional execution across CSAMs, Cloud Solution Architects, Engineering, sales teams, partners, and services teams. Anticipate customer risk, remove delivery blockers, and maintain clear escalation paths. Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning, investment, and prioritization discussions.

Additional Business Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement

This role operates as a senior cross-functional orchestrator. Success depends on consistent alignment across customer executives, CSU leadership, CGMs, account teams, Unified teams, finance and operations stakeholders, and delivery partners. Own end-to-end business transformation engagements, partnering with C-suite leaders to define AI-driven operating models, establish governance, align organizational change, and deliver measurable business outcomes tied to strategic priorities and P&L impact.

Customer executives and business decision makers, to maintain outcome clarity and executive sponsorship. CSU leadership and the CSAM/CSA community, to align growth ownership, delivery priorities, and escalation paths. CGMs and sales leaders, to validate ECIF scope, ACR ROI assumptions, and account-level growth opportunities. Unified and services teams, to connect support investments to customer outcomes and growth priorities.

Success Measures

Exceed our M365 Copilot & Cowork targets & growth plans. Customer success plans demonstrate measurable adoption, consumption, and outcome progress. Stakeholders can see a single CSU point of accountability for business growth orchestration across these priorities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Significant experience in customer success, account leadership, AI solutions, cloud adoption, or enterprise technology transformation. Proven ability to lead senior stakeholder alignment across customer, sales, technical, services, and operations teams. Strong commercial judgment, including ability to connect customer outcomes to ACR growth, AI monetization, investment decisions, and ROI governance. Experience managing complex plans across multiple workstreams, business owners, and review cadences. Executive communication skills with ability to simplify complex portfolio and investment topics into clear recommendations.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting Singapore or ASEAN enterprise customers, or cloud growth programs, or market-level growth initiatives. Prior ownership of customer success plans, investment governance, or business performance reviews. Ability to coach senior CSAM and CSA teams while influencing without direct authority. Ability to set enterprise-wide AI and agentic architecture strategy, govern data and platform decisions, establish scalable operating models, and ensure investments deliver proven business value through outcome measurement, financial accountability, and continuous innovation.

Preferred qualifications

About The Job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google's unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Account Manager, you will drive excellence by winning with unique value and maximizing the impact of our advertising solutions. You will relentlessly prove value and showcase success to spark future growth for our customers in the evolving AI-era.

As an Account Manager in the Media & Entertainment vertical, you'll craft innovative and effective cross-platform advertising solutions that propel Google's clients to the forefront of the industry. Drive accelerated growth for the world's best online streaming and theatrical companies, expertly navigating Google's powerful suite of products and services. Build strategic partnerships that transform the advertising landscape and execute bold initiatives that leave your mark. This is your opportunity to join a high impact, agile team and deliver a big impact.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Engage and influence key customer stakeholders by leading strategic meetings to uncover marketing goals and key performance indicators, translating them into actionable campaign strategies.

  • Analyze campaign data, ensuring performance is accurately tracked, and deliver measurable results aligned with customer objectives.
  • Monitor performance data to extract key insights, identifying and cultivating qualified upsell opportunities to drive future customer growth and build pipeline.

c8784d6589a96db0620222c9b2529b1a.snippet:
Job description


POSITION DESCRIPTION


Account Manager, within the South Asia Institutional team, to drive and execute our institutional client initiatives in the region. The regional coverage of the South Asia Institutional team includes all ASEAN, South Asia and Central Asia markets. There is scope to provide secondary coverage in South Asia Global Wealth Management coverage as appropriate. This position is based in Singapore.


Our client is recognized as a leading fixed income and alternatives managers globally. In APAC, their business franchise has also grown meaningfully, with expectations that the region will remain a key driver of growth. With the overall growth in APAC as a key strategic plan, our client is looking for an Account Manager with good experience and strong potential to expand our footprint in the South Asia region.


The Account Manager will report to the head of Greater China Institutional & South Asia Client Management, and work within the South Asia Institutional Client Management team covering these markets.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



  • As the Lead Account Manager for the assigned client base:

    • Client Servicing/Management

    • Acquire and oversee the relationship/initiatives of new and existing clients and mandates under coverage.

    • Take ownership of the client relationships from front to back end, ensuring that all investment, marketing, operational, compliance and legal requirements are met and the business is conducted in line with practice.

    • Develop relationships across the strata of influential asset allocators and investment teams in key institutions which have been identified as being interested in developing partnerships of this nature.

    • Participate in formal portfolio client reviews; the Account Manager needs to develop deep technical and macro expertise to act as the surrogate portfolio manager and represent the firm according to organisation standards.

    • Business Development/Growth

    • Develop and execute the business plan of assigned client segment. Specific to this role, the segment coverage is expected to be insurance and official institutions, but can evolve based on the experience of the candidate

    • Position the full range of organisation’s products and services to the assigned investor base with the assistance of senior investment professionals where appropriate.

    • As the supporting Account Manager for the assigned client base: -Collaborate with the Lead Account Manager and client management team to provide relationship management coverage, including stepping in as the Account Manager as appropriate.

    • As a key member of the South Asia Institutional Client Management team: -Develop and execute a holistic business plan to deepen and broaden the firm's footprint, with a primary emphasis on Insurance and official institutions as key client segments

    • Build and maintain a detailed knowledge of key business and strategic issues facing target channels, with the objective of addressing these issues




IDEAL EXPERIENCE



  • Proven record in growing and managing institutional client relationships in Singapore and SEA markets

  • Outstanding sales closing, relationship management and negotiation skills. Capable of driving own agenda and overseeing client relationships from front end to back end

  • Experienced business developer and servicer focused on meeting with clients very regularly and representing the firm at client meetings and key events

  • Stature, gravitas and seniority to operate at the highest level - internally and externally.

  • Collegiate team player, experienced and comfortable working in an international operating environment.

  • Deep technical knowledge and understanding of investment concepts, economics and capital markets, with at least 6-8 years of relevant industry experience. Experience in fixed income, alternatives, private credit and real estate will be strongly preferred.


EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS



  • Bachelor degree in Finance or Economics or relevant curriculum.

  • Regulatory certificate in relevant jurisdiction

  • CFA, or Masters Degree, or progress towards attaining the designation

Account Servicing · Brand Campaigns & Communications · Korean Celebrity Marketing · Events

At ED&C, www.ednc.co, we believe great account managers don't just manage timelines, they build relationships, solve problems, and create opportunities for clients to grow. We're looking for someone who is independent, solutions-oriented, commercially minded, and experienced in managing clients, media partners, stakeholders, and talent representatives.

Our work spans integrated marketing campaigns, celebrity partnerships, public relations, regional events, and brand activations. With offices in Singapore, Seoul, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Jakarta, and Taipei, we work with some of Asia's most dynamic brands and celebrities.

If you enjoy taking ownership, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited by the intersection of communications, entertainment, celebrity partnerships, and regional marketing, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Build trusted client relationships by combining strategic thinking, commercial awareness, and exceptional execution.
  • Lead campaigns and projects, from product launches and media events to celebrity partnerships, regional activations, and integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Manage media, talent representatives, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are executed smoothly and professionally.
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen by understanding client objectives, budgets, and commercial priorities while recommending solutions that create value for both the client and the agency.
  • Manage celebrity public relations initiatives, including media engagements, interview coordination, and press events.
  • Communicate thoughtfully and appropriately, adapting your approach to different clients, markets, partners, media representatives, and talent teams.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships through strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and new business initiatives.
  • Work with a strong sense of urgency by anticipating challenges, solving problems proactively, and maintaining momentum across multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Stay adaptable and resourceful while managing shifting priorities, tight deadlines, and unexpected changes.

Who You Are

  • Four to six years of experience in account management, public relations, talent management, integrated marketing, advertising, entertainment, communications, or events.
  • Experience in a PR, communications, advertising, marketing, entertainment, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, or talent management agency environment is strongly preferred.
  • Mature, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while remaining highly collaborative.
  • An excellent communicator with strong writing skills and the ability to manage relationships across different cultures and seniority levels.
  • Commercially minded, with the ability to balance creativity, client objectives, budgets, and business outcomes.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Possesses a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
  • Resourceful, adaptable, and comfortable navigating unfamiliar situations.
  • Passionate about entertainment, celebrity culture, media, and regional marketing trends.
  • Fluency in Mandarin, Korean, or other Asian languages would be an advantage.

Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As an Account Manager, Agency, you'll be at the center of this transformation and drive growth across your customers. You'll partner directly with Profound’s agency partners’ executives and key stakeholders to understand their business goals, address pain points, and ensure Profound is delivering clear, measurable ROI for the agencies and for their end clients. Working closely with our Agency Engagement Managers and Agency Account Executives, you'll connect platform usage and engagement to real business outcomes, and expand relationships both within agencies and with their end clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 40 to 60 accounts (depends on contract values) and be directly responsible for renewal and expansion revenue
  • Co-manage the customer lifecycle with the Agency Engagement Management team from onboarding through expansions and renewals, identifying opportunities to deepen adoption and value for the agency and their clients
  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s goals, workflows, and organization to position Profound as a must-have partner
  • Partner with agencies to build strong relationships with enterprise brands along the way, empowering agency stakeholders and their client stakeholders
  • Build organizational maps of agencies to expand relationships and impact
  • Build and manage a pipeline of renewals, cross-sells, and upsells against monthly and quarterly revenue targets
  • Lead commercial conversations including executive business reviews and negotiations for multi-product renewals and upsells
  • Forecast with precision using CRM data and pipeline management best practices to ensure transparency and accountability
  • Drive mutual value for agencies who are part of the Profound Partners program, in collaboration with the Ecosystem team (joint GTM, training and enablement, etc.)
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Agency Account Executives and Agency Engagement Managers to deliver a seamless agency partnership experience and surface insights that drive adoption

Who You Are

  • 5 or more years of SaaS experience in account management, renewals, or expansion sales, with a specific focus on agencies and agency partnerships
  • Track record of exceeding commercial targets through renewals and upsells, with quota-carrying experience preferred
  • Strong consultative selling skills and comfort leading discovery, demos, and business reviews with senior stakeholders
  • Excellent negotiation and closing skills with the ability to manage complex deals and procurement processes
  • High emotional intelligence and communication skills, able to build trust quickly and manage multiple, matrixed stakeholder relationships, at the independent / subsidiary agency level and at the holding company level
  • Highly organized and data-driven with strong pipeline discipline and attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, resourceful, proactive, and comfortable owning outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • High integrity and long-term orientation, motivated by customer and partnership success and sustainable revenue growth

Location

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, London, or Singapore office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $90,000 to $140,000 before variable compensation. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

Compensation Range: $70K - $140K

423b44e03d5520154ca1c88084a12eb9.snippet:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values - Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

The Vice President, Cash Management Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and deepening client relationships within UOB's Group Transaction Banking franchise. This role focuses on delivering cash management and liquidity solutions to corporate and commercial clients, supporting their working capital, treasury, and operational banking needs.

The incumbent will lead sales origination efforts, develop strategic client relationships, and collaborate across product, implementation, and coverage teams to deliver holistic client solutions

Job Responsibility

Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Drive acquisition of new-to-bank clients and expand share-of-wallet from existing clients in the cash management space.
  • Achieve individual sales targets across deposits, transaction volumes, and fee-based income.
  • Identify opportunities across payables, receivables, liquidity management, and digital solutions.
  • Build a strong pipeline through proactive prospecting and market engagement.

Client Relationship Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor to corporate clients on treasury and cash management solutions.
  • Understand clients' operating models, cash flows, and industry dynamics to provide tailored solutions.
  • Partner closely with Relationship Managers (RMs) to jointly manage and grow key accounts.
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention.

Solutioning & Deal Execution

  • Structure and propose end-to-end cash management solutions aligned with client needs.
  • Lead or support RFPs, pitches, and solution presentations to clients.
  • Coordinate with product specialists, implementation, legal, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Maintain strong awareness of regulatory requirements and internal policies.

Product & Market Expertise

  • Payments and collections
  • Liquidity and cash concentration
  • Virtual accounts and digital channels
  • Cross-border and regional solutions

Stay abreast of market trends, competitor offerings, and regulatory developments. Provide feedback to product teams to support innovation and enhancement.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across coverage, product, implementation, operations, and risk functions.
  • Contribute to regional initiatives and cross-border deals within ASEAN and Greater China.
  • Support junior team members and contribute to team development where required.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related discipline.
  • Typically 8-12 years of relevant experience in transaction banking, cash management sales, or corporate banking.
  • Proven track record in originating and closing cash management deals.
  • Strong understanding of corporate treasury and working capital solutions.
  • Experience managing large corporates and/or mid-sized enterprises in Singapore or regional markets preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong sales acumen with a results-driven mindset
  • Excellent client engagement and presentation skills
  • Ability to structure complex financial solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills
  • Analytical thinking with attention to detail
  • Willingness to deep dive into solutions and problem solving for clients and stakeholders
  • Good understanding of banking regulations and risk considerations
  • High level of resilience and adaptability
